jobs.title: PhD Candidate in Risk-Based Power System Operation and Utilisation of Transformer Capacity
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

Are you motivated to take a step towards a doctorate and open up exciting career opportunities? Do you have a background in electric power systems and are you interested in risk-based power system operation? As a PhD Candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate, and at the same time gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a further career in higher education and research, in and outside academia. 

The Department of Electric Energy (IEL) at NTNU is seeking a highly motivated candidate for a full-time (100%) PhD position for 3 years in “Risk-Based Power System Operation and Utilisation of Transformer Capacity”. You will join the research group Power System Operation and Analysis (PSOA) at IEL, where we foster an open, inclusive, and collaborative working environment.

Our working environment is characterized by a friendly, supportive atmosphere, with regular gatherings such as professional meetings within the research group, weekly research colloquia, shared lunches, and “Friday coffee” sessions to wrap up the week. Formal and informal gatherings provide opportunities to exchange ideas, celebrate milestones, and strengthen connections. PhD Candidates also arrange social activities, open to everyone who wishes to join, creating a welcoming and inclusive community.

Your immediate Line Manager will be the Head of Department.


About the project

The PhD position is a part of the Knowledge-building Project “Increasing Emergency Load Limits for Transformers” (KSP UPLOAD) that is starting up in 2027. SINTEF Energy Research is the project owner.  NTNU is a participating partner, together with leading industry partners. Hiring for the PhD position is subject to the final confirmation of funding availability from KSP UPLOAD.

Liquid-immersed power transformers are critical power grid assets. Due to an ageing power grid, growing demand for electricity, and very long lead times on installing new transformers, there is a need to both increase the utilization of existing infrastructure of transformers and to maximise the value of new investments. Increasing the short-term load limits for transformers will free up capacity to accommodate new load and generation, reduce the need for reinvestments, and provide back-up capacity in case of emergency. Improved methods for condition monitoring and prediction, along with better risk criteria can reduce uncertainties and offer a possibility for increasing the transformer loading. KSP UPLOAD will investigate key failure mechanisms for transformers, map the benefits and risks of increasing the load and temperature limits, and pilot new concepts for risk control. 

The PhD Position belongs to Work Package 1 of KSP UPLOAD: ‘System-level Benefits and Risks in from Increased Loading’. It addresses the question of how to quantify the socio-economic benefits, as well as the risk with respect to reliability of supply, when operating transformers beyond nameplate limits. 

The tasks meant for the PhD work are related to:  

  • Quantifying how higher loading limits affect the socio-economic trade-off between reliability of supply and making additional capacity available to power markets with flow-based market coupling.
  • Developing methods for optimally allocating the additional transfer capability enabled by increased transformer loading limits across day-ahead, intraday, and balancing markets to maximize socio-economic value while respecting system security and reliability constraints.

Different approaches can be explored, such as integrating probabilistic and deterministic reliability criteria with market operation in a single security-constrained optimal power flow model, and combining optimal power flow analysis with reliability analysis methods.

The main supervisor of the PhD Candidate will be Associate Professor Vijay Venu Vadlamudi (IEL). Co-supervisors will be Professor Hossein Farahmand (IEL) and Senior Research Scientist Iver Bakken Sperstad (SINTEF Energy Research). 


Duties of the position
  • Conduct high-quality research within the framework described above.
  • Participate in activities of the research group Power System Operation and Analysis (PSOA).
  • Complete academic training consisting of coursework corresponding to a minimum of 30 ECTS.
  • Contribute to publications in relevant journals and to popular science dissemination.
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions.

Career-enhancing work, which is in addition to the research project and doctoral education, may be offered to a candidate who demonstrates clear motivation and ability for such work, and if the Department determines there is a need. Examples of career-enhancing work include, but are not limited to, contributing to teaching, laboratory and exercise teaching, supervision, and examination work within the employee's areas of competence. 

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must hold a Master’s degree within Electric Power Engineering, with specialization in electric power and/or energy systems. 
  • Your course of study must correspond to a five-year Norwegian course, where 120 credits have been obtained at the Master's level. Master's students can apply, but the Master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position, and no later than autumn 2026.
  • You must have proficient programming skills in Python.
  • Employment is contingent upon the candidate’s ability to obtain the required security clearance.
  • You must have a strong academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker grade background, you may be considered if you can document that you are particularly suitable for a PhD education, i.e., by having relevant work experience and/or published/publishable scientific papers.
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the Faculty's Doctoral Programme.
  • You must have English language skills, both written and spoken, corresponding to the scale B2 in the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). Applicants who are not native English speakers are encouraged to document their English language proficiency. One of the following test scores could be documented for this purpose: 
    • TOEFL internet-based test (iBT) - Score equivalent to the B2 level: 79 - 101. 
    • IELTS - Score equivalent to the B2 level: 5.5 - 6.0 
    • Cambridge English - Score equivalent to the B2 level: 160 - 179.

Further assessment of both written and oral English language skills and the ability to communicate fluently will be conducted in the continued selection process and during any interviews for all applicants.

PLEASE NOTE: For detailed information about what the application must contain, see paragraph “About the application”.

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • Master’s thesis relevant to the announced position.
  • English language skills, both written and spoken, corresponding to the scale C1 in the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). See which scores are equivalent to the C1 level here.
  • Proficiency in a Scandinavian language (Norwegian, Swedish, or Danish), both written and spoken, at B2 level or higher is considered an advantage. The candidate is expected to collaborate with stakeholders in the Norwegian industry and utility sectors, where Norwegian is the working language.

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • demonstrate strong motivation, curiosity, and a learning-oriented mindset
  • work independently, take initiative, and maintain good structure and discipline in their work
  • communicate effectively and collaborate well with supervisors and peers
  • show resilience and work constructively when facing challenges or setbacks
  • demonstrate integrity and a strong sense of responsibility in their research conduct

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Social activities organized by PhD Students
  • Weekly social gathering on Fridays (Friday coffee)
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)  
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals.  

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. 


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years, with the possibility of an additional 3 to 12 months of employment related to career-enhancing activities. 

The option for career-enhancing work may be offered to a candidate who has clear motivation and ability for such work, and if the Department deems it necessary. This will be clarified with the candidate during and after any interview.  

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Electric Power Engineering within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme throughout the period of employment.

The position is conditional on external funding.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in Norwegian/a Scandinavian language or English. 

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • A cover letter where the applicant describes personal motivation, summarizes scientific work, and explains how the applicant sees her/his background as suitable (400 words/1 page).
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project, and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages, including references). This proposal will be neither final nor binding for the project.
  • CV.
  • If you have testimonials of work experience, submit them.
  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees. If you have not yet completed your Master's thesis, you must provide confirmation on your estimated date for the submission of the Master's thesis, or confirmation that your Master's thesis has been submitted.
    • Applicants from universities outside Norway are requested to send a diploma supplement or a similar document, which describes in detail the study programme and grading system.
  • A copy of the Master's thesis. If you recently submitted your Master's thesis, you are encouraged to attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position. 
  • If you have publications or other relevant research work, submit them.
  • You are encouraged to include documentation of English language proficiency if you are not a native speaker of English. 
  • Name and contact information of three referees.


If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.


Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Associate Professor Vijay Venu Vadlamudi by email at vijay.vadlamudi@ntnu.no. 

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact Head of Office Bodil Wold by e-mail at bodil.wold@ntnu.no.  

Application deadline: 23.11.2026

-----------------

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 

The city of Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the tech capital of Norway with a population of 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Professional subsidized day-care for children is easily available. Furthermore, Trondheim offers great opportunities for education (including international schools) and possibilities to enjoy nature, culture and family life and has low crime rates and clean air quality.

The Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) creates knowledge for a better world and solutions that can change everyday life.

The Department of Electric Energy is one of the seven departments at the Faculty of Information Technology and Electrical Engineering. This gives us outstanding opportunities for interdisciplinary research with high relevance for the society, addressing industrial needs and global challenges.

jobs.title: Yrkessjåfør - varetransport og godstransport
jobs.description:
Yrkessjåfører søkes – buss, minibuss, lastebil og vogntog

Professional Drivers Wanted – Bus, Minibus, Truck.

English text below the Norwegian text.

Arbeidssted: Finnsnes, Troms

Ulf Trulsen AS, Senja Tours og Finnsnes Termotransport søker dyktige og pålitelige yrkessjåfører til våre virksomheter på Finnsnes.

Vi søker

• Bussjåfører – klasse D til turbuss og persontransport

• Minibussjåfører – klasse D1

• Lastebilsjåfører – klasse C/CE til godstransport, distribusjon og langtransport

Fleksible turnusordninger

Vi tilbyr flere arbeidsordninger og ønsker å finne en løsning som passer den enkelte sjåfør:

• Fast heltidsstilling med ordinær arbeidstid

• 14/14-turnus – 14 dager arbeid / 14 dager fri

• Månedsturnus – én måned arbeid / én måned fri

• Andre turnusordninger etter avtale

Turnusordningene gjør stillingene godt egnet for deg som ønsker å pendle mellom hjemlandet og Norge, samtidig som du får lengre perioder fri.

Bolig og innkvartering

Vi kan hjelpe sjåfører som ønsker å flytte til Norge med å finne bolig i Finnsnesområdet.

For deg som ønsker å pendle, kan vi undersøke rimelige løsninger for innkvartering i arbeidsperiodene, for eksempel:

• Hybel

• Leilighet

• Boligmodul

• Annen egnet innkvartering

Vi ønsker å gjøre det enkelt å kombinere arbeid hos oss med bosted og familieliv i hjemlandet.

Vi hjelper deg med overgangen til Norge

For kandidater fra Norden og EU/EØS kan vi bistå med praktiske spørsmål knyttet til oppstart i Norge, blant annet:

• Førerkort og YSK

• Norske krav og regler

• Skatteregistrering

• Bolig og innkvartering

• Andre praktiske og administrative forhold

Vi vurderer hver kandidat individuelt og forsøker å finne gode løsninger for både arbeid, turnus, bolig og pendling.

Om Finnsnes

Finnsnes ligger i Senja kommune i Troms i Nord-Norge og er et viktig transport- og regionsenter i Midt-Troms. Området byr på spektakulær nordnorsk natur, samtidig som Finnsnes har et aktivt næringsliv og gode servicetilbud.

Vi ser etter deg som

• Har førerkort D, D1, C eller CE, avhengig av stillingen

• Har nødvendig YSK

• Er en trygg og ansvarsfull sjåfør

• Er serviceinnstilt og profesjonell

• Kan arbeide selvstendig og fleksibelt

• Behersker norsk, svensk, dansk, finsk eller engelsk

Erfaring som yrkessjåfør er en fordel.

Interessert?

Send oss gjerne CV og en kort presentasjon av deg selv. Oppgi hvilken førerkortklasse du har, hvilken type kjøring du er interessert i, og om du ønsker fast arbeid, turnus eller pendling.

Vi oppfordrer kvalifiserte sjåfører fra Norge, Norden og EU/EØS til å søke.

Arbeidssted: Finnsnes, Troms

Stillinger: D / D1 / C / CE

Arbeidsform: Fast stilling og ulike turnusordninger

Oppstart: Etter avtale

In ENGLISH:

Professional Drivers Wanted – Bus, Minibus, Truck.

Location: Finnsnes, Troms, Northern Norway

Ulf Trulsen AS, Senja Tours and Finnsnes Termotransport are looking for skilled and reliable professional drivers to join our operations in Finnsnes.

We are looking for

• Bus drivers – Category D for coach/tour bus and passenger transport

• Minibus drivers – Category D1

• Truck drivers – Category C/CE for freight transport, distribution and long-haul transport

Flexible shift and rotation schedules

We offer several work arrangements and aim to find a solution that suits each individual driver:

• Full-time positions with regular working hours

• 14/14 rotation – 14 days working / 14 days off

• Monthly rotation – one month working / one month off

• Other rotation schedules by agreement

Our rotation schedules are particularly suitable for drivers who wish to commute between their home country and Norway, while enjoying longer periods of time off.

Accommodation and housing

We can assist drivers who wish to relocate to Norway in finding accommodation in the Finnsnes area.

For drivers who prefer to commute, we can also look into affordable accommodation during working periods, such as:

• Rooms

• Apartments

• Modular accommodation

• Other suitable housing solutions

Our goal is to make it as easy as possible to combine working with us with living and family life in your home country.

We help you with the transition to Norway

For candidates from the Nordic countries and EU/EEA, we can provide guidance and practical assistance with matters related to starting work in Norway, including:

• Driving licences and Driver CPC / YSK

• Norwegian rules and requirements

• Tax registration

• Housing and accommodation

• Other practical and administrative matters

We assess each candidate individually and aim to find good solutions regarding work arrangements, rotation schedules, accommodation and commuting.

About Finnsnes

Finnsnes is located in Senja Municipality in Troms, Northern Norway, and is an important transport and regional centre in Mid-Troms. The area offers spectacular Northern Norwegian nature, while Finnsnes has an active business community and good local services.

We are looking for someone who

• Holds a Category D, D1, C or CE driving licence, depending on the position

• Holds the required Driver CPC / YSK

• Is a safe and responsible driver

• Is service-minded and professional

• Works well independently and is flexible

• Speaks Norwegian (or another Scandinavian langiage) and/or English

Previous professional driving experience is an advantage.

Interested?

Please send us your CV and a short introduction about yourself. Let us know which driving license category you hold, what type of driving you are interested in, and whether you are looking for a full-time position, rotation work or a commuting arrangement.

We welcome qualified drivers from Norway, the Nordic countries and the EU/EEA to apply.

Location: Finnsnes, Troms, Norway

Positions: D / D1 / C / CE

Work arrangements: Full-time and various rotation schedules

Start date: By agreement

Ulf Trulsen AS, Senja Tours og Finnsnes Termotransport søker dyktige og pålitelige yrkessjåfører til våre virksomheter på Finnsnes.

jobs.title: Har du hænderne godt skruet på? Vi søger 2 produktionsmedarbejdere i Holstebro!
jobs.description:
Er du praktisk anlagt, kvalitetsbevidst og klar på nye udfordringer? Så har vi måske jobbet til dig!

På vegne af en stor og solid virksomhed i Holstebro, der producerer aluminiumsfacader og vinduer, søger vi 2 medarbejdere til produktion og montage.

Du behøver ikke nødvendigvis at være uddannet håndværker. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at arbejde med hænderne, er nysgerrig på nye opgaver og måske har en lille håndværker gemt i maven.

Du bliver en del af et team med gode kolleger, hvor samarbejde, kvalitet og en god arbejdsindsats er i fokus.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Samling af aluminiumsfacader og aluminiumsvinduer

  • Montering af beslag og forskellige komponenter

  • Påsætning af gummi- og tætningslister

  • Lettere montageopgaver

  • Andre praktiske opgaver i produktionen

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er mødestabil og tager ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Har hænderne godt skruet på og lyst til at lære nyt

  • Arbejder omhyggeligt og har sans for kvalitet og detaljer

  • Trives med fysisk arbejde og praktiske opgaver

  • Kan samarbejde med dine kolleger og bidrage positivt til teamet

Det vigtigste er din indstilling og lyst til at lære. Har du praktisk erfaring fra tidligere arbejde, produktion, montage eller håndværk, er det selvfølgelig en fordel – men din motivation er mindst lige så vigtig.

Du skal som minimum beherske det danske sprog i skrift og tale svarende til modul 3 i dansk undervisning.

Vi tilbyder

  • Fuldtidsstilling på daghold

  • Ansættelse på ubestemt tid

  • Opstart snarest muligt

  • En arbejdsplads med gode kolleger og mulighed for at lære nye færdigheder

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig!

Medarbejderne ApS håndterer ansættelsen for virksomheden. Vi er et veldrevet rekrutterings & vikarbureau med ni afdelinger fordelt i landet. Vi er medlem af Vikar Branchen DI, som bla. forpligtiger os til at oveholde lovpligtoge regler så som GDPR. Vi passer godt på dig hos Medarbejderne ApS.

Bemærk at ansøgninger og CV via mails ikke behandles.

Du kan ansøge om jobbet via dette link; https://medarbejderne.peopletrust.dk/candidate/?module=candidateweb&page=Job&action=readMore&jobId=1020176

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Avustaja sympaattiselle asiakkaalle Sotkamoon
jobs.description:
**Avustaja sympaattiselle asiakkaalle**

Haemme avustajaa osa-aikaiseen työhön avustamaan sympaattista asiakastamme Sotkamossa.

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden palveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys, joka tarjoaa iloa ja turvaa ikäihmisten arkeen. Mottomme on: autamme ikääntyviä kuin omaa äitiämme.

Kasvamme jatkuvasti ja etsimme lisää avustajia tiimiimme. Löydät lyhyen ja helposti täytettävän hakulomakkeemme täältä: https://helpper.hemby.fi/apply

**Mitä helpperiltä vaaditaan?**

Helppereiltä ei vaadita sote-alan kokemusta tai tutkintoa. Tärkeää on, että palat halusta auttaa ja sinulla on reipas työote. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat myös hyvin joustavat.

Helpperin työtä voivat tehdä kaikki yli 18-vuotiaat opiskelijoista eläkeläisiin.

Tärkeintä on, että haluat viettää aikaa ikäihmisten kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat hyvin joustavat.

**Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä?**

Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:

"Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."

"Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."

Auttaminen kokonaisvaltaisesti seniorin tarpeiden mukaan."

**Helpperinä saat:**

Oman nimetyn ikäihmisen, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun ohelle tai lisätyöksi. Tavallisin työaika on 2-10h/vko. Kilpailukykyisen palkan: 13,20-15,98 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset. Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro- tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!

Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

Lähetä hakemus helpperiksi täältä: https://www.hemby.fi/hae-helpperiksi

Lue lisää Hembystä täältä:https://www.hemby.fi/

Mikäli sinulla on kysyttävää helpperiksi ryhtymisestä, laita meille sähköpostia osoitteeseen rekry@hemby.fi, niin jutellaan lisää!

jobs.title: Senior Growth Manager - France to Morocco
jobs.description:
LemFi (Series B) is building the go-to financial app for the Global South.


Moving to a new country shouldn’t mean starting from zero. That's why our team of 400+ spanning 20+ countries is building a financial ecosystem that helps immigrants stay connected to home, build stability, and create wealth regardless of where they are from or where they live.


What began as fast, affordable remittances is now evolving into a complete platform for multi-currency accounts, payments, credit, and long-term financial growth.


With millions of users across the globe, we process over $1B in monthly transactions to 30+ countries, proving that borders shouldn't limit financial opportunity.

About the role

As the Senior Growth Manager for the France-Morocco corridor, you'll drive LemFi's expansion within the Moroccan diaspora in one of our most critical markets. While the primary focus of your community-building will be in France, we are open to candidates based in France, the UK, or other European countries where LemFi currently operates.

This is a growth role that requires you to be comfortable traveling to key diaspora hubs to build a physical community presence and drive high-leverage organic growth. You will direct influencer negotiations, manage external agencies and key community leaders, and execute grassroots field marketing.

You'll spend 3 to 5 days every few weeks in a new city (primarily across France or other key European hubs), representing LemFi at events, building partnerships, rigorously tracking campaign performance, and driving user acquisition. You're embedded in the communities we serve, acting as both a strategist and a ground-level operator. You will work across paid channels, organic strategy, and local product teams to drive massive user acquisition in this market, while serving as the voice of the user.

What you'll build and own

  • Travel across France (and potentially other key European markets) 3 to 5 days every few weeks, establishing an on-the-ground presence in key cities. Attend community events, build and expand LemFi's community network with local Moroccan leaders and organizations, and grow relationships that build deep trust.

  • Develop and execute comprehensive user acquisition strategies tailored for the Moroccan diaspora communities in France and Europe. Own growth targets for assigned markets and optimize based on data and insights.

  • Source, negotiate directly with, and manage France/Morocco-focused influencers, community leaders, and external agencies to drive scalable organic growth.

  • Lead community-driven initiatives to build trust, awareness, and advocacy, and participate in local events, meetups, and forums. Build and maintain relationships with community leaders and grassroots partners, implementing tracking mechanisms for the exact customer acquisition cost of your activities.

Your experience

  • At least 5 years of experience in fast-paced environments with a background in growth, sales, marketing or similar.

  • Proven ability to work against targets and deliver measurable results. You're motivated by ambitious goals and comfortable being measured against clear KPIs.

  • Strong data-driven mindset. You interpret data, track performance and adjust strategies accordingly.

  • Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to build trust with diverse stakeholders. You're a persuasive communicator who can influence partners and leaders.

  • Entrepreneurial and tenacious. You take ownership, push through obstacles and find ways to win. Biased to action, you think critically and move quickly.

  • Self-motivated and effective working independently and in remote environments. You're willing to travel extensively and work occasional weekends to support market growth.

Nice to have

  • Prior experience launching or scaling ventures in new markets.

  • Deep understanding of African and diaspora community in Europe. You're culturally fluent and comfortable immersing yourself in new cultural environments.

  • Background in fintech, payments or diaspora-focused products.

  • Established network within diaspora communities.


Why Join LemFi?

Love shouldn’t be expensive, yet those working hardest for their families often face predatory fees and banking exclusion. We're changing this.

At LemFi, you won’t be just a cog in a machine. Whether designing products, scaling operations, or telling our story, you’ll tackle complex challenges with real, immediate impact. Your work goes beyond metrics - it puts money back in families’ pockets and offers access to the previously excluded. Join us to make a meaningful difference, where high performance is a lifeline for millions.

You can connect with us on LinkedIn and Instagram and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store or Google Play.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Trust & Safety (Full Remote - France)
jobs.description:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

We are looking for a Trust & Safety Product Manager to own the product and technical delivery of our compliance and safety initiatives across our platforms.

You will turn safety requirements into effective product features, moderation capabilities, third-party integrations, and measurable improvements. Working closely with Compliance, Engineering, AI/ML, Product, and Customer Support, you will help us identify risks earlier, build safeguards into new features, and continuously improve how our safety systems perform.

This is a newly created role within our Product team, working directly with our CTO, Michael Monin and our Legal & Safety Lead, Maxwelle Sokol. You will have significant ownership from the outset and the opportunity to shape how the safety product function develops as the company continues to grow.

Our platform serves adults and permits lawful adult content. We are looking for someone who can navigate sensitive, context-dependent issues thoughtfully, protecting users and enforcing clear boundaries without unnecessarily restricting legitimate expression.

Here’s what you can expect:

Key Responsibilities

  • Safety & legal product strategy and delivery. Translate safety policies, legal requirements (e.g., in online safety and AI-specific laws such as the EU AI Act), incident findings, and user feedback into clear product requirements, acceptance criteria, and engineering work. Drive initiatives from problem definition through implementation, testing, launch, and ongoing improvement.

  • Internally developed moderation technologies. Own the product side of improvements to our in-house moderation systems, including our proprietary LLM technology EverGuard. Partner with Engineering and AI/ML teams on, e.g., detection capabilities, moderation rules and thresholds, and appropriate interventions across user inputs and AI-generated outputs.

  • Third-party safety partnerships and integrations. Lead the technical and product lifecycle of third-party safety partnerships, from identifying needs and evaluating providers to implementation, testing, rollout, and ongoing performance management.

  • Safety dashboards, monitoring, and quality assurance. Establish dashboards and a recurring QA that help us proactively identify emerging issues, prevent harmful content, and ensure that our T&S measures are working as intended.

  • Red teaming and adversarial testing. Own our testing for how moderation systems and product safeguards respond to deliberate misuse and difficult edge cases. Track findings through remediation, retesting, and closure—not just delivery of a report.

  • Trust and safety reviews for new features. Establish and run a dedicated T&S review for new features, with proportionate reviews for material changes to existing features, models, and integrations. Engage early in product design to identify foreseeable misuse, affected users, and appropriate safeguards.

  • Incident follow-through and continuous improvement. Coordinate the product and engineering response to significant safety issues, working with colleagues responsible for incident management, policy, and user support.

Learn more about our Trust & Safety infrastructure in our Trust & Safety Hub.

Your Qualifications

  • Data-driven product decisions that align with legal/ethical standards: You can name the metrics you want to influence, explain why it matters, and say whether your work actually moved them. You’ve run A/B tests, product experiments, data deep-dives, or lightweight user research and used the findings to shape what was built next. You can assess risks associated with user-generated content, transactions, and interactions, and translate these into policies that align with legal and ethical standards, trackers/dashboards, and strategic planning;

  • Content moderation and AI guardrails: You understand how product realities and safety requirements interact on a tech platform; you explore strategies for efficient and scalable content moderation, including automation, machine learning, human review and user reporting.

  • Legal/safety work experience: You have worked closely with trust and safety and compliance requirements and understand how to translate and implement these for a consumer-facing product;

  • Collaborative mindset and communication: You work cross-functionally with engineering, legal, operations, and customer support teams — these are your partners and support system, not your adversaries or a box to be checked. You ask the right questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and are fully fluent and comfortable in English;

  • AI fluency: You are completely comfortable working with and leveraging AI tools. You actively seek out and experiment with new tools and techniques without waiting for a project or manager to require them;

  • You are point person for third-party partnerships: You proactively test and can autonomously handle discussions with third-party tools and integrations that affect our compliance and safety posture;

  • You take ownership and move without waiting for certainty: Comfortable with ambiguity, you create clarity by investigating, building, testing, and learning rather than waiting for a complete brief. You balance execution against planning, address blockers early, and take responsibility for the outcome rather than waiting to be told what to do, caring more about reaching the right result than following a fixed process;

  • You are comfortable with the product category: you are fully comfortable building products based on uncensored models and content;

Bonus points

  • You have previous legal/compliance education

  • Professional experience or interest in AI

  • Experience with consumer-facing features, particularly in the entertainment or gaming industry

Soft Skills

🗣 Strong communication & collaborative skills (perfectly fluent in English)

🎯 Goal-oriented, ownership and commitment

⚡️ Doer mindset - we are moving fast and need people who can balance execution, planning, and strategy

🧢 Humble - willing to learn, open to feedback

🍭 #NSFW - Comfortable reviewing and discussing uncensored AI-generated content and NSFW material

We believe strongly that information can be learned, but effort and motivation cannot. If this role appeals to you but you don’t have hands-on experience in all the fields listed in this job description, apply anyway and tell us why you’d be a good fit!

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

jobs.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Disclaimer: We're open to hire Account Executives across our Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes and Biarritz offices.

⭐️ The Account Executive (mid-market) job

We’re expanding our Sales team in France and are looking for ‘full-stack’ Sales to engage with prospects and turn them into happy Alan customers. You will join a team that focuses on companies from one of the following segments: Tech & Engineering, Business Services & Media, Retail, Transport, HCR, Learn & Care, Food & Beverage or Metallurgy.

You will interact with everyone from HR executives to CEOs.

Meet Hakim in this article to learn more about makes the Metallurgy segment so interesting for an Account Executive.

Why is our Vertical approach interesting?

  • Market potential: Vast and dynamic markets with significant structural challenges, offering fertile ground for a modern, tech-driven solution like Alan.

  • Team readiness: We've honed our go-to-market strategy over the years, and it's paying off with increasing inbound leads and active field marketing driving strong pipeline momentum.

  • Passionate teams: Our dedicated teams brings deep sector expertise and genuine passion for the clients we serve; every day in the field sharpens our edge and fuels our conviction.

  • Growth opportunity: The addressable market is enormous, offering virtually unlimited opportunities for growth.

What will you do with us?

You’ll own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. The average sales cycle is 4-6 months, dealing with companies ranging from 30 to 300 employees, with an average ARR of 150K€.

At Alan, Account Executives drive deals and close strategic opportunities with prospects. We sometimes handle some customer relationships to ensure the best possible onboarding. You’ll educate prospects, provide inspiring product demos, and onboard key stakeholders, making the transition from prospect to customer seamless.

We expect you to understand and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method ensures the prospect experience is an integral part of the overall Alan customer experience—making it pleasant and delightful for everyone. We expect you to be instructive to prospects (Smart), as well as to define the best personalized high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

You’ll also help us grow and improve as a company, challenging us to enhance our product(s), methods, and strategy, and getting involved in initiatives to expand our customer base.

Meet Fanny Cibot who is Account Executive within the Business Services & Media Crew.


⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You’ll be a great fit for the Metallurgy Team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 4 years of experience managing the whole Sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. Prospection is a key part of the role;

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above) and an advanced level in English.

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills;

  • Have empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems;

  • Can influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building;

  • Have a deep understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue business models;

  • Have a great attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team;

  • Are eager to learn fast and make an impact from day 1;

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level range.

If you're still wondering whether this could be the best move for you, take a look at this article from Lucie Leflour, our Sales Lead in France.


Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

  • Har god evne til å sette grenser med varme og tydelighet

  • Er tålmodig, forutsigbar og tåler følelsesmessige svingninger

  • Har førerkort og mulighet til å følge opp barnet i skole og fritid

  • Har mulighet til å ha én omsorgsperson hjemme på heltid (for spesialiserte oppdrag)

Du kan være enslig, samboer eller gift - det viktigste er at du har et stabilt liv og et hjerterom for et barn som trenger deg. Vi oppfordrer spesielt deg med helse-, sosial- eller pedagogisk bakgrunn til å søke, men personlig egnethet og motivasjon vil alltid veie tungt.

Kanskje er det akkurat deg vi leter etter?

Arbeidsoppgaver

Arbeidsoppgaver som fosterhjem og spesialisert fosterhjem

Å være fosterhjem - og særlig spesialisert fosterhjem - er et meningsfylt og krevende omsorgsoppdrag med stor betydning for barn og unges liv. Du blir en stabil voksenperson som gir barnet trygghet, forutsigbarhet og gode relasjoner i hverdagen.

Som fosterhjem vil du blant annet:

  • Skape en trygg og stabil hverdag for barnet

  • Samarbeide tett med barnets familie, barnevernstjeneste og andre faginstanser

  • Bidra til barnets utvikling, mestring og trivsel gjennom omsorg, støtte og struktur

  • Delta i møter, veiledning og relevant opplæring

  • Være en aktiv og støttende del av barnets skole- og fritidsliv

Som spesialisert fosterhjem har du i tillegg:

  • Høyere grad av tilgjengelighet og tilstedeværelse, ofte i form av en hjemmeværende omsorgsperson

  • Økt samarbeid med fagpersoner, oppfølgingsteam og behandlingsapparat

  • Oppdrag knyttet til barn og unge med mer sammensatte utfordringer, som traumer, atferdsvansker eller omsorgssvikt

  • Tett faglig oppfølging og veiledning fra Omsorgsgruppen, samt jevnlig kompetanseheving

Begge roller krever mye - men gir enda mer tilbake. Hos Omsorgsgruppen står du aldri alene.

Vi tilbyr

Når du tar imot et barn gjennom Omsorgsgruppen, skal du føle deg både trygg, ivaretatt og faglig støttet. Vi vet at det å være fosterhjem er en stor oppgave - og vi er med deg hele veien.

Hos oss får du:

  • En meningsfull jobb i et selskap som setter barnet og relasjonen i sentrum

  • 24-timers tilgjengelighet - du står aldri alene, og har alltid noen å kontakte ved behov

  • Tett oppfølging fra erfarne fosterhjemsveiledere som kjenner hverdagen og gir deg god veiledning

  • Faglig oppdatering og kurs med høy kvalitet, slik at du er godt rustet i oppgaven

  • Arbeidsgodtgjørelse: Lønnsberegning vil være avhengig av fosterhjemmets utdanning, erfaring, og oppdragets omfang/særskilte krav.

  • Skattefri utgiftsdekning for nødvendige kostnader knyttet til barnet

  • Pensjonsopptjening og yrkesskadeforsikring

  • Avlastning - vi vet at gode pauser gir bedre omsorg

Omsorgsgruppen legger stor vekt på tillit, tilstedeværelse og kvalitet - både for barna og for deg som fosterhjem. Vi tror på styrken i nære relasjoner, og vi vet at trygge voksne gjør en forskjell.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Omsorgsgruppen AS er en verdidrevet organisasjon som setter menneskemøter i sentrum. Vi tror på kraften i trygghet, omsorg, medmenneskelighet og glede - og bruker disse verdiene aktivt i alt vi gjør. Vår spesialitet er relasjonsbygging, og vi vet at varige endringer skjer når mennesker blir møtt med respekt, ro og ekte tilstedeværelse.

Vi har kontor i hjertet av Moss sentrum og består av en engasjert personalgruppe på 30-40 fagpersoner, fordelt på tre avdelinger. Sammen jobber vi målrettet for å skape trygge rammer for barn, unge og familier som trenger støtte - og for deg som ønsker å være en del av dette viktige arbeidet.

jobs.title: Brukerstyrt personlig assistent til 23 år gammel mann
jobs.description:
Brukerstyrt personlig assistanse (BPA) er en ordning som gir mennesker med funksjonsnedsettelse praktisk bistand til å gjøre ting som andre kan gjøre selv.
BPA gir mulighet til å styre egen hverdag ved å bestemme når, og av hvem en trenger assistanse. Det gir større muligheter til å leve et aktivt og selvstendig liv.

Arbeidstid kan variere, men det vil være behov for assistent tirsdager kl.9-16, i tillegg til noen fredager kveld og søndager dagtid.  Gjerne oppgi i søknaden hvilke dager du har mulighet til å arbeide.

Gyldig politiattest ikke eldre enn 3 mnd må forevises før ansettelse.

Kun elektroniske søknader vil bli behandlet.

Det må vedlegges attester/vitnemål ved søknaden slik at vi kan beregne riktig ansiennitet og lønnsfastsettelse ved ansettelse.

 

   
Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Arbeidsoppgavene vil være varierte og innebære følge til diverse aktiviteter, bistå og veilede ved praktiske oppgaver i hjemmet som rengjøring og matlaging, veilede i personlig stell, kjøring.
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Erfaring fra lignende arbeid og psykisk helsearbeid er en fordel
  • Førerkort kl. B (automat)
  • Personlig egnethet vektlegges, og menn oppfordres til å søke
Personlige egenskaper
  • Du må være pålitelig, tålmodig  ansvarsfull, og være i god fysisk form
  • Det er en fordel om du er glad i trening og fysisk aktivitet
  • Du må være komfortabel med å være med på kristne møter
Vi tilbyr
  • God opplæring
  • Lønn etter gjeldende avtaleverk som pleiemedarbeider/assistent
  KontaktinformasjonMartine Edvardsen, Veileder - BPA tjenesten, 91 34 76 85, martine.edvardsen@kristiansand.kommune.no

4630 Kristiansand

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Bli med å styrke laget!

Kristiansand kommune har 115 000 innbyggere og er Agders største arbeidsgiver. Vi er over 9 000 ansatte med allsidige oppgaver innen et bredt spekter av tjenesteområder. Som en av landets største kommuner trenger vi stadig nye, engasjerte og motiverte medarbeidere.

Helse og mestring er ett av 6 direktørområder i Kristiansand kommune. Området har om lag 4 500 fast ansatte, et driftsbudsjett på 3,5 mrd. kr og består av 6 kommunalsjefsområder; Forvaltning og koordinering, omsorgssenter, livsmestring, helsefremming og inkludering, hjemmetjenester og rehabilitering og helse og mestringsdirektørens stab. Helse og mestring har ansvaret for å levere helse-, sosial- og omsorgstjenester til befolkingen i Kristiansand. Kristiansand kommune skal ha et høyt utviklingsfokus for å sikre bærekraftige tjenester. Det innebærer at oppgaver og funksjoner vil være i stadig utvikling.

Sterkere sammen er vår visjon. De beste resultatene blir til i samhandling. Våre arbeidsplasser skal kjennetegnes av verdiene på lag, på stell, på hugget. Vi ser hverandre, deler kompetanse og har et større perspektiv enn vårt eget. Vi legger vekt på god dialog med innbyggerne og ønsker sammen å skape stadig bedre tjenester. Vi er alltid på jakt etter effektive og bærekraftige måter å jobbe på – for fellesskapet, miljøet og fremtiden.

Vår kommune har fokus på et inkluderende arbeidsliv og er opptatt av at arbeidsstyrken skal gjenspeile mangfoldet i samfunnet. Vi ønsker medarbeidere med ulike kompetanser, fagkombinasjoner, livserfaring og perspektiver for å bidra til enda bedre oppgaveløsning. Vi oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte til å søke, uansett alder, kjønn, funksjonsevne, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn. Vi vil tilrettelegge for medarbeidere som har behov for det der det er mulig. Aktuell tilrettelegging kan for eksempel være tekniske hjelpemidler, tilpasning av møbler eller endring av rutiner, arbeidsoppgaver og arbeidstid.

Velkommen til en veldrevet organisasjon.

Kristiansand kommune praktiserer meroffentlighet, jf. offentleglova § 11. Offentlig søkerliste vil normalt inneholde navn på samtlige søkere. Det må foreligge særskilte omstendigheter for å få innvilget unntak, jf. offentleglova § 25.

jobs.description:
Etsimme asiakasyrityksellemme Sähkö-Team Oy:lle sähkömoottoreiden huoltoon ja korjaukseen keskittyvää asentajaa Helsingin Roihupellossa sijaitsevalle korjaamolle.

Sähkö-Team Oy on vuonna 1977 perustettu sähköalan yritys, jonka ydinosaamista ovat sähkökoneiden ja sähkömoottoreiden huolto ja korjaus. Yrityksen korjaamolla huolletaan ja korjataan monenlaisia sähkömoottoreita ja sähkökoneita eri käyttötarkoituksiin. Työhön kuuluu muun muassa sähköisiä ja mekaanisia korjauksia, moottoreiden vianmääritystä, huoltoja sekä tarvittaessa käämintätöitä. Sähkö-Team toimii monimerkkikorjaamona ja palvelee asiakkaita pääasiassa pääkaupunkiseudulla, mutta sähkömoottoreita saapuu huoltoon myös muualta Suomesta.

Toimenkuva:

Etsimme käytännönläheistä ja teknisesti osaavaa henkilöä osaksi Sähkö-Teamin korjaamotiimiä. Työ on kokoaikainen ja vakituinen ja työtä tehdään arkisin klo 07.30 – 16.00. Tehtävässä työllistyt suoraan asiakasyrityksemme kirjoille.

Työ painottuu sähkömoottoreiden huoltoon, vianmääritykseen ja korjaukseen. Tehtävässä pääset käsittelemään erilaisia sähkömoottoreita ja sähkökoneita aina vian selvittämisestä moottorin purkamiseen, korjaamiseen, kokoonpanoon ja testaukseen asti.

Työskentely tapahtuu pääsääntöisesti korjaamolla, mutta työhön kuuluu tarvittaessa asiakaskohteissa tehtävät vianmääritys- ja mittaustyöt. Joskus isoja sähkömoottoreita huolletaan myös paikan päällä asiakkaan tiloissa, jolloin työskennellään työryhmässä yhdessä muiden Sähkö-Teamin asentajien kanssa.

Työtehtäviisi voi kuulua esimerkiksi:

\- sähkömoottoreiden huolto, korjaus ja testaus

\- moottoreiden purku, tarkastus ja kokoonpano

\- sähköisten vikojen vianmääritys, mittaukset ja kunnon arviointi

\- mekaaniset huolto- ja asennustyöt, kuten laakereiden ja tiivisteiden vaihdot

\- asiakaskohteissa tehtävät vianmääritys- ja kuntokartoituskäynnit

Työnhakijalta odotamme:

Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on sähköalan koulutus ja käytännön ymmärrys sähkömoottoreista sekä sähkö- ja mekaniikkatöistä. Sinulla voi olla esimerkiksi taustaa teollisuuden kunnossapidosta, sähköasennuksista, koneiden huollosta tai muista tehtävistä, joissa sähköinen ja mekaaninen osaaminen yhdistyvät.

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää erityisesti:

\- sähköalan koulutusta

\- ymmärrystä sähkömoottoreiden toiminnasta ja rakenteesta

\- sähköalan perusteiden ja sähkötöiden hallintaa

\- mekaanista asennusosaamista

\- kykyä tehdä vianmääritystä ja tulkita mittaustuloksia

\- käytännönläheistä ja itsenäistä työotetta

\- B-luokan ajokorttia

\- sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa

Tarjoamme sinulle:

Tarjoamme sinulle kokoaikaisen ja vakituisen työn vakavaraisessa yrityksessä. Sähkö-Teamilla on vuosikymmenten kokemus sähköalalta ja sähkökoneiden korjaamisesta, joten sinulla on mahdollisuus hyödyntää omaa ammattitaitoa monipuolisesti ja samalla oppia lisää sähkömoottoreista, sähkökoneista ja niiden korjaamisesta.

Palkkaus määräytyy osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan.

jobs.title: Student Assistant in our Control Center - night shift position
jobs.description:
Nordic RCC is looking for candidates with a technical background and interest in the role as operator in our control center – is this something for you?

Do you like working by firm and well-defined procedures, yet alert to interfere in the process when needed? Are you open-minded and enjoy working in a diverse and international team? And are you eager to be part of something new and meaningful?

The position will mainly cover the operator position during the shift from 21.00 PM- 07.15 AM during both weekdays, weekends and holiday periods. The shifts, of individually 10.25 hours length, are distributed throughout the operator team. The schedule is planned and updated 3 times a year, securing at least a planned period of 4 months into the future. You can expect an average of around 70-80 working hours per month.

You will be working alone in the office during the shifts, with an on-call colleague standby to assist in any technical matters if needed.

If you can say yes to the above, then you may be just the person we are looking for.

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system.

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green transition

Nordic RCC provides calculations and recommendations to the four Nordic Electricity Transmission System Operators (TSOs), Energinet, Fingrid, Statnett and Svenska Kraftnät. The main aim of the services is to ensure transparency and help the TSOs with operational planning to ensure continued security of supply with an increase of renewables in the system. In short: We play a small but important part of enabling the green transition.

You will join a team of young, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues of currently more than 20 nationalities, and at times work in virtual teams with expert colleagues from the Nordic TSOs and potentially from all of Europe.

We are not looking for a specific educational background, but an engineering or similar technical or data-scientific background is preferred.

Whether you are in your bachelor’s program, or master’s degree program, that is not critically important. What is more important is your profile as a whole and how you are assessed to fit within the Nordic RCC organization.   

Key responsibilities for the operator role will be:

  • Participating in the 24/7 control center shift roster: mainly covering the night hours 21.00 - 07.15.

  • The shift starts in the control center relieving a colleague operator from the evening shift. When time allows, and the processes for the evening have finalized successfully, you have an opportunity to enter an adjacent resting facility. During the shift, when alerted, your responsibility is to enter the control center within minutes, intervening in the operational challenge faced. Next morning at 07.00, the morning operator will relieve you from your shift responsibility.

  • Become an expert in executing the services provided from the 24/7 Nordic RCC control center.

  • Maintaining your qualifications and knowledge in the operator control systems, including through routinely joining parallel shift during office hours to train in all NRCC services under the guidance of operators.

  • Interface to the Nordic TSOs control centers.  

  • Cooperation with the TSOs securing the process of services.

  • Trouble shooting and fixing challenges in the services together with NRCC IT support.

  • KPI recording and reporting, weekly and monthly.

  • Aid the back-office operators in small tasks, such as visit approval to the core room.

Additional tasks and involvement

Depending on the flexibility and the competence of the candidate, together with the department needs, there will be an opportunity to be involved in other areas of responsibility. This way one will get a better understanding of the NRCC in general and meet fellow NRCC colleagues during normal business hours.

Other working areas, depending on department needs, can be:

  • Involvement in testing system updates and features to be introduced to the control center.

  • Quality assurance and updating operational procedures.

  • Quality assurance and data retrieval for operational reporting.

  • Provide analytical insights on operational planning scenarios.

You are open-minded, international mindset and excellence at working within structured patterns, at the same time the ability to maneuver within a huge spectrum of corner cases quickly, reliably, and independently.

You are structured and can appreciate a fast-paced environment from time to time. On a personal level you are open-minded, team-oriented and take responsibility.

Nordic RCC is an international office, so fluency in spoken and written English is required as well as a motivation for working in an international environment.

You will join a diverse and enthusiastic team in our office at Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. Nordic RCC is home to over twenty nationalities, with a healthy gender balance and a wide range of ages and backgrounds. We value curiosity, fellowship, respect, and transparency—and we hope you see yourself in these values. 

Your daily workplace will be in the NRCC control center at the office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad.

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) and no later than November 15th 2026.

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.  

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.   Nordic RCC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. 

If you have any questions, please contact Kenneth Nielsen, Head of Service Operations, KEN@nordic-rcc.net

Barfoed Group

Alle kolleger i Barfoed Group - uanset om vi arbejder i frontlinjen eller i baggrunden - har det fælles mål; ”at levere høj service til vores lejere”.

Barfoed Group er en af Danmarks største privatejede ejendomskoncerner. Vi har mere end 100 års erfaring i drift og udvikling af fast ejendom. Are you a MIG MAG welder in the Salo Region? You could be the right fit for the role!

Location: Salo Region, Finland
Employment Type: Fixed-term contract, a possibility of permanent employment
Salary: 14 - 18 € / hour

We are looking for a MIG/MAG Welder for our client company for a long-term position in the Salo region. Our client is a manufacturer specializing in steel structures, turning their customers' ideas into finished products – from design and production to assembly and delivery. In this role, you will work with bigger metal products in a modern industrial environment.

Your role

You will get to MIG MAG weld in project that consists of large metal components with material thicknesses ranging from 5 to 25 mm. The work is performed in a clean and safe production environment in a one-shift system, Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week. Flexibility to change to a two-shift system is required.

You will have access to high-quality tools and equipment and receive a thorough introduction to the company's products and working methods. If you are relocating from another area, we can assist with accommodation arrangements when needed.

As part of the recruitment process, candidates will complete a welding test at the client's premises.

What we expect from you

* Proven experience in MIG/MAG welding

* An unwavering commitment to attention to detail and quality

* Flexibility to work both morning and evening shifts

* English and/or Finnish language skill

* A valid work permit for Finland is a must

* Ability to read technical drawings

Considered an advantage

* Previous experience with welding heavy products and thick materials.

What we offer

* A stable, long-term position with a respected company in the metal industry

* Competitive hourly pay based on your experience and skills

* Salary and employment conditions based on the Finnish Technology Industry Collective Agreement

* Clean and safe working facilities with high-quality equipment

* Comprehensive onboarding and opportunities to further develop your skills

* Assistance with accommodation arrangements if needed

* Salary 14-18 € / hour depending on skills

About Wellpack

You will be employed by Wellpack, a personnel services company established in 2013. Wellpack is known as a trusted partner, particularly within the industrial and defence industry sectors. We connect skilled professionals with quality employers and contribute to building sustainable employment in Finland.

Apply now!

This is an ongoing recruitment process, and we fill positions as production grows and staffing needs arise. We review applications as they arrive and contact suitable candidates as positions become available.

Submit your application through the "Apply" link in the job advertisement. Your application will be stored in our recruitment system. In your application, be sure to tell about your previous work experience and skills.

For more information about the position, please contact Wellpack's recruitment team by email at wellpack@wellpack.fi [wellpack@wellpack.fi].

jobs.title: Two Design Managers, Deck Outfitting & Structure Teams, Marine
jobs.description:
Would you like to lead and develop a team of engineering professionals in a global engineering and consulting organization? Do you enjoy supporting people, driving team performance, and working closely with clients and internal stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions for the marine industry? If so, this could be your next career step.

Both roles can be based in our offices in Turku or Espoo. In your application, please indicate your preferred location and specify whether you are applying for the Deck Outfitting Design Manager or Structure Design Manager position.

Your role and the team

Join us as we are looking for two people-focused leaders to guide our Deck Outfitting and Structure teams to success. You'll be part of our growing international Marine business. Our professionals combine technical excellence, innovation, and collaboration to deliver sustainable and technologically advanced vessel solutions for clients around the world.

- The Deck Outfitting team consists of 14 professionals and has grown significantly in recent years. The team plays a key role in our basic engineering projects, delivering deck and mission outfitting solutions for demanding marine projects. In this role, you will provide technical guidance and support the team in identifying effective engineering solutions.
- The Structure team consists of 19 professionals and combines structural design expertise with advanced calculation capabilities, including FEM analysis and classification-related engineering. In addition to supporting the same vessel projects as the Deck Outfitting team, the team also carries out dedicated structural and calculation assignments. This role focuses on enabling experts to succeed through supportive leadership.

As a Design Manager, your primary responsibility is to lead and develop a team ranging from trainees and design engineers to senior consultants and discipline leads while ensuring effective resource allocation and successful project delivery. Your focus is on people leadership, competence development, and ensuring your team has the capabilities needed to deliver high-quality results. Rather than acting as a hands-on technical specialist, you will enable both your team and projects to succeed.

You will be responsible for team leadership, resource planning, competence development, and staffing decisions, while working closely with project managers, discipline leads, Sales, and other stakeholders to support successful project delivery and business growth.

What helps you succeed in these roles

- B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in a relevant field, preferably in engineering or technology.
- Previous experience in a leadership role within the marine industry or another engineering-driven environment.
- Experience in structural design, deck outfitting, or related marine engineering disciplines is considered a strong asset.
- Ability and motivation to lead, coach, and develop individuals and teams to achieve their full potential.
- Strong resource management, planning, and organizational skills, with the ability to make decisions, solve problems, and adapt to changing priorities.
- Understanding project delivery, stakeholder management, and multidisciplinary engineering environments.
- Fluent communication skills in English and preferably in Finnish.
- Willingness to travel occasionally and work in a global environment across different time zones.

What we promise you

Interesting and challenging projects with a supportive team, modern tools and technologies, and a flexible hybrid work model that helps you balance work and free time. We offer training, mentoring, and comprehensive learning and development opportunities to support your growth and help you shape your career. All this is backed by our warm EloWe culture, built on respect, equality, kindness, and support.

Learn more about us: [Visions of Tomorrow, Engineered Today - Elomatic](https://www.elomatic.com/)
Get to know your future colleagues: [Meet Us! videos](https://www.youtube.com/@ElomaticOy/shorts)

Please share your thoughts regarding salary expectations in your application. Our compensation aligns with trade union recommendations and reflects your future role, capabilities and skills, working experience and specialization. Additionally, we offer versatile employee benefits, including comprehensive insurance and support for sports and cultural activities.

We succeed together, we have passion to improve, we are trustworthy

If you share our values and are ready for this exciting opportunity, apply with your CV and cover letter in English or Finnish by October 20th at the latest. We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds and working styles, different perspectives make us stronger. We review applications continuously and are ready to start interviews during the application period.

For more information, feel free to contact us

Global Resource Manager: Tiina Kilpi, tiina.kilpi@elomatic.com

And remember to follow us on [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/elomaticoy/) and [LinkedIn!](https://www.linkedin.com/company/elomatic/)

_________________________________________________________________________________

With over 50 years of experience, we are known as pioneers in the development of design methods. Our 1,300 professionals provide exceptional value across the entire life cycles of products, services, and digital solutions.

What we do

Elomatic specializes in

- Marine

- Industry, covering process and energy industries, machinery, and equipment manufacturing.

We offer a comprehensive range of services, including engineering and consulting, project management, technical analysis and visualization, as well as product and service development. Additionally, we deliver products and overall solutions that complement our core services.
