Practical information:
Location: Romandie-Switzerland | Working model: Hybrid | Seniority: Senior | Language requirements: Very good written and spoken French and English

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Security Engineer with strong expertise in Microsoft Security, Identity and/or Compliance and AI-enabled Modern Workplace or Cloud Services. The successful candidate will design, implement and deliver enterprise-scale security transformations across Microsoft 365, Azure and Microsoft Security technologies, helping customers strengthen their security posture while enabling productivity and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Security & Identity

- Design and implement enterprise security architectures aligned with Zero Trust principles.
- Lead customer engagements around Identity & Access Management, Identity Governance and Privileged Access Management.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, Passwordless Authentication, Identity Governance, Access Reviews, Lifecycle Workflows and Privileged Identity Management.
- Support hybrid identity transformations involving Active Directory, Entra ID and federated identity providers.

Cloud Security

- Design and deploy security solutions across Azure and Microsoft cloud environments.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud capabilities, including workloads such as servers, storage, databases, containers and Kubernetes where relevant.
- Conduct cloud security posture reviews and support customers in improving governance, policy management and secure workload design.
- Threat Protection & SOC Modernization
- Design, implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud. Defender XDR solutions including Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365 and Defender for Cloud Apps.
- Implement and tune Microsoft Sentinel including data onboarding, detection engineering, analytics rules, automation and SOAR use cases.
- Contribute to threat hunting, incident response readiness and security operations process improvement.

Data Security & Compliance

- Design and deploy Microsoft Purview solutions for information protection, sensitivity labels, data classification, DLP, records management and data lifecycle management.
- Support customers in meeting compliance, governance and data protection objectives.
- Translate regulatory and business requirements into practical security and compliance controls.

AI & Security Innovation

- Lead customer discussions around secure AI adoption and responsible use of Microsoft Copilot and Security Copilot.
- Deliver readiness assessments and governance frameworks for Copilot-enabled environments.
- Define controls to protect sensitive data and identities in AI-enabled collaboration and cloud scenarios.

Professional Experience

- Years of experience in enterprise security consulting, engineering or architecture.
- Proven experience delivering Microsoft security, identity, and/or compliance or cloud security projects.
- Experience working directly with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders.
- Strong consulting mindset with the ability to translate business requirements into pragmatic security solutions.
- Structured, self-reliant, solution-oriented working style with strong customer and team orientation.

Preferred Certifications

- SC-100 – Cybersecurity Architect Expert
- SC-300 – Identity and Access Administrator
- SC-200 – Security Operations Analyst
- SC-400 – Information Protection Administrator
- AZ-500 – Azure Security Engineer
- MS-102 – Microsoft 365 Administrator
- Additional Microsoft Security, Azure, Purview, Sentinel, Copilot or Security Copilot etc. certifications are a plus

- Planlægning og organisering af indkøb og opbevaring

jobs.title: German speaking Google Ads Sales Executive (m/w/d), Barcelona Spain (Sales-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Join a dynamic team as a Google Ads Sales Executive, where you’ll drive growth for our valued clients. We’re seeking a resilient individual to focus on providing exceptional service-oriented Google Ads solutions to emerging businesses and established local enterprises. If you have a proven sales track record, excel at building relationships quickly, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

- Engage with regional clients, understanding their needs and providing tailored service solutions.
- Manage a high volume of accounts, focusing on delivering exceptional service and sales support.
- Drive revenue growth by effectively selling and convincing clients, using strong sales techniques.
- Work with performance targets and KPIs to consistently meet or exceed objectives.
- Quickly adapt to changing customer needs and business priorities.
- Cultivate relationships with clients, ensuring their satisfaction and fostering long-term loyalty.
- Provide excellent customer service, addressing inquiries, concerns, and providing timely resolutions.

Requirements

- C2 level of German and C1 level of English (both written and spoken).
- 2 years of proven sales experience, with the ability to win people over and convince clients rapidly.
- Proficient at creating digital marketing strategies for all customers sizes.
- Education: BA/BS degree required; Master’s degree or advanced professional certification is highly desirable.
- High-Impact Target Attainment: Extensive history of consistently achieving and surpassing challenging sales quotas. Must possess deep expertise in persuasive negotiation and a demonstrated capacity for driving significant individual revenue and market share gains in high-velocity sectors of different verticals. Proficient resilience and ability to handle a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
- Advanced Client Advocacy: Significant experience as a senior, customer-facing subject matter expert, specifically designing and implementing service protocols that resolve systemic client friction and substantially enhance customer retention and lifetime value.
- Operational Versatility: Exceptional ability to thrive through periods of ambiguity and rapid change, swiftly implementing process improvements and recalibrating priorities to ensure continuous business momentum.

Specialized Skills for the German Market:

- Deep German market and cultural understanding.
- Strategic thinking to target high-growth companies.
- Strong problem-solving, analytical, and relationship-building skills.
- Ability to unlock substantial expansion opportunities.
- German cultural awareness for building client trust.
- Stakeholder management, including skeptical clients and multiple agencies.
- Deep understanding of the German digital marketing ecosystem to position Google Ads effectively.
- Proficiency in managing sophisticated ROI and integration queries.
- Knowledge of local regulations, especially GDPR, to ensure compliance and tailor data-privacy-focused outreach strategies.

Desirable Skills

- Process Excellence: Systematically improving organizational processes to enhance efficiency, effectiveness, and quality
- Collaboration: Working effectively with others, sharing ideas and resources to achieve common goals
- Communication: Exchanging information, ideas, and messages between individuals or groups through various channels and mediums.
- Emotional Intelligence: Understanding and managing one’s own emotions and the emotions of others to foster positive relationships and enhance the impact of actions
- Open Mindedness: Considering and appreciating diverse perspectives and ideas, fostering collaboration
- Critical Thinking: Evaluating information and arguments, leading to informed and effective decisions based on data insights
- Solution Orientation: Approaching problems and challenges with a focus on finding practical and effective solutions
- Entrepreneurship: Having a mindset characterized by innovation, creativity, risk-taking, and a proactive approach to problem-solving and opportunity identification

Benefits

- Full-time (39 hours/week) hybrid position in Barcelona with a salary of 24.310,00 € gross/year + up to 4.290,00 € gross/year in bonus.
- Relocation Support
- Private Health Insurance.
- Continuous skill development and certifications.
- Clear career growth opportunities
- Engaging workplace with bi-weekly, monthly, or quarterly contests and dynamic business casual culture.
- Prime office location at the World Trade Center, Barcelona, surrounded by the sea.

jobs.description:
Willkommen im Team als

(Senior) Risk Manager*in

Das Unternehmen:

Die Commerz Real AG ist der Asset Manager der Commerzbank Gruppe und verfügt über 50 Jahre internationale Markterfahrung. Das Unternehmen vereint umfassendes Know-how im Asset Management mit breiter Strukturierungsexpertise und entwickelt daraus sachwertorientierte Fondsprodukte sowie maßgeschneiderte Investmentlösungen in den Bereichen Immobilien und Infrastruktur. Als Leasingdienstleister des Commerzbank-Konzerns bietet die Commerz Leasing zudem bedarfsgerechte Leasingkonzepte. Seit 2025 sind die Asset-Management-Beteiligungen der Commerzbank Gruppe bei der Commerz Real AG gebündelt. Neben den Marken und Produkten der Commerz Real zählen dazu die Aquila Capital Investmentgesellschaft mit Fokus auf nachhaltige Sachwertinvestments im Bereich Energieinfrastruktur sowie Yellowfin Asset Management als Boutique für liquide Investmentstrategien. Unter dem Dach der Commerz Real AG verwalten insgesamt rund 1.000 Mitarbeitende an rund 20 Standorten Vermögenswerte von rund 55 Milliarden Euro.

Die Commerz Real Fundmanagement S.à r.l. (“CRFM“) ist ein Spezialist für die Verwaltung von Alternativen Investmentfonds. Die CRFM trägt hierdurch zum Profil der Commerz Real AG und ihren Konzerngesellschaften (“Commerz Real Gruppe“) als integrierter Investmentdienstleister bei. Die CRFM arrangiert Alternative Investmentfonds, insbesondere für Immobilien, Infrastrukturprojekte, Anlagen zur Erzeugung erneuerbarer Energien sowie Großmobilien (wie z.B.: Flugzeuge, Schiffe und Schienenfahrzeuge). Die CRFM ist eine Tochtergesellschaft der Commerz Real AG, die ihrerseits eine Tochter der Commerzbank Aktiengesellschaft, Deutschland, ist.

Aufgabe:

- Als (Senior) Risk Manager Anlageprodukte und Teil des Risk Management Teams bist Du verantwortlich für die Risikoanalyse, Bewertung und Überwachung von (komplexen) Neu- und Bestandsgeschäften unter Beachtung von wirtschaftlichen, rechtlichen und steuerlichen Rahmenbedingungen hinsichtlich aller relevanten Risikoarten (u.a. Adressausfall-, Objektwertänderungs-, Marktpreis-, Liquiditätsrisiken, spezielle Risiken im Bereich Infrastructure wie z.B. Betriebs- und Projektentwicklungsrisiken, etc.)
- Dabei stellst Du die kompetenzgerechte Genehmigung bzw. Erstellung von Genehmigungsvorlagen für An- und Verkaufstransaktionen der AIF/Spezial-AIF sicher
- Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehört auch die Mitarbeit bei der Strukturierung und Steuerung von AIF/Spezial-AIF zur haftungsmäßigen und wirtschaftlichen Optimierung
- Ebenso verantwortest Du die regelmäßige risikotechnische Überwachung der AIF/Spezial-AIF im Wertschöpfungsprozess inkl. Überwachung der vertraglichen Finanzierungsgestaltung und des Liquiditätsmanagements
- Du unterstützt die Marktbereiche bei Vertragsverhandlungen im Neu- und Bestandsgeschäft sowie bei der Entwicklung von neuen Produkten als Mitglied in Dealteams und/oder Projektgruppen
- Die Leitung von bzw. Mitarbeit in bereichsinternen Projekten zur Optimierung / Digitalisierung der Risikoorganisation, hier insbesondere zur (Weiter-)Entwicklung von gesetzeskonformen Prozessen, Regularien und Risikotools gehört ebenfalls zu Deinen Aufgaben
- Du bringst Deine Expertise und Unterstützung bei übergreifenden Projekten sowie im Rahmen der Digitalisierungsstrategie ein. Dabei übernimmst Du auch die Leitung von übergreifenden Projekten
- Du übernimmst Coaching / Weiterbildungsaufgaben im Risikomanagement sowie die Ausbildung von Nachwuchskräften

Profil:

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes (auch berufsintegriertes) Studium mit der Fachrichtung Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder Rechtswissenschaften, idealerweise im Schwerpunkt Risikomanagement
- Langjährige fachbezogene Berufserfahrung im Bereich Risikomanagement eines Asset-Managers, eines Fondsemissionshauses oder eines Kreditinstitutes,
- Umfassende Kenntnisse und mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Assetklasse Infrastructure, idealerweise auch in Private Equity und Debt Strukturen. Grundkenntnisse und Interesse an den Assetklassen Renewable Energies, sowie Real Estate runden Deine Erfahrung ab.
- Erweiterte betriebswirtschaftliche Kenntnisse insbesondere im Bereich Risikomanagement, Bilanzanalyse, Discounted Cash-Flow-Analyse, Sensitivitätsanalyse, Cash-Flow-Modellierung, Liquiditätsrisikomanagement und Portfoliosteuerung
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse der einschlägigen Gesetze, Verordnungen, Vorschriften und Richtlinien (AIFM-Richtlinie, AIFM-VO, ESMA-Leitlinien, Luxemburger Gesetze bzgl. AIFMD, u.a.)
- Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und sehr sicherer Umgang mit MS Office
- Gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, idealerweise auch gute Französischkenntnisse
- Ausgeprägte Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit
- Hohes Maß an Zielstrebigkeit und Eigeninitiative sowie unternehmerisches Denken und Flexibilität

jobs.title: Ingenieur (m/w/d) für Typgenehmigung und Qualität - Werden Sie Spezialist für Minibusse (Ingenieur/in - Fahrzeugtechnik)
jobs.description:
Ingenieur (m/w/d) für Typgenehmigung und Qualität

- Werden Sie Spezialist für Minibusse

Möchten Sie dazu beitragen, dass unsere Minibusse alle Anforderungen der EU-Vorschriften erfüllen und ordnungsgemäß genehmigt und dokumentiert sind? Haben Sie ein abgeschlossenes Ingenieurstudium und Interesse daran, sich von Grund auf in die Themen Homologation und Typgenehmigung einzuarbeiten? Dann könnten Sie genau die richtige Person für uns sein!

Über die VBI Group

Die VBI Group ist ein familiengeführtes Unternehmen, das 1980 gegründet wurde. Wir kaufen und verkaufen neue und gebrauchte Busse. Mit Standorten in Christiansfeld und Kliplev in Dänemark sowie in Nekla in Polen liefern wir jährlich mehrere Hundert Busse an Kunden in ganz Europa.

Am Standort Kliplev, der Ihr primärer Arbeitsort sein wird, bauen wir Basisfahrzeuge wie den Mercedes-Benz Sprinter, den Iveco Daily und den MAN TGE zu fertigen Minibussen der Fahrzeugklassen M1, M2 und M3 um – darunter auch rollstuhlgerechte Fahrzeuge.

Wir sind ein wachsendes Unternehmen mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einer offenen, unkomplizierten Unternehmenskultur.

Ihre Aufgaben

Als Ingenieur (m/w/d) für Typgenehmigung und Qualität übernehmen Sie eine zentrale Rolle in den Bereichen Typgenehmigung, technische Dokumentation und Qualitätssicherung.

Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören unter anderem:

- Verantwortung für EU-Gesamtfahrzeug-Typgenehmigungen (WVTA) gemäß Verordnung (EU) 2018/858 als Hersteller in der zweiten Fertigungsstufe.
- Bearbeitung neuer Typgenehmigungen, Erweiterungen bestehender Genehmigungen und der dazugehörigen Beschreibungsunterlagen.
- Anlage und Registrierung von Fahrzeugen in den Systemen der dänischen Fahrzeugbehörden sowie Bearbeitung von Einzelgenehmigungen.
- Erstellung und Prüfung von CoC-Dokumenten (Certificate of Conformity).
- Prüfung von Teilgenehmigungen für Komponenten wie Sitze, Sicherheitsgurte, Verglasung, Beleuchtung und Rampen.
- Verantwortung für die Produktionskonformität (CoP – Conformity of Production).
- Teilnahme an Audits mit Behörden und technischen Diensten wie IDIADA und TÜV.
- Pflege und Weiterentwicklung unseres Qualitätsmanagementsystems (QMS) sowie unseres Cybersicherheitsmanagementsystems (CSMS) gemäß UN-Regelung Nr. 155.
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Produktion, dem Vertrieb und unserem Werk in Polen.

Das bringen Sie mit

- Ein abgeschlossenes Ingenieurstudium, beispielsweise im Maschinenbau oder in der Produktionstechnik, oder eine vergleichbare technische Qualifikation.
- Eine strukturierte, sorgfältige und analytische Arbeitsweise.
- Interesse daran, sich in technische Vorschriften, Normen und Dokumentationsanforderungen einzuarbeiten.
- Die Fähigkeit, selbstständig zu arbeiten und gleichzeitig konstruktiv mit verschiedenen Abteilungen zusammenzuarbeiten.
- Gute mündliche und schriftliche Kenntnisse in Dänisch, Englisch und Deutsch.

Erfahrung im Fahrzeugbereich, mit Typgenehmigungen, Fahrzeugprüfungen oder Qualitätsmanagement ist von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung. Entscheidend sind Ihr technisches Verständnis und Ihre Motivation, sich in ein spezialisiertes Fachgebiet einzuarbeiten.

Sie erhalten die Möglichkeit, Ihren eigenen Verantwortungsbereich aktiv mitzugestalten und fachlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Sie kommen aus Norddeutschland? Dann müssen Sie nicht unbedingt bereits Dänisch sprechen. Wenn Sie Deutsch und Englisch beherrschen und bereit sind, Dänisch zu lernen, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

Das bieten wir Ihnen

- Eine umfassende Einarbeitung in die Bereiche Homologation und Typgenehmigung.
- Eine solide Grundlage mit bestehenden Genehmigungen, technischer Dokumentation und etablierten Verfahren.
- Eine eigenverantwortliche Schlüsselposition mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum und direkter Berichtslinie zur Geschäftsleitung.
- Eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Produktion und unserem Werk in Polen.
- Ein offenes und hilfsbereites Arbeitsumfeld in einem wachsenden Familienunternehmen.
- Eine leistungsgerechte Vergütung sowie eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge.

Die Stelle auf einen Blick

Arbeitsort: Kliplev bei Aabenraa, Dänemark
Anstellung: Vollzeit
Eintritt: Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt

Wir führen Bewerbungsgespräche fortlaufend. Daher freuen wir uns, wenn Sie uns Ihre Bewerbung so bald wie möglich zusenden.

Bewerbung und Kontakt

dbp@busimport.dk

Bei Fragen zur Stelle können Sie sich gerne direkt an unseren CEO Dan B. Pedersen wenden:

Telefon: +45 40 35 62 52

Wir freuen uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen!

Ingeniør til homologering og kvalitet** **

– bliv specialist i minibusser

Vil du være med til at sikre, at vores minibusser er korrekt godkendt og dokumenteret efter EU's regler? Har du en ingeniøruddannelse og lyst til at lære homologering og typegodkendelse fra bunden? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Om VBI Group

VBI Group er en familieejet virksomhed, grundlagt i 1980. Vi køber og sælger nye og brugte busser. Vi har afdeling i Christiansfeld, Kliplev og i Nekla, Polen og leverer flere hundrede busser om året til kunder i hele Europa.

I Kliplev-afdelingen, der vil være dit primære arbejdssted, opbygger vi basiskøretøjer som Mercedes Sprinter, Iveco Daily og MAN TGE til færdige minibusser i klasse M1, M2 og M3 – herunder også kørestolsbusser.

Vi er en virksomhed i vækst.  Beslutningsvejene er korte og omgangstonen uformel.

Jobbet

Som homologerings- og kvalitetsingeniør får du en central rolle i arbejdet med typegodkendelse, dokumentation og kvalitet.

Dine primære opgaver bliver bl.a.:

- Ansvar for EU-helbilsgodkendelser (WVTA) efter forordning (EU) 2018/858 som 2.-trinsproducent.
- Håndtering af nye godkendelser, udvidelser og informationsdokumenter.
- Oprettelse af køretøjer i NIV/Færdselsstyrelsens systemer samt enkeltgodkendelser.
- Udarbejdelse og kontrol af CoC-dokumenter.
- Kontrol af delgodkendelser på komponenter som sæder, seler, ruder, belysning og ramper.
- Ansvar for CoP-kontroller (Conformity of Production).
- Deltagelse i audits med myndigheder og tekniske tjenester som IDIADA og TÜV.
- Vedligeholdelse af vores kvalitetssystem (QMS) og cybersikkerhedssystem (CSMS/UN R155).
- Tæt samarbejde med produktion, salg og vores fabrik i Polen.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

- Har en ingeniøruddannelse, fx som maskin- eller produktionsingeniør, eller en tilsvarende teknisk baggrund.
- Arbejder struktureret, grundigt og analytisk.
- Har lyst til at sætte dig ind i tekniske regler, standarder og dokumentation.
- Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig samarbejde på tværs af organisationen.
- Taler og skriver både dansk, engelsk og tysk.

Erfaring med køretøjer, typegodkendelse, syn eller kvalitetsstyring er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du har en god teknisk forståelse og lyst til at lære et specialiseret område. Du vil få gode muligheder for at præge og udvikle dit eget arbejdsområde.

Kommer du fra Nordtyskland, behøver du ikke kunne dansk fra start, hvis bare du taler tysk /engelsk og har lyst til at lære dansk.

Vi tilbyder

- Grundig oplæring i homologering og typegodkendelse.
- Et solidt udgangspunkt med eksisterende godkendelser, dokumentation og procedurer.
- En selvstændig nøglerolle med stor indflydelse og direkte reference til ledelsen.
- Tæt samarbejde med både produktion og vores fabrik i Polen.
- En uformel og hjælpsom omgangstone i en familieejet virksomhed i vækst.
- Løn efter kvalifikationer samt pension.

jobs.title: Senior SAP PSCD Consultant (m/f/d) (IT-Berater/in)
jobs.description:
Senior SAP PSCD Consultant (m/f/d)

- Remote, GermanyEmployees can work remotely
- Full-time
- Service Region: Germany,France,Switzerland

Company Description

English

We are Nagarro – a global SAP Business Unit with a strong focus on digital transformation. We design and implement innovative IT solutions that drive businesses forward across industries. With more than 1,200 SAP experts in Germany and 18,000 colleagues worldwide, we offer a dynamic, open, and team-oriented work environment.

We advise our clients on IT strategies, implement and operate SAP systems, and develop tailored solutions for SAP ERP and SAP S/4HANA. Our expertise spans retail, manufacturing, process industries, professional services, and the public sector. We work in on-premise, cloud, and hybrid environments and develop in-house products to increase efficiency.

Deutsch
Wir sind Nagarro – eine globale SAP Business Unit mit starkem Fokus auf digitale Transformation. Wir gestalten und implementieren innovative IT-Lösungen, die Unternehmen branchenübergreifend voranbringen. Mit mehr als 1.200 SAP Expert:innen in Deutschland und 18.000 Kolleg:innen weltweit bieten wir ein dynamisches, offenes und teamorientiertes Arbeitsumfeld.

Wir beraten unsere Kunden zu IT Strategien, implementieren und betreiben SAP Systeme und entwickeln maßgeschneiderte Lösungen für SAP ERP und SAP S/4HANA. Unsere Expertise reicht von Handel über Fertigung und Prozessindustrie bis zu Professional Services und dem öffentlichen Sektor. Wir arbeiten in On-Prem-, Cloud- und Hybrid-Umgebungen und entwickeln eigene Produkte zur Effizienzsteigerung.

Job Description

English

As an SAP PSCD Consultant, you will:

- Take responsibility for customer projects in SAP Public Sector Management (PSM) and support the PSCD module.
- Lead or assist in all project phases: conception, design, customizing, prototyping, and roll-out of SAP ERP and SAP S/4HANA solutions.
- Analyze, optimize, and improve processes in public sector finance.
- Ensure functional and technical feasibility of SAP solutions.
- Collaborate closely with clients and internal teams to deliver high-quality SAP services.
- Contribute to knowledge transfer and best practices within the SAP team.

Deutsch

Als SAP PSCD Consultant übernimmst du:

- Verantwortung für Kundenprojekte im SAP Public Sector Management (PSM) und Unterstützung des PSCD-Moduls.
- Betreuung aller Projektphasen: Konzeption, Design, Customizing, Prototyping und Roll-out von SAP ERP- und SAP S/4HANA-Lösungen.
- Analyse, Optimierung und Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen im Public Sector Finance.
- Sicherstellung der fachlichen und technischen Umsetzbarkeit von SAP-Lösungen.
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden und internen Teams, um hochwertige SAP-Services bereitzustellen.
- Mitwirkung beim Wissensaustausch und der Weitergabe von Best Practices innerhalb des SAP-Teams.

Qualifications

English

- Completed degree in Business Administration, Business Informatics, or equivalent qualification with relevant professional experience
- Proven experience in SAP consulting, ideally in SAP PSM and PSCD modules
- Solid knowledge of Public Sector Management (PSM) processes and SAP PSCD
- Experience in SAP ERP and SAP S/4HANA projects, including conception, design, customizing, prototyping, and roll-out
- Knowledge of SAP FI and SAP S/4HANA Finance is a plus
- Fluent German (C1) and good English skills
- Flexible and willing to travel (20% up to 40%)

jobs.title: Fahrer (m/w/divers) für Showtruck gesucht (Berufskraftfahrer/in)
jobs.description:
.....gesucht wird ein "bewirtender" Berufskraftfahrer oder "kundenorientierter" Gastronom mit Lkw-Führerschein.....

Wir suchen einen zuverlässigen und erfahrenen Lkw-Fahrer mit Führerschein C/CE für unseren Showtruck, der sich um die sichere und effiziente Beförderung unserer Gastronomie-Einrichtung kümmert und nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs ist, insbesondere in Italien und Frankreich.

Als Lkw-Fahrer werden Sie für die Bedienung und Wartung des Fahrzeugs verantwortlich sein und sicherstellen, dass alle Aufgaben im Zusammenhang mit dem Auf- und Abbau der Gastronomie-Einrichtung reibungslos durchgeführt werden. Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören die Fahrt zu den Veranstaltungsorten, der Auf- und Abbau der Einrichtung, der Ausschank und die Betreuung der Gäste. Wir suchen einen Kandidaten mit ausgeprägten Fahrkenntnissen, excellenten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und einer tiefen Erfahrung im Umgang mit Lkw und Gastronomie-Einrichtungen.

Die Stelle erfordert eine hohe Flexibilität und die Bereitschaft, nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs zu sein. Wenn Sie eine Herausforderung suchen und sich für eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit begeistern, dann sind Sie bei uns richtig.

Zum Aufgabengebiet gehören voraussichtlich aber nicht ausschließlich:

- Mitreisetätigkeit an 6-10 Monaten am Stück im Jahr, ausdehnbar auf 12 Monate im Jahr, wenn erste Teilsaison stimmt
- Erfahrung im Betrieb/Mitreisen bei Schaustellerbetrieben, Eventbereich
- leichter Auf- und Abbau von Gerätschaften während der Tour
- Eventunterstützung von Organisation vor Ort
- Terminplanung Tour
- Ausschankbetrieb
- Führerschein Klasse CE

Persönliche Voraussetzungen:

- Unabhängigkeit
- Altersvorgabe 30-58
- technisches Verständnis Light&Sound und LKW-Technik
- englisch fließend, jede weitere Fremdsprache ist willkommen
- Persönlichkeit: präsent, kommunikativ, selbstbewusst

Společnost Weekamp Doors hledá do svého kolektivu nové kolegy na různé pozice ve výrobě.
Jsme mezinárodní společnost s více než 22 – letou tradicí vyrábějící dřevěné dveře a okna určené pro evropský trh. Řadíme se mezi přední zaměstnavatele Valašskoklobucka a Hornolidečska. Právě u nás získáte stabilní zaměstnání, nadstandartní benefity a práci s tak krásným materiálem jako je dřevo.
Pokud nemáte žádné zkušenosti či vzdělání v oboru, vůbec to nevadí. Naučíme Vás vše potřebné! Nemusíte se tak ničeho bát.

Nabízíme:
Práci ve 2-směnném provozu
Perspektivní a stabilní práci u zahraniční firmy
Odpovídající mzdové podmínky, možnost kariérního růstu

Benefity:
13. mzda
PLNĚ HRAZENÉ STRAVNÉ (závodní jídelna / stravenky)
BONUS 2 000 Kč každý měsíc
Příplatek za práci přesčas 50 %
Zvýhodněné mobilní tarify pro Vás i Vaši rodinu
Právní poradenství
Akce, večírky
Firemní oblečení, obuv

Na našich zaměstnancích nám záleží. Budujeme firemní kulturu založenou na hodnotách, které jsme si jako společnost nastolili, podporujeme vzdělávání zaměstnanců jak v rámci interních školení, tak externími lektory z dotačního vzdělávání. Zjišťujeme potřeby našich zaměstnanců a dáváme jim zpětnou vazbu ohledně možných řešení. Snažíme se být víc než poskytovatel financí.

Líbí se Vám, jakým způsobem uvažujeme? Chcete toho být součástí?
Neváhejte, zavolejte nebo napište a domluvte si osobní pohovor, prohlédněte si výrobu a přesvědčte se, že práce u nás má smysl!

jobs.description:
KO: Šajerová Hana, tel.: 553 760 820 - volat PO-PÁ od 8:00 do 15:30 hod., e-mail: kariera@hagemann.cz

Máte silný smysl pro detail, chuť udržovat pořádek, pečlivost a spolehlivost?
Pak bychom Vám rádi nabídli práci uklízečky. Tato práce zahrnuje běžný úklid, tj. zametání, vytírání podlah, utírání prachu, čištění nábytku a zařízení, vysávání koberců a vynášení odpadků. Dále provádění čištění a dezinfekci toalet, umyvadel, pisoárů a záchodů, a to denně nebo podle stanovených hygienických norem. Součástí práce je i čištění oken, zrcadel, přepážek a světelných a tepelných zdrojů, mechanické mytí a leštění podlah, případně obsluha úklidových strojů. Kromě toho je součásti této práce výpomoc při výdeji obědů v závodní jídelně, úklid kuchyně, jídelny, příprava varnic a mytí nádobí.
Motivace pro tuto práci často pramení z radosti z viditelných výsledků dobře odvedené práce a z pocitu, že přispíváte k příjemnému prostředí pro ostatní.

Zaměstnanecké výhody:
- Příspěvek na stravování v závodní jídelně.
- Odměna k životním událostem jako je svatba, narození dítěte nebo jubileum.
- Výhodné tarify u operátora O2.
- Zaměstnanecké slevy na autoservis, pořízení vozu i stavebního materiálu.
- Až šest týdnu volna
- Pouze ranní směny
- Parkování v areálu firmy

Pozice kalibračního technika u nás obnáší obsluhu kalibrační linky a ověřování správnosti měření elektroměrů a dalších produktů.
Počítejte také s přesahem do logistiky, konkrétně s tvorbou a plánováním objednávek pro výrobu.
Pozice je jak dělaná pro absolventa střední průmyslové školy elektrotechnické (nebo jiné s podobným zaměřením).
Bude skvělé, když nastoupíte co nejdříve, ale rádi si na vás počkáme.
V místě pracoviště máme k dispozici venkovní parkovací místa, jezdí k nám i autobus (MHD/PID).
Jaké znalosti a dovednosti byste měli mít
S kalibrační linkou vás naučíme, ale potřebujete mít alespoň základy elektrotechniky a elektroniky, tedy vzdělání ze střední průmyslové školy elektrotechnické (nebo podobně zaměřené).
Bude se vám hodit i anglický jazyk v písemné formě, tady také stačí základy (například pro porozumění datovému listu součástky).
Co vám nabízíme
I když rosteme, udržujeme rodinný charakter firmy bez zbytečných korporátních pravidel, a s nadstandardní úrovní firemních benefitů. Budete pracovat ve zcela nových prostorech v Jinočanech v Logport Prague West. Tahle pozice časem navíc slibuje kariérní posun ve smyslu vedení týmu a pracovní poměr na dobu neurčitou.

jobs.title: Kvalitář - kvalitářka ve výrobě, Technici v chemickém inženýrství a příbuzných oborech
jobs.description:
V Adventure Menu už 16 let pomáháme lidem užívat si cesty, dobrodružství i náročné situace s chutí. Vyrábíme plnohodnotná jídla z přírodních surovin, která připravujeme tradičními postupy a uchováváme pomocí moderních technologií. Díky tomu mají naše jídla dlouhou trvanlivost až 15 let, a přitom neobsahují chemické konzervanty ani jiné zbytečné přísady. Naše produkty slouží jak milovníkům outdooru, tak profesionálům v oblasti krizové připravenosti a taktického použití.

Máš zkušenosti s řízením kvality a chceš se podílet na výrobě prémiových potravin, za kterými stojí smysluplný příběh? Hledáš práci, která ti nabídne volné víkendy, jednosměnný provoz s ranní pracovní dobou a fajn kolegy, které jejich práce baví?

U nás najdeš moderní výrobní prostředí, přátelský tým a prostor aktivně ovlivňovat kvalitu našich produktů. Pokud hledáš práci, která dává smysl, a chceš se stát součástí Adventure Menu, ozvi se nám. Rádi tě poznáme!

Co bude tvým úkolem?
• odpovídá za úplnost, platnost, dostupnost a dohledatelnost dokumentace systému kvality a bezpečnosti potravin
• schvalování nebo zajišťování schválení kvalitativních dokumentů a záznamů podle kompetenční matice a pravidel řízené dokumentace
• zajišťování přípravy, průběhu a uzavírání interních, zákaznických, HACCP,IFS Food auditů včetně nápravných opatření
• zajišťování archivace záznamů po dobu stanovenou právními, certifikačními, zákaznickými a interními požadavky
• chránit důvěrné, osobní, zákaznické, výrobkové a auditní údaje a poskytovat je pouze oprávněným osobám
• zodpovědnost za dodržování bezpečnostních a hygienických norem
• vytváření směrnic, návodů a pravidel včetně jejich následného uvádění do praxe a jejich aktualizace
• spolupráce na implementaci certifikace IFS a následné uvedení do praxe
• zodpovědnost za nejvyšší standardy kvality během výroby
• všeobecný přehled a vyhodnocování kvality výroby

Co od tebe očekáváme?
• středoškolské vzdělání + min. 2 roky praxe na obdobné pozici (v potravinářství výhodou, nikoliv podmínkou)
• praxi v oblasti řízení kvality ve výrobní společnosti; zkušenost s vedením týmu a zákaznickými audity
• praktickou znalost HACCP a IFS a zákaznickými standardy
• silné organizační, komunikační a analytické schopnosti
• orientaci na výsledky a schopnost řešit problémy
• pokročilou práci s MS Office, elektronickou dokumentací a podnikovými systémy
• profesionální přístup, samostatnost, spolehlivost, odbornou integritu, rozhodnost, systematičnost, schopnost vést lidi, odolnost, nestrannost a schopnost srozumitelně prosadit požadavky i v náročné situaci
• flexibilitu, loajálnost a stanovování priorit
• pečlivost a smysl pro pořádek

Výhodou bude, pokud budeš mít:
• znalost standardu IFS Food
• orientaci v potravinovém právu, značení potravin, alergenech, specifikacích, sledovatelnosti, stahování výrobků z trhu a požadavcích na bezpečnost potravin
• zkušenosti s analýzou rizik a kořenových příčin, interními audity, CAPA, analýzou trendů, řízením změn a prací s laboratorními výsledky a specifikacemi
• komunikativní znalost angličtiny

Co nabízíme:
• stabilní zaměstnání v progresivně rostoucí firmě od r. 2013
• možnost aktivně ovlivnit budoucnost a rozvoj firmy
• možnost profesního růstu
• atraktivní mzdové ohodnocení a benefity
• jednosměnný provoz – ranní
• volné víkendy a svátky
• práce v Trutnově a výhledově také v Dolní Kalné
• velký důraz na skvělou firem

jobs.title: Division Controller & Commercial Manager High Speed (m/f/d) (80-100%)
jobs.description:
Accelleron is accelerating sustainability in the marine and energy industries as a global technology leader in turbocharging, fuel injection, and digital solutions for heavy-duty applications. Building on a heritage of over 100 years as a trusted industry partner, the company serves customers in more than 100 locations in over 50 countries. Accelleron’s 3,000 employees are continuously innovating to deliver best-in-class products, services, and solutions that are mission-critical for the energy transition. You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting-edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions. At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength.

In this role, you will serve as a strategic Finance Business Partner for the High Speed Division, supporting the Division President and Leadership Team in driving profitable growth, operational excellence, and strategic decision-making across a global business. Working closely with stakeholders across Sales, Operations, and Technical Development in Europe, the US, and China, you will ensure financial transparency, performance management, and value creation while translating business insights into impactful actions. Reporting directly to the Chief Financial Officer (CFO), you will lead planning, forecasting, reporting, and business performance processes, while actively contributing to the division's strategic development and future growth.

Your responsibilities:


Support the definition and execution of the High Speed strategy, ensuring alignment between strategic priorities and financial targets.
Own the strategic five-year planning, budgeting and forecasting processes for the High Speed Division globally.
Own monthly, quarterly and annual financial closing and reporting, ensuring compliance with internal and external requirements.
Lead the monthly financial performance review with the Division President, providing transparency on key P&L and operational performance drivers.
Ensure transparency on customer, product and lifecycle profitability and provide actionable insights to improve financial performance.
Drive cost and working capital performance across the Division and initiate corrective actions where required.
Act as financial business partner for strategic initiatives, investments and major development projects, including active participation in business cases, design reviews and steering committees.
Partner with Sales on commercial and financial risk management, including risk reviews, insurance claims and escalation mechanisms.
Ensure effective financial governance and internal controls, including implementation and adherence to the Table of Authority.
Drive continuous innovation and improvement, simplification and standardization of financial processes and reporting.
Actively contribute to the strategic development of the High Speed division as member of the Division’s Leadership Team
Contribute to cross-divisional and Group Finance initiatives, supporting the development of the global Finance function.

Your background:


Strong financial background with expertise in controlling, planning and internal controls
Results-oriented finance leader with strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Strong business partnering and communication skills, with the ability to challenge and influence and implement solutions across the organization
Strong cross-cultural collaboration skills in a global organization
Ability to translate financial and operational insights into actions
10+ years of relevant experience, complemented by strong digital & financial tool capabilities
Digital mindset with proof record on digital innovations

Your benefits:


Attractive compensation & benefits
Employee Assistance Program Global
Parental Leave Program



We look forward to receiving your application. If you want to discover more about Accelleron, take another look at our website accelleron.com.

jobs.title: VI SØGER UGC CONTENT CREATORS TIL GODBILPLEJE.DK ✨
jobs.description:
VI SØGER UGC CONTENT CREATORS TIL GODBILPLEJE.DK ✨

Er du kreativ med et kamera, god til at lave videoer og elsker at skabe content, der fanger opmærksomheden? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!

Hos GodBilpleje.dk søger vi dygtige og kreative content creators, der kan komme ud til os og producere professionelle, engagerende UGC-videoer til vores sociale medier.

Hvad skal du lave?

  • Filme fede før- og eftervideoer af vores bilplejebehandlinger.

  • Præsentere og fortælle om de forskellige ydelser, vi tilbyder.

  • Lave autentiske UGC-videoer, hvor du gerne selv må være foran kameraet.

  • Skabe kreative videoer til TikTok, Instagram Reels og Facebook.

  • Fange de små detaljer og de imponerende resultater, der får folk til at stoppe med at scrolle.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har erfaring med at producere og redigere videoer.

  • Har dit eget kamera, mikrofon og øvrigt nødvendigt udstyr.

  • Kan stå for hele processen fra idé til færdig video.

  • Er kreativ, selvstændig og har øje for detaljer.

  • Forstår, hvordan man laver content, der skaber visninger, engagement og kunder.

  • Kan komme fysisk ud til os og filme.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

  • Betalt samarbejde efter aftale.

  • Mulighed for et fast og længerevarende samarbejde.

  • Frihed til at komme med kreative idéer.

  • Masser af spændende bilplejeprojekter med flotte resultater, der er perfekte til video.

INTERESSERET?

Send os en kort besked med:

  • Lidt om dig selv.

  • Eksempler på videoer, du tidligere har lavet.

  • Dine priser for produktion af UGC-videoer.

Vi søger både freelancere og content creators, der har lyst til et fast samarbejde.

jobs.title: Senior / Staff Security Engineer
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 30,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

At Linear, we are committed to quality. Security is an essential part of that quality — not a layer that we add later, but something we build in from the start. We have a foundational security program we're proud of but, as Linear evolves our product and scales into enterprise, there's meaningful work ahead: staying ahead of vulnerabilities as our attack surface grows, responding fast and cleanly when incidents happen, and hardening our product and infrastructure. As Security Engineer at Linear, you'll be operating in a high-autonomy role with real scope, doing hands-on security work across the product and infrastructure we build.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company. This role is open to candidates based in North America. You can work from anywhere within this region. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you’ll do

Depending on your experience / skillset and our broader priorities, you could:

 - Operate, automate, and extend vulnerability management end-to-end: triage, prioritize, and drive remediation across product, infrastructure, and dependencies, and keep the program’s SLAs meaningful rather than theoretical

 - Run our bug bounty program: triage incoming reports, validate severity, work with engineering on fixes, and keep researcher relationships professional and responsive

 - Lead product security testing: threat model new features (including AI/agent-facing surfaces), review designs and code for security-relevant risk, and do hands-on testing (manual and tool-assisted) rather than relying solely on scanners

 - Be a primary responder for security incidents: lead investigation and containment, drive postmortems, and turn lessons into concrete hardening work

 - Own meaningful chunks of our cloud/infra security posture on GCP/k8s/Postgres: harden configurations, close gaps surfaced by audits or scanning, and partner with infra engineering on secure defaults

 - Build and maintain security tooling and automation, including using AI/LLM tooling to speed up triage, code review, and repetitive investigation work, so the program scales without linear headcount growth

 - Partner with the GRC/Trust function: feed real findings into the risk register and control evidence, and help make sure compliance requirements reflect actual engineering practice

What we’re looking for

 - A generalist, senior-level security engineer (5+ years across security engineering, with real depth in at least two of: vulnerability management, product/appsec testing, incident response, and cloud security). We need breadth, rather than a narrow specialist in any one of these.

 - Hands-on and technical: you can read and reason about code (we use a lot of TypeScript), you’re comfortable in cloud environments (GCP a plus), and you can go deep on a finding rather than just filing a ticket for someone else to fix. You’re comfortable using AI coding/security tools as force multipliers (Linear Agent, Claude, Codex, etc).

 - Calm under pressure: you can lead an incident from first alert through postmortem without needing to be told what to do next

 - A builder: you’d rather write a script or ship a tool than repeat a manual process a third time

 - A pragmatic risk-reducer: you optimize for actually reducing risk, not for checking a box or maximizing findings count

 - Autonomy-oriented: comfortable setting your own priorities, working with significant independence, and knowing when to escalate

 - A clear communicator: able to explain a technical finding to a non-technical stakeholder and write it up so it’s actually actionable

Our tech

This is a hands-on security engineering role. You'll be running tools, reading/writing code, building detections, working in our cloud environment, and partnering closely with the engineers who build our product. Our stack is fronted by Cloudflare and runs on Google Cloud with k8s, Postgres, and Node.

For day-to-day work, we use:

 - Linear, GitHub, Slack, and Google Workspace for collaboration

 - Claude and ChatGPT for general & engineering-specific AI tasks

 - Vanta for compliance automation and evidence collection

Our security-specific tooling includes:

 - GitHub Advanced Security

 - RunReveal

 - SentinelOne

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Learn how we think and work

 - Read Me https://linear.app/readme a story about our mission

 - Our hiring process: How we hire at Linear https://linear.app/now/how-we-hire-at-linear

 - How we work: Designing remote work at Linear https://linear.app/now/designing-remote-work-at-linear

jobs.title: Field Service Specialist
jobs.description:
Location: Europe – preferably Poland, Czech Republic or Romania.

DTE is a fast-growing deep-tech company transforming how the metals industry controls and optimises its production. Our real-time melt chemistry technology gives aluminium producers immediate insight into their process, unlocking operational efficiency, higher yields and more sustainable production.

As DTE expands its international operations, we are looking for a Field Service Specialist based in Europe to support future customer deployments and help establish our field service capabilities in the region.

This is an opportunity to join a growing international team, work hands-on with innovative industrial technology and play an important role in building DTE's presence in the European market.

Position Summary

The Field Service Specialist will be part of DTE's Service, Production and Delivery team, supporting the installation, commissioning, maintenance and troubleshooting of DTE's industrial analytical equipment as new customer deployments are established.

You will work closely with customers during installation, start-up and service visits, configuring equipment to meet operational requirements, training operators and providing remote and on-site technical support.

The role also involves close collaboration with DTE's Engineering and Service teams in Iceland and internationally, contributing practical field experience to product improvements and the development of service procedures.

We are looking for someone who enjoys working directly with customers, understands demanding industrial environments and takes ownership of solving technical challenges.

This is a hands-on technical role in demanding industrial environments involving heat, noise, dust and heavy machinery, requiring a strong commitment to safety, quality and reliable operation.

Key Responsibilities

Install, commission and service DTE's analytical equipment at customer sites as new deployments are established.
Ensure installations and service work meet DTE's standards for quality, safety and reliability.
Configure equipment, perform functional testing and train customer operators.
Troubleshoot, maintain and repair equipment, providing both remote and on-site technical support.
Assess customer site readiness ahead of installation, including power, utilities, access, lifting arrangements and safety requirements.
Participate in an on-call rota for technical support as required.
Collaborate with DTE's Engineering and Service teams to identify technical issues, implement improvements and support product development.
Contribute to the development of service procedures, checklists, spare parts lists and troubleshooting documentation.
Help establish and develop DTE's field service capabilities in Europe as the company expands into the region.

Qualifications, Knowledge & Experience

At least 3 years of experience in field service, equipment assembly or technical support involving electronic or industrial equipment.
A degree or vocational qualification in engineering, electronics, electrical technology or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience.
Experience troubleshooting automated control systems and industrial equipment.
Strong analytical and practical problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently, take initiative and manage technical challenges in the field.
Comfortable working in demanding industrial environments, including foundries and aluminium production facilities.
Strong commitment to safety, quality and customer service.
Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken.
Knowledge of Polish, Czech, Romanian, German, Spanish, or other European languages is an advantage.
Valid driving licence and passport.
Legal authorisation to work or provide services in the country of residence.

Experience in the metals industry, foundries or industrial automation, as well as electrical qualifications or certifications, would be an advantage.

Location & Travel

Employment Type: We are open to both direct employment and independent contractor arrangements, depending on the candidate's location, experience and the most suitable contractual setup.

Location: Preferably Poland, Czech Republic or Romania. This is a home-based field service position field service position, requiring regular international travel to support customer deployments, installations, training and technical service activities.

The role is expected to involve approximately 50% travel, depending on project schedules and customer requirements. Travel will support DTE's international operations and future customer deployments in Europe, with visits to DTE headquarters in Iceland for training, product familiarisation and collaboration with Engineering and other teams.

The successful candidate should live within convenient driving distance of a major international airport.

For applications & inquiries send to: agusta@dte.ai

Last application date is October 31st, 2026.


Why DTE?

We are past proving that the technology works. DTE's systems are already operating in production environments, and we are now scaling from individual installations to plant-wide deployments.

We are solving a fundamental blind spot in one of the world's largest industries: metals producers cannot optimise what they cannot measure in real time.

Our technology provides the foundation for real-time process control, higher recycling rates, lower emissions and the future of autonomous metals manufacturing.

As we expand into Europe, you will have the opportunity to help build our regional service capabilities from the ground up, while working closely with an experienced international team.

Our core values are purpose, excellence and empowerment. We look for people who are driven, resilient and motivated by building technology with real industrial impact.

We encourage people of all genders to apply. DTE is committed to being an inclusive workplace where employees feel empowered, supported and able to do their best work. We look forward to receiving your application.

jobs.title: Leiter Automatisierungstechnik Siemens TIA
jobs.description:
About EH Group Engineering

EHG is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product is a significantly more compact fuel cell with high power density and lower costs of production. Faced with the challenges of climate change and the transition to a decentralised energy system, EHG seeks to provide high performance and cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To help bring this vision to life, we are looking for a Senior Control Engineer to coordinate our efforts in designing control strategies for containerized systems integrating our fuel cell technology alongside equipment such as gas reformers, batteries, and climate control units. You will coordinate the control team and play a key role in shaping how these complex, multi-equipment systems operate safely and efficiently in the field.

Based in the US? You’re welcome to apply. This is an on-site role in Nyon, Switzerland. We ask that you relocate within 3 months of starting, and we’ll support you with a relocation package.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate the control engineering activities and define the control architecture and technical roadmap for our fuel cell and containerized power systems

  • Develop control strategies, models and algorithms for test-benches, fuel cell system and containerized power supply systems using Matlab/Simulink and Siemens PLCs

  • Coordinate the transition of prototype control algorithms from Simulink to industrial-quality code in TIA Portal Step 7

  • Implement, tune and validate controllers for thermal, air, fuel and power subsystems

  • Define and own control requirements, state machines and safety/diagnostic logic

  • Drive the continuous improvement (performance, efficiency and robustness) of our products

  • Define and oversee model-in-the-loop (MIL) testing and validation procedures

  • Manage the complete software life cycle, from requirements through release and maintenance, including dataset management

  • Establish coding standards, conduct code reviews and ensure compliance with industrial and certification requirements

  • Coordinate and develop the control team, including task planning and prioritization

  • Act as the main control interface with embedded, test and electrical engineering, as well as external partners and suppliers

 

Skills and Experience Required:

  • BSc/MSc in control, electrical, mechatronic or automation engineering is mandatory

  • Minimum 7 years of experience in control engineering, including at least 2 years in a technical lead or senior role

  • Skill 1 : Strong experience in process control engineering, particularly with containerized power supply systems; knowledge of programming and implementing safety PLCs is a strong plus

  • Skill 2 : Strong experience with TIA Portal (Step 7, WinCC, Test Suite), with the ability to structure code to industrial standards and meet certification requirements

  • Experience with functional safety (e.g. IEC 61508, ISO 13849), including SIL/PL determination and implementation of safety functions

  • Experience across the complete V-model development cycle, including hazard and risk assessment, requirements definition, safety requirements specification (SRS), verification and validation, and dataset management

  • Experience with stationary and maritime power applications, with a focus on the US and EU markets and their respective standards and certification requirements

  • Proven team player, with the ability to:
    (i) Coordinate and mentor the control team by clearly explaining your code and helping the team adopt robust industrial methods: you will take the responsibility in developing Skill 1 and Skill 2 across the team
    (ii) Collaborate effectively within interdisciplinary teams

  • Solid knowledge of control theory, state machines and system identification

  • Strong experience with MATLAB/Simulink and model-based design is a plus

  • Professional working language is in English.

     

Start date: Immediately

jobs.description:
About EHG

EH Group (EHG) is a rapidly growing fuel cell power platform delivering onsite power to AI data centers, defense, and industry. Our fuel-agnostic proton exchange membrane (PEM) systems scale from kW-scale units to GW-scale power plants, and we design, manufacture, and deploy them for customers worldwide.

Founded in Switzerland, EHG is now expanding into the United States, fueled by exponential AI data center power demand and a soon-to-be-announced major investment round. This is a defining, high-growth chapter for the company.

 

The opportunity

We're hiring a Quality Manager to own a single quality system across both of our production streams — our established MW-scale facility in Nyon, Switzerland and our new US operation in Houston, Texas.

You'd be based in Nyon, where our production and process knowledge sits today, and own quality for the US operation as it stands up. The requirement is explicit: quality must be identical at both sites. Same specifications, same control plans, same acceptance criteria, same records. A customer taking delivery of a system should not be able to tell which site built the stack inside it, and our certification and warranty position depends on being able to demonstrate that.

Our customers are data center operators, defense programs, and industrial sites where reliability is the product. In your first year you'd harmonize our quality management system across both entities, establish controls in Houston that match those proven in Nyon as manufacturing technology transfers, build supplier quality alongside Supply Chain for a shared global supply base, and support certification of our systems for both European and US markets.

Location & travel: Nyon-based. Regular travel to Houston is expected as the US operation stands up, along with travel to supplier and partner sites in Europe and the US.

 

What you'll own

  • One quality management system across both entities — a common QMS covering Nyon and Houston, including the path to ISO 9001 certification in the US and alignment with what is already established in Switzerland.

  • Equivalence between sites. A single set of product specifications, control plans, inspection criteria, and acceptance standards, with a defined process for how any change is applied at both sites rather than one.

  • In-process quality for fuel cell stack production at both locations, including the process controls that matter most in stack assembly — cleanliness and contamination control, leak testing, torque and compression control, and alignment.

  • Supplier quality for a shared global supply base, working with Supply Chain on qualification, audits, first article inspection, part submission, and ongoing performance, with one qualification standard regardless of which site a supplier serves.

  • Quality oversight of contract manufacturing and assembly partners building balance of plant and containerized systems on our behalf in both regions — audits, quality agreements, source inspection, and acceptance criteria.

  • Nonconformance and corrective action across both sites, including NCR and CAPA processes and structured problem solving, with findings at one site systematically applied at the other.

  • Traceability and product records — a common lot genealogy model from raw material through stack serial to delivered system, and the test and inspection data that supports warranty, certification, and customer acceptance, held consistently across both entities.

  • Certification across regions, working with external certification partners on the standards applicable to stationary hydrogen power systems in Europe and the US, authority having jurisdiction approvals, and marine classification where relevant.

  • Quality culture on both floors, including operator training, work instruction discipline, and establishing the habits in Houston that are already proven in Nyon, as US headcount grows quickly.

  • Building the US quality capability, defining what needs to sit on the ground in Houston versus what is run centrally from Nyon, and recruiting into it as volumes grow.

 

What we're looking for

Core experience

  • Owning quality across more than one manufacturing site, ideally in more than one country, with a demonstrated ability to hold two sites to genuinely the same standard from a distance.

  • Establishing or substantially rebuilding a quality function, including authoring a quality management system rather than administering an existing one.

  • Hands-on in-process and incoming quality in a production setting, with real familiarity with control plans, inspection methods, measurement systems, and process capability.

  • Supplier quality experience, including auditing suppliers and holding them to standard.

  • Structured problem solving and root cause analysis, with a track record of permanently closing out recurring defects.

  • Working knowledge of product certification processes and the evidence they require, ideally in energy, power equipment, or another regulated product category. Exposure to both European and US regimes is a strong advantage.

  • The judgment to know which controls are essential at low volume and which can wait, and the confidence to hold a quality position under schedule pressure.

  • Comfort working across time zones and influencing a site you are not physically based at, including building quality capability remotely.

Especially compelling

  • Fuel cell, battery cell, or similar electrochemical assembly experience.

  • Experience with cleanliness-critical or contamination-sensitive assembly processes.

  • Experience supporting a technology transfer between sites or countries, and establishing quality at the receiving end.

  • Experience qualifying and auditing contract manufacturers or system integrators.

  • Startup or scale-up experience as an early hire during hyper-growth.

  • Experience working between Europe and the US, and with US codes and certification practice in particular. French is useful but not required.

 

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation and meaningful equity, calibrated to the market and discussed directly with you.

  • Relocation support to Nyon, Switzerland.

  • The opportunity to build EHG's global quality function during a defining phase of hyper-growth.

Note: Swiss work authorization or eligibility is required for this role, along with the ability to travel to the United States.

jobs.title: Robotics Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
About Enact

The next defining technological breakthrough will be in the physical world. We stand at a historical inflection point: bringing general-purpose intelligence into robotics.

At Enact we rethink the entire robotic tech stack from model architectures and data pipelines, to the actuators and sensors that feed the model. Pushing beyond pure vision and language approaches, we build a proprioceptive nerve system, and the cortex that makes sense of it, to solve dexterity through whole-body force-awareness and deploy robots for thousands of tasks in industry and beyond.

We are shaping a company where brilliant and unconventional people thrive together on solving the hardest challenges of our time. We are truth seekers. We reason from first principles, test our beliefs against reality, and trust that the best ideas can come from anyone. We move fast. We care deeply about our work and colleagues and are driven by passion to change the status quo.

If this resonates, we're excited to hear from you.

In This Role You Will

  • Design, integrate and test the electromechanical systems at the core of our dexterous robots: actuator modules, joints, and end-effectors, sensors, PCBs, and cable harnesses into compact, reliable units for high-DoF robotics

  • Bring hardware to life: lead system assembly & bring-up, debug across mechanics, electronics, and firmware, and work with controls & AI engineers to build a fully vertically integrated manipulation system

  • Develop & build automated test setups to validate performance, durability, and reliability, and take systems from prototype to series production

What We're Looking For

  • Degree (BSc/MSc/PhD) in mechatronics, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or a related field

  • 3+ years of work experience developing complex mechatronic systems that bridge mechanical design, electronics, and software

  • Solid understanding of electric motors, encoders, sensors, and motor drivers, and how to integrate them into a working system

  • Experience with system-level debugging and testing using tools such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic analyzers, and data acquisition systems

  • Comfortable with programming for test automation and data analysis (e.g., Python)

  • Familiarity designing parts in CAD (e.g. Onshape)

  • Hands-on experience with rapid prototyping, workshop tools, soldering, 3D printing, and prototype assembly/testing

  • Fluency in English (spoken and written), with strong interpersonal and communication skills

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Hands-on development experience with high-DoF robotic systems (e.g., robotic arms, end-effectors, dexterous hands, or humanoids)

  • Development experience with actuator systems (frameless motors, gearboxes, encoders, and integrated drives)

  • Experience with motor control and communication buses such as EtherCAT or CAN

  • Experience with PCB design or schematic review, and cable harness design

  • Thermal management for compact, high-power electronics and actuators

What we offer

  • The opportunity to make a real impact working on some of the biggest challenges of our time

  • A fast-paced learning environment alongside an outstanding, driven team

  • Ownership from day one, with the ability to iterate quickly and see your impact firsthand in an early-stage startup

  • Visa sponsorship & relocation benefits to hire the best in the world

  • A world-class in-person setup in central Zürich, with excellent prototyping, robotics, and technical infrastructure for hands-on builders

  • Competitive compensation and meaningful equity participation

jobs.title: Manager Operations Planning & Performance
jobs.description:
Bij Crisp hebben we een missie: eten met meer smaak bereikbaar maken voor iedereen. Daarvoor moet elke schakel in onze operatie, van warehouse tot voordeur, dagelijks naadloos op elkaar aansluiten. Als Manager Operations Planning & Performance ben jij de spil tussen wat de klant bestelt en hoe wij dat logistiek waarmaken. Je brengt alle operationele schakels samen in één strakke, integrale planning en bouwt mee aan een betrouwbare operatie die klaar is om slim door te groeien.

Wat je gaat doen

Je bent eigenaar van de integrale operationele planning. Je vertaalt verwachte klantvraag naar concrete capaciteit op de weg (hoeveel bezorgers hebben we per dag en per hub nodig?) en bepaalt samen met de Operations Manager de planningsstrategie voor de korte en middellange termijn. Je zorgt voor een strakke planning tussen Delivery, Retentie en Warehouse. Zo werkt iedereen vanuit dezelfde basis en tilt jouw scherpe blik onze processen naar een hoger niveau.

  • Je geeft leiding aan een team van routeplanners (werkstudenten en starters). Samen zorgen jullie dagelijks voor de meest efficiënte bezorgroutes. Jouw team staat in direct contact met de bezorghubs, het warehouse en de growth afdeling om de capaciteit af te stemmen

  • Je werkt nauw samen met teams door de hele organisatie, van Tech en Analytics tot Recruitment. Om te weten wat er speelt, ben je regelmatig te vinden waar het gebeurt: op onze bezorghubs en in het warehouse.

  • Je stuurt op operationele KPI’s (zoals Drops per Hour en Time per Stop) en beheert belangrijke kostenlijnen. Samen met de Regiomanager en Business Analyst Delivery blijf je ons bezorgnetwerk continu optimaliseren.

  • Je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor de lijn tussen ons warehouse en de hubs. Je onderhoudt de contacten met vrachtwagenvervoerders, stuurt op prestaties (On Time) en kosten (Cost per Drop) en maximaliseert de vulgraad.

  • Je kijkt altijd naar wat beter kan, houdt trends en innovaties in de markt in de gaten en draagt dit actief aan wanneer je hier kansen ziet. Je signaleert kansen in de operatie, maakt de impact inzichtelijk en leidt verbeterprojecten van idee tot implementatie, bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van servicetijd, automatisering van planningstaken of de inrichting van ons netwerk.

  • Je bent onderdeel van het Delivery team en rapporteert aan de Head of Delivery.

Dit ben jij

  • Je hebt HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau en minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring in operationele planning, logistiek of supply chain, bij voorkeur in een snelgroeiende e-commerce- of retailomgeving.

  • Je beweegt je makkelijk door de hele organisatie, van de vloer tot het management. Je zoekt actief de samenwerking op en krijgt verschillende teams moeiteloos op één lijn. Je creëert draagvlak en krijgt mensen mee in een gezamenlijke aanpak, ook als je geen formele zeggenschap over ze hebt

  • Je bent sterk met data. Je duikt zelf in de cijfers, bouwt een model of dashboard als dat nodig is, en vertaalt analyses naar concrete keuzes voor de operatie. Ervaring met SQL, BigQuery en Data Studio is een pré.

  • Jij kijkt verder dan je eigen scope en overziet de hele keten. Je begrijpt hoe een keuze in de planning doorwerkt in het warehouse, op de weg en bij de klant, en je weet de juiste balans te vinden tussen kosten en kwaliteit.

  • Je bent resultaatgericht en weet wat het is om eigenaarschap te nemen. Jij maakt dingen graag makkelijk en concreet. Complexe vraagstukken zet jij gemakkelijk om naar begrijpelijke acties.

  • Je houdt het hoofd koel als het even spannend wordt. Pieken, onverwachte uitval of last-minute wijzigingen brengen je niet van je stuk; je prioriteert, plant opnieuw en zorgt dat de operatie doordraait.

  • Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.

Wat wij bieden

  • Werken bij een B Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op het Europese voedselsysteem.

  • 27 vakantiedagen om bij te komen en op te laden.

  • Een extra vrije dag per jaar om je in te zetten voor vrijwilligerswerk en iets goeds te doen.

  • Aandacht voor je mentale gezondheid met online begeleiding van erkende psychologen via OpenUp.

  • Voor straks een perfect pensioen via BPFL.

  • Elke maand food for thought, met workshops en talks via de Crisp University.

  • Regelmatig tastings of workshops op kantoor of bij een van onze leveranciers, om te zien hoe onze lekkerste producten worden gemaakt – en natuurlijk ook te proeven.

  • Dagelijks een uitgebreide, georganiseerde lunch op kantoor.

  • Enthousiaste, slimme collega’s en tijd om elkaar te leren kennen tijdens sport, events en proeverijen.

  • En... fikse korting op je Crisp boodschappen, omdat je thuis natuurlijk ook goed wilt eten.

Onze selectieprocedure

Solliciteer via onderstaande button. Hoe meer je kunt delen over jezelf en de reden dat je solliciteert, hoe beter.
Bij Crisp streven we naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen welkom is, ongeacht hun achtergrond, geslacht, leeftijd, etniciteit, seksuele geaardheid, religie of beperking. Wij moedigen sollicitanten met diverse perspectieven en achtergronden aan om te solliciteren en geloven in gelijke kansen voor iedereen. We waarderen de unieke bijdragen die elke medewerker kan leveren en zijn vastbesloten om een inclusieve werkplek te creëren waarin iedereen wordt gerespecteerd en gewaardeerd.

jobs.title: Project Leider Bouw
jobs.description:
Monumental automatiseert de bouw met robotica en software. Onze missie is om de bouw software-defined en autonoom te maken – een toekomst waarin mooie gebouwen op maat in één dag verrijzen, met minimale inzet van handwerk.

We zijn een groeiend team van engineers, operators en technici, afkomstig van bedrijven als Palantir, Qualcomm, Dyson, Shopify, Tesla, Meta en Google DeepMind. We staan nog aan het begin van het opbouwen van dit bedrijf, en dit is je kans om buitenproportioneel veel impact te maken op een probleem dat écht uitmaakt. Vanaf dag één werk je samen met een ervaren foundingteam, met een Series B van $32M achter ons onder leiding van Khosla Ventures en Plural.

Monumental zit in het centrum van Amsterdam, in een prachtig pand met een volledig uitgeruste werkplaats en een eigen testvloer voor robots. We bouwen de hele stack in-house – hardware én software. We zijn uitdrukkelijk geen hybride of remote-first bedrijf: robots en muren bouw je niet vanaf je keukentafel, dus we werken vijf dagen per week op locatie.

Lees meer over waarom wij vinden dat je je tijd aan de bouw zou moeten besteden, en over onze visie en ons bedrijf. Misschien vind je ons YouTube-kanaal interessant, de film van Based in Europe over hoe we het Europese woningtekort aanpakken, of deze video van Andreas Klinger over hoe ons kantoor eruitziet.

Over de functie

De afgelopen jaren is Monumental gegroeid van een werkend product en de eerste proefprojecten naar bouwen op grote schaal. Inmiddels hebben we een vloot van meer dan 150 robots, die metselwerk hebben uitgevoerd voor meer dan 90 woningen, een school, een buurthuis, een hotel en meer dan 150 meter kanaalwand.

Elke maand nemen we meer bouwprojecten aan, intern noemen we die ‘deployments’. We werken met meer robots en meer mensen en breiden vanuit Nederland uit naar het Verenigd Koninkrijk en de VS.

Als Hub Lead zet je onze eerste vestiging buiten het hoofdkantoor op, in het noorden van Nederland. Je begint met ons grootste bouwproject tot nu toe. Naarmate er meer projecten bijkomen, bouw je het team en de operatie verder uit.

We zoeken mensen die breed inzetbaar zijn en een bouwproject willen leiden alsof het hun eigen bedrijf is. Achter elk project staat een Deployment Manager die van begin tot eind verantwoordelijk is. In de praktijk vervul je vijf rollen tegelijk: uitvoerder, operationeel manager, accountmanager, analist en projectmanager. Je maakt het bouwplan, voert het met je team als onderaannemer uit, onderhoudt het contact met de aannemer en zorgt dat we goed metselwerk op tijd opleveren. Dat doe je in de bouw, waar plannen voortdurend veranderen. Uiteindelijk leid je meerdere projecten tegelijk, waaronder complexe projecten waarbij veel op het spel staat.

De ene dag sta je bij zonsopgang op en ga je naar de bouwplaats. Je zaagt stenen, bewaakt de planning, stemt af met de hoofdaannemer en ziet je bouwplan steen voor steen werkelijkheid worden. De volgende dag zit je op onze vestiging, analyseer je de winst- en verliesrekening van je project en werk je aan systemen waarmee je bij het volgende project een betere marge haalt. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de oplevering en geeft knelpunten die je op de bouwplaats tegenkomt door aan ons R&D-team.

Dit is intensief, praktisch werk op locatie, waar je veel voldoening uit kunt halen. Robots gaan kapot, het weer slaat om en de aannemer verandert het plan. Jij zorgt dat de bouw doorgaat.

Je krijgt veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid. De rol past goed bij je als je eerder een bedrijf hebt opgericht, of als je een ondernemende functie zoekt waarin je veel invloed hebt op het resultaat.

Wat je gaat doen

  • De logistiek van een bouwproject plannen. Je bepaalt hoeveel en welke robots en mensen nodig zijn, stemt af met andere onderaannemers en maakt de dagelijkse planning. Tegelijk houd je het grotere geheel in het oog en begrijp je wat jouw keuzes betekenen voor de kosten en opbrengsten per project.

  • Op de bouwplaats het team aansturen, begeleiden en motiveren. Je onderhoudt het contact met hoofdaannemers en andere betrokkenen, vertegenwoordigt Monumental en legt uit wat we doen. Je schakelt net zo makkelijk met steigerbouwers als met de CEO’s van de grootste hoofdaannemers en onze engineers.

  • Operationele systemen opzetten waarmee elk project beter verloopt dan het vorige. Je ziet waar tijd en middelen verloren gaan, past processen aan en verbetert de marge.

  • Samenwerken met bestaande klanten en zorgen dat daar nieuwe bouwprojecten uit voortkomen. In de toekomst doe je dat ook voor aanverwante productlijnen buiten het metselwerk.

  • Verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor de winst- en verliesrekening van je project en voorstellen doen om de kosten en opbrengsten per project steeds verder te verbeteren.

  • Helpen bij het werven en interviewen van nieuwe robotoperators en deployment operators.

Wat we zoeken

  • Minimaal drie jaar ervaring startupervaring, als operator, manager, of founder.

  • Nederlands als moedertaal. De bouwsector is sterk lokaal georganiseerd, dus dit is een vereiste voor de functie.

  • Je communiceert helder en makkelijk met mensen met uiteenlopende achtergronden.

  • Je bent bereid om letterlijk je handen vuil te maken om het werk gedaan te krijgen.

  • Je komt snel in actie, zet door en krijgt dingen voor elkaar. In deze functie draait het vooral om uitvoeren.

  • Je kunt goed omgaan met hoge werkdruk. Op bouwplaatsen gaat regelmatig iets mis en staat er veel op het spel. Daar komt bij dat we nieuwe technologie inzetten waarvan we nog niet alle mogelijke storingen kennen.

  • Je denkt scherp en leert graag. Welke achtergrond je ook hebt, je zult in deze rol veel en snel moeten leren. Het werk kan elke drie tot zes maanden als een nieuwe baan voelen. Je leert veel over de bouw, robotica en werken in een snelgroeiend technologiebedrijf.

  • Je hebt ervaring met het aansturen van een klein team en weet hoe je mensen begeleidt en motiveert.

  • Je bent operationeel en analytisch sterk. Je kunt een helder operationeel plan uitwerken in een spreadsheet, een winst- en verliesrekening presenteren en verschillende scenario’s doorrekenen, inclusief de factoren die het resultaat bepalen. Je bent een sterke projectmanager.

Waarom Monumental?

Bij Monumental werken betekent vooroplopen in een beweging die de bouwsector wezenlijk wil veranderen. Jouw werk heeft hier niet alleen impact op het bedrijf, maar op de toekomst van hoe we bouwen. Als je gedreven wordt door innovatie, graag complexe uitdagingen aanpakt en klaar bent om echt verschil te maken, horen we graag van je.

You are responsible for the people, the roadmap and the technical direction, and you stay hands-on enough to ship alongside the team and make architectural calls credibly. At DataSnipper, Team Lead is our entry point into engineering management: the same people, delivery and product responsibilities as an Engineering Manager, on a smaller team.

We are a handful of people serving the whole company, so your judgment about what not to build matters as much as what the team ships.

About DataSnipper

DataSnipper is the driving force behind an intelligent automation platform that’s transforming the world of audit and finance.

At DataSnipper, we’re always on the lookout for innovators who think outside of the box. New ideas aren’t just welcomed at DataSnipper–they’re essential.

The Data Platform team works across three areas:
