jobs.description:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the Role

We're looking for a hands-on scientist-engineer to help build our next-generation DNA synthesis platform, enabling high-throughput, cost-effective production of large and diverse DNA libraries. You'll work at the intersection of chemistry, materials science, bioengineering, and hardware development, designing and building prototypes, running experiments, and optimizing processes to turn new synthesis technologies into reliable, scalable production systems.

DNA synthesis is a fundamental part of our protein engineering platform. We're developing new approaches to dramatically increase synthesis throughput while reducing cost and turnaround time.

You'll work closely with our scientific and engineering teams to develop and prototype new DNA synthesis technologies. Your focus will be on translating scientific concepts into working hardware and experimental systems, designing and building prototypes, testing different approaches, and continuously improving their performance.

This is a highly hands-on, interdisciplinary role combining experimental science with practical engineering. You'll take ownership of prototype development, experimental validation, and process optimization, helping move promising technologies from early concepts to reliable, scalable systems.

We're looking for someone who enjoys building things, solving technical problems, and working across disciplines. You don't need to be an expert in DNA synthesis, but you should have strong scientific fundamentals, an engineering mindset, and experience turning ideas into working prototypes.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and test prototypes for next-generation DNA synthesis technologies.

  • Translate scientific and technical requirements into practical engineering designs and experimental setups.

  • Scope and evaluate different technical approaches, components, materials, and equipment for prototype development.

  • Develop and optimize the chemistry, materials, and processes underlying the synthesis platform.

  • Design and execute experiments to characterize performance, identify limitations, and improve reliability.

  • Work closely with mechanical, electronics, software, and automation engineers to develop integrated experimental systems.

  • Troubleshoot complex technical problems across chemistry, hardware, and process engineering.

  • Develop analytical methods and quality control strategies to measure performance and guide optimization.

  • Help scale successful prototypes into robust, reproducible systems suitable for routine production.

  • Work with external suppliers and engineering partners to source components, evaluate technologies, and accelerate development.

What We're Looking For

  • A strong background in chemical engineering, chemistry, materials science, bioengineering, mechanical engineering, or a related field.

  • Hands-on experience designing, building, and testing experimental setups, prototypes, or laboratory equipment.

  • Strong understanding of chemistry, materials, or process engineering, with the ability to apply these fundamentals to practical engineering challenges.

  • Experience developing and optimizing experimental processes, including systematic troubleshooting and performance characterization.

  • Comfortable working across hardware and experimental science, translating scientific requirements into practical engineering solutions.

  • Experience selecting components, evaluating technical trade-offs, and iterating on prototype designs.

  • Strong experimental skills, including designing experiments, analyzing data, and making decisions based on results.

  • Independent, resourceful, and comfortable working on open-ended technical problems.

  • A practical, hands-on approach to engineering, with a focus on building, testing, and improving systems rather than purely theoretical development.

  • Experience with DNA or oligonucleotide synthesis, including chemical or enzymatic approaches, is a plus.

  • Experience with solid-phase synthesis, surface chemistry, or chemical process development is a plus.

  • Familiarity with microfluidics, high-throughput dispensing, or array-based technologies is a plus.

  • Experience with laboratory automation, instrumentation, or custom hardware development is a plus.

  • Experience with CAD, electronics, fluidics, or mechanical prototyping is a plus.

  • Experience scaling experimental technologies from proof of concept to production is a plus.

  • Programming and data analysis experience, particularly in Python, is a plus.

jobs.title: Bioengineer / Molecular Biologist
jobs.description:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the Role

This is a hands-on research role in our biology and production team. You'll work on the science that underpins everything Adaptyv does: developing and optimizing protein expression systems, running molecular biology workflows, and pushing the boundaries of what we can produce and characterize at scale.

We express proteins at high volume across cell-free and cell-based systems, run DNA synthesis and assembly at high throughput, and characterize binding, stability, and function using BLI, SPR, and enzymatic assays.

What you'll do

  • Develop and optimize protein expression workflows - cell-free expression (PURE, lysate-based), E. coli, and potentially mammalian systems. Troubleshoot when proteins don't express, misfold, or aggregate.

  • Design and execute DNA synthesis and assembly protocols: PCR, Golden Gate, Gibson. Improve yield, fidelity, and throughput.

  • Develop new assays or adapt existing ones for the platform - thermostability, developability, enzyme activity, or whatever the next customer need demands.

  • Run experiments yourself. This is not a project management role. You'll be at the bench doing molecular biology, analyzing data, and iterating on protocols.

  • Work with the automation team to translate your methods into automated workflows. You develop the protocol that works; they make the robots run it.

  • Analyze experimental data, identify failure modes, and improve methods systematically. When 20% of constructs in a batch fail to express, you figure out why.

What we're looking for

  • MSc or PhD in molecular biology, biochemistry, bioengineering, or a related field. Hands-on depth matters most - years at the bench doing real molecular biology counts more than the degree title.

  • Practical protein expression and purification skills. You've expressed recombinant proteins and know what it takes to get them soluble, folded, and functional.

  • Experience with DNA synthesis, cloning, or assembly methods (PCR, Golden Gate, Gibson). High-throughput experience is a plus.

  • Comfortable with data analysis - you interpret chromatograms, binding curves, and expression gels without hand-holding.

  • Rigorous experimentalist. You keep detailed notes, design proper controls, and understand why reproducibility matters when you're running hundreds of experiments a month.

  • Interested in automation. You don't need to program robots, but you should want your protocols to become automated workflows rather than staying manual forever.

  • Independent and resourceful. You troubleshoot using literature, first principles, and experimentation - not by waiting for someone to tell you what to try next.

Location: Lausanne, Switzerland (on-site - this is a lab role).

Er du klar til næste skridt i din tjenerkarriere og har du lyst til at blive en del af et ambitiøst team med passion for gastronomi, vin og værtskab? Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Ohjaaja, lastensuojelun sijaishuolto
jobs.description:
Pienryhmäkoti Hiivola on lastensuojelun sijaishuollon ympärivuorokautista hoitoa ja kasvatusta tarjoava yksikkö Riihimäen kupeessa upeiden maalaismaisemien keskellä. Toimimme omalla 1,5 hehtaarin tontillamme luonnon ympäröimänä. Toimintaamme ohjaavat arvot ovat **turva, toivo, luonto ja yhdessä**.

Hiivolassa arki rakentuu turvallisten, läsnä olevien ja osaavien aikuisten ympärille. Tuemme lasten kasvua ja kehitystä yksilöllisesti heidän tarpeensa huomioiden.

Etsimme joukkoomme **ohjaajaa määräaikaiseen perhevapaan sijaisuuteen**. Työsuhde alkaa sopimuksen mukaan mahdollisimman pian. Sijaisuuden arvioitu kesto on lokakuuhun 2027 saakka.

Tehtävässä edellytämme tehtävään soveltuvaa sosiaali- tai terveysalan tutkintoa, esimerkiksi:

- sosionomi (AMK)

- yhteisöpedagogi (AMK)

- sairaanhoitaja (AMK)

- lähihoitaja


Työ on kolmivuorotyötä. Lisäksi edellytämme ajokorttia ja hygieniapassia.

Hiivolassa on seitsemän asiakaspaikkaa. Ohjaajan tehtävänä on luoda vuorossaan turvallinen ja kannustava ilmapiiri kaikille lapsille sekä osallistua aktiivisesti heidän arkeensa. Työhön kuuluu myös dokumentointia sekä kodinhoidollisia tehtäviä.

Arvostamme idearikasta, yhteistyökykyistä ja toiveikasta työotetta. Hiivolassa eletään toiminnallista arkea, jota jokainen työntekijä voi rikastuttaa omilla vahvuuksillaan. Yksikössä on eläimiä ja vietämme paljon aikaa luonnossa liikkuen.

**Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden tehdä merkityksellistä työtä pienessä ja välittävässä työyhteisössä, jossa jokaisen työntekijän osaamista arvostetaan.**

Vi er en veletableret virksomhed med over 10 års erfaring inden for professionelt håndværk. jobs.title: Senior Regulatory Affairs Specialist
jobs.description:
The Practical Detail
Location: Wageningen
Working model: Hybrid

Why this role matters
You will lead regulatory compliance across Europe, ensuring our innovative products meet and exceed all requirements.
This role is crucial for guiding product development and marketing strategies within Flora Food Group, helping us deliver Culinary Essentials for Better Food.
You will influence business-critical decisions by translating complex regulations into clear guidance, balancing compliance with creativity and speed to market.
Your work supports our purpose by enabling safe, compliant, and innovative food solutions that reach kitchens across Europe.

What you'll do

  • Guide Product Developers and Technical Project Leaders from project inception to launch, ensuring regulatory compliance for innovative products and claims.
  • Shape and implement Flora Food Group's marketing claims strategy and risk management plans.
  • Anticipate, identify, and manage regulatory changes across Europe, driving their implementation within the business.
  • Train and support cross-functional teams including R&D, Marketing, and Sales on regulatory frameworks such as product and labelling compliance, nutrition and health claims, and regulatory processes.
  • Liaise with Legal, Quality, Corporate Affairs, and Marketing teams to address regulatory and compliance questions from authorities and customers.

Performance
You will own regulatory leadership across Europe, ensuring compliance that enables innovation and market success. You will translate regulatory requirements into clear, pragmatic guidance for the business, balancing compliance, innovation, creativity, and speed to market, while driving continuous improvement of regulatory processes, tools, and ways of working.
Success will be measured through effective business partnering, timely project support, compliant product delivery, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Care
You will report to the Regulatory Affairs Manager for Developed Markets (Europe) and work closely with diverse teams across R&D, Marketing, Legal, Quality, and Corporate Affairs.
Your role demands responsible leadership, balancing regulatory compliance with business needs to build sustainable, long-term solutions.
You will foster collaboration and accountability, ensuring Flora Food Group's products meet the highest standards for consumers and communities.

Passion
As a food lover and regulatory expert, you bring curiosity and rigor to navigating complex food regulations.
You understand the importance of taste, nutrition, functionality, and reliability in every product we develop.
Your passion for food innovation drives you to support creative solutions that meet regulatory demands without compromising quality or consumer trust.

About you
You bring strong experience in European food regulations within an FMCG environment, with a proven ability to influence and guide cross-functional teams.
You have a Master's Degree or higher in Food Technology, Quality, Chemistry, or a related field, combined with practical experience in regulatory affairs.
You are proactive, able to manage time-sensitive priorities, and skilled at translating complex regulatory requirements into clear, pragmatic guidance.
Fluency in English is essential, and additional languages are a plus.
You are genuinely interested in food culture and curious about how consumer behaviour and future food trends shape innovation.
You understand that strong brands are built by anticipating what's next in taste, nutrition and functionality, and by translating insight into meaningful consumer experiences.

Where this could lead to
This role typically leads to progression into the Regulatory Affairs Manager position, with opportunities to expand into Nutrition, Corporate Affairs, or Communications depending on your background and aspirations. Growth is supported by increasing responsibility for regulatory strategy and cross-functional leadership within Flora Food Group.

What's next
If this opportunity sounds exciting, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply before: 29-Oct-2026

Elif -----

jobs.title: Cruise Consultant til MyCruise
jobs.description:
Brænder du for salg, rejser og gode kundeoplevelser?

Vil du rådgive kunder om nogle af verdens mest spændende rejser og samtidig være en del af en virksomhed i vækst?

Hos MyCruise søger vi en Cruise Consultant til vores salgsteam på hovedkontoret i Vanløse.

Som Cruise Consultant får du ansvaret for at rådgive vores kunder og sammensætte den helt rigtige krydstogtrejse. Det handler ikke bare om at finde en kahyt og en afrejsedato, men også om alt det uden om, som fly, hotel, udflugter og meget mere. Du skal forstå kundens ønsker, inspirere, rådgive og skabe en rejse, der passer til den enkelte kunde.

Du bliver en del af et ambitiøst salgsteam, hvor vi arbejder professionelt med salg, konvertering og kundeoplevelse, men hvor der samtidig er plads til personlighed, godt humør og forskellige måder at være en dygtig sælger på.

Om jobbet

Dine kunder kontakter os, fordi de allerede drømmer om at komme ud at rejse. Din opgave er at omsætte drømmen til den rigtige rejse.

Du kommer blandt andet til at:

• Rådgive kunder om krydstogter, destinationer, rederier og rejsemuligheder

• Sælge og sammensætte individuelle krydstogtsrejser

• Afdække kundens behov og finde den løsning, der passer bedst

• Følge op på tilbud og kundehenvendelser

• Arbejde aktivt med mersalg og muligheder for at gøre kundens samlede rejse endnu bedre

• Opbygge relationer til både nye og eksisterende kunder

• Arbejde med nogle af verdens største og mest spændende krydstogtsrederier

• Holde dig opdateret på produkter, destinationer og nye muligheder i markedet

Du får naturligvis en grundig introduktion til vores produkter, systemer og rederier.

Hvem er du?

Det vigtigste for os er, at du kan lide at sælge og motiveres af at skabe gode resultater sammen med kunden.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

• Har erfaring med salg, rådgivning eller kundekontakt

• Er god til at lytte og hurtigt kan forstå kundens ønsker og behov

• Har et naturligt kommercielt mindset og trives med mål og resultater

• Er serviceminded og forstår, at den gode kundeoplevelse og det gode salg går hånd i hånd

• Har energi, drive og lyst til at tage ansvar for dine egne kunder

• Trives i en hverdag med tempo og mange forskellige kundehenvendelser

• Er struktureret og følger dine tilbud og kunder helt til dørs

• Er fortrolig med IT og har nemt ved at lære nye systemer

Har du erfaring fra rejsebranchen eller kendskab til krydstogter, er det naturligvis en fordel, men det er ikke et krav. Resten kan vi lære dig.

Hvem er MyCruise?

MyCruise er et af Skandinaviens førende specialiserede krydstogtsrejsebureauer. Vi samarbejder med en lang række af verdens største krydstogtsrederier og hjælper hvert år vores kunder med at finde den helt rigtige rejse.

Vi sælger både klassiske ocean cruises, Exclusive cruises samt River cruises.

Vi har kontorer i Danmark, Norge, Sverige og Storbritannien, mens vores danske hovedkontor ligger i Vanløse. Her arbejder salg tæt sammen med blandt andet Concierge &  Product Marketing

Vi er i vækst og har store ambitioner for de kommende år. Derfor leder vi også efter mennesker, der har lyst til at udvikle sig sammen med os.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

• En spændende salgsrolle i en branche, hvor produktet virkelig kan begejstre

• Grundig oplæring i krydstogter, rederier, destinationer og vores systemer

• Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling

• Studieture og mulighed for selv at opleve nogle af de produkter, vi sælger

• Personalepriser på rejser

• Pension og sundhedsordning

• Frokostordning, frugt, kaffe og sodavand

• Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med dygtige og engagerede kolleger

• En organisation med korte beslutningsveje og mulighed for selv at gøre en forskel

• Arbejdsplads på vores hovedkontor i Vanløse tæt på metro og S tog

Lyder det som dig?

Send dit CV og din ansøgning til job@mycruise.dk.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Stillingen er på fuld tid og med arbejdssted på vores hovedkontor i Vanløse.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

We are currently looking for reliable and motivated employees to join a well-established fish production company. This is an excellent opportunity to become part of an international workplace where teamwork, quality, and food safety are highly valued.

Your daily tasks may include:

  • Sorting, processing, and preparing fish products

  • Filleting, trimming, and cutting fish

  • Quality control and inspection of products

  • Weighing, packing, and labeling finished products

  • Cleaning and sanitizing production areas and equipment

  • Assisting with various other production-related tasks as needed

Working Hours

Full-time position, 37 hours per week. Overtime may occur during busy periods.

Day Shift: 06:55 - 15:09
Morning Shift: 05:55 - 14:09

Please note that there is a 1-hour self-paid break each day.

We are looking for candidates who:

  • Speak and understand English

  • Are physically fit and comfortable performing standing and repetitive work

  • Have previous experience from fish production, food production, or a similar manufacturing environment

  • Can work efficiently while maintaining a high level of quality

  • Are able to follow strict hygiene, safety, and quality procedures

  • Are reliable, punctual, and have a positive attitude towards teamwork

 

What We Offer

  • A good and supportive working environment with colleagues from many different nationalities

  • Thorough introduction and training

  • Workwear and safety footwear provided by the company

  • Access to a canteen with the option to purchase food

  • The opportunity to gain valuable experience within a professional food production company

Salary: 143,40,- + 6,50,- per hour.

Important Information

Due to the location of the workplace and the early working hours, public transportation is not a realistic option, and it is therefore necessary that you have your own reliable means of transportation to and from work.

Due to strict hygiene and food safety requirements, jewelry, piercings, artificial nails, and artificial eyelashes are not permitted in the production area.

If you are looking for long-term employment in a professional production environment and have experience from the fish or food industry, we encourage you to apply. We are looking for employees who are ready to contribute, work as part of a team, and help maintain the high standards our customer is known for.

jobs.title: Tenure track assistant professor/Associate professor positions in Veterinary medicine
jobs.employer: Technical Sciences - Institut for Husdyr- og Veter
jobs.description:
The Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences (ANIVET) is seeking three new staff members for teaching and research in veterinary medicine. The positions are available from 1 August 2027 or soon thereafter.

The educational activities for these positions are aimed at students in veterinary medicine at both the bachelor’s and master’s levels.

The veterinary medicine programme is organised into courses covering educationally relevant themes and integrates a range of disciplines, and this is done with the vision to create a professional engagement while ensuring scientific depth for the students of veterinary medicine.

ANIVET is part of the Faculty of Technical Sciences at Aarhus University. The department is located near Viborg (Campus AU Viborg – Research Centre Foulum) and encompasses five research units with approximately 200 dedicated employees of which 50% are scientific staff. The AU Viborg campus will gradually grow to a student population of 800 – 900. The positions will be integrated into the department’s existing scientific research units, in which scientists at all career stages work together with skilled technical staff such as laboratory technicians and data analysts.

The positions
  1. Clinical veterinary science – livestock
  2. Veterinary public health
  3. Veterinary pathology

If you wish to apply for more than one position, please apply for each position separately. Please read more down below in “How to apply”.

1. Tenure track assistant professor or Associated Professor in Clinical veterinary science – livestock
We are seeking a candidate with a clinical background in veterinary science within production animals - Livestock.

Research tasks
The focus of the position is to:
  • Perform clinical veterinary science within production animals, with emphasis on individual or group-level animal diagnostics, clinical decision-making, and evidence-based treatment and prevention strategies.
  • Research in major production diseases in cattle and/or pigs of significant importance in Europe, including development of clinically applicable knowledge and tools supporting veterinary decision-making in practice.
  • Integrate clinical findings with herd-level data to improve disease prevention and health management in modern production systems.



Within his/her area of expertise, it is expected that in addition the candidate will:
  • Conduct research-based advisory work for authorities and have an active role in externally funded research projects.
  • Contribute to the development and delivery of teaching in clinical veterinary science for production animals, with emphasis on case-based and hands-on learning.
  • Provide academic leadership within the clinical production animal field, including mentoring and coordination of junior teaching staff (e.g., assistant lecturers/teaching assistants).
  • Contribute to strengthening collaboration with the veterinary profession and industry stakeholders in Denmark.


Your profile
The preferred candidate should demonstrate:
  • The ability to independently conduct research within veterinary clinical science related to pig or cattle production
  • Danish authorization as a veterinarian or can achieve it
  • Preferably experiences within obstetrics



2. Tenure track assistant professor or Associated Professor in Veterinary Public Health
We are seeking a candidate with strong expertise in veterinary public health, including popu-lation-level animal health, food safety/meat inspection, and the role of veterinarians in society.

Research tasks
The focus of the position is to:
  • Conduct research within veterinary public health, including epidemiology, zoonoses, food safety/meat inspection, disease dynamics, risk assessment or animal welfare.
  • Contribute to interdisciplinary One Health research integrating animal, human and environmental health on population level.
  • Support evidence-based policy and advisory work for authorities.
  • Participate in externally funded research projects.


Within his/her area of expertise, it is expected that in addition the candidate will:
  • Develop and deliver teaching in Veterinary Public Health for example to apply case-based and problem-oriented teaching methods with focus on real-world scenarios in veterinary services.
  • Do research within monitoring of animal welfare issues across the EU.
  • Contribute to teaching across the veterinary curriculum where public health perspectives are relevant.

Your profile
The preferred candidate should demonstrate:
  • The ability to independently conduct research within veterinary public health preferably with an interdisciplinary research profile integrating biological, social and economic aspects in projects
  • Danish authorization as a veterinarian or can achieve it. Experience with Danish conditions is an advantage.
  • Preferably, experience with antimicrobial use at the population level.


3. Tenure track assistant professor or Associated Professor in Veterinary Pathology
We are seeking a candidate with a broad background in veterinary pathology, encompassing both gross and histopathological examinations for diagnostic purposes with a strong interest in developing and innovating teaching within veterinary pathology.

Research tasks
The focus of the position is:
  • General and comparative veterinary pathology, including the mechanisms, diagnosis, and characterization of disease processes across animal species.
  • Diagnostic pathology, encompassing post-mortem investigations, histopathology, and the integration of pathological findings into veterinary practice and meat inspection.
  • Pathological assessment of animal welfare aspects of mortality in livestock


Within his/her area of expertise, it is expected that in addition the candidate will:
  • Teach and supervise students and early-career researchers at bachelor, master, and PhD levels.
  • Conduct research-based advisory work for authorities and have an active role in externally funded research projects.
  • Contribute to the collection and curation of pathological specimens for teaching purposes and reporting of findings to referring veterinarians and animal owners.
  • Contribute to the continued development of the department's digital histopathology teaching platform, TUTOR.
  • Support in the administration and further development of the department's animal donor programme for anatomy and pathology.

Your profile
The preferred candidate should have experience with:
  • Post-mortem examinations, including diagnostic necropsies, case reporting, and communication of findings.
  • Diagnostic histopathology.


Your profle as Tenure Track assistant professor
You are a skilled researcher with a solid background within your specific field of research, and you possess:
  • Documented research qualifications at a high international level
  • Teaching and supervision experience
  • Qualifications for the Tenure-Track assistant professor level at Aarhus University must include postdoctoral training or similar with a relevant research profile and a strong scientific publication record in one or more of the areas of the position you are applying for.

Please refer to the tenure track guidelines for the tenure review criteria and for the tenure review process.

Your profile as Associate professor
You are established as a prominent researcher within your specific field of research, and you possess:
  • The ability to carry out independent and well-organized research work, as well as work as part of an interdisciplinary team.
  • Documented teaching qualifications at a high international level.
  • Experience with project management

In order to be assessed as qualified as associate professor, you must meet the academic criteria as outlined here

How to apply
  • You must indicate the specific position you are applying for by selecting it in the menu. You may only select one position. If you wish to apply for one of the other positions, you must submit a separate application for each position.
  • Please also indicate in your written application which position you are applying for.
  • Furthermore, please indicate whether you are applying for a tenure-track assistant professor position, an associate professor position, or both by ticking the box. .

Who we are
The Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences is well-known for its skilled and very innovative interdisciplinary research environments with a high international impact. We perform world-class research, which contributes with solutions to address essential societal challenges within the green transition; the food production and veterinary medicine – nationally and globally.

The department generates novel research at the highest international level within sustainable food production, the environment, climate, and the health and welfare for animals and humans. The activities form the basis for our research-based public authority consultancy and degree programmes covering bachelor’s, master’s and PhD degree programmes within animal science and veterinary medicine. We offer a lively, engaged and innovative learning and study environment, which is closely integrated with the research environment.

Our department has unique and advanced animal experimental research facilities and technologies located close to the research environment, and a comprehensive national and international research network and strong industrial and professional collaborations.

What we offer
  • A well-developed research infrastructure, laboratories and access to shared equipment and animal experimental facilities.
  • An informal and multicultural research environment with high professionalism and close collaboration and networking activities.
  • A workplace characterised by equality and a good work-life balance, and open discussions across different fields of research.


Living in Denmark
Please visit the international staff https://internationalstaff.au.dk/prearrival/ for information about arriving to and living in Denmark for both the applicants and their potential families.

Area of employment and place of work
The area of employment is Aarhus University (AU), with related departments The place of work is AU Viborg, Research Centre Foulum, Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, Blichers Allé 20, DK-8830 Tjele.
AU Viborg is approximately 10 km from Viborg. You can read more about it here: https://international.viborg.dk/

Contact
For further information, please contact Deputy head of department, Professor Henrik Callesen (henrik.callesen@anivet.au.dk)
or Head of department, Professor Charlotte Lauridsen (charlotte.lauridsen@anivet.au.dk)

Technical Sciences Tenure Track
Aarhus University offers talented scientists from around the world attractive career perspectives via the Technical Sciences Tenure Track Programme. Highly qualified candidates are appointed as Assistant Professors for a period of six years with the prospect of performance- based advancement to a tenured Associate Professorship.

The aim of the Technical Sciences Tenure Track Programme is to:
  • attract outstanding talented individuals that are competitive at an international level
  • to promote the early development of independent research success early in the career of scientists
  • to create transparency in the academic career path

As part of the tenure track position, the candidate is offered:
  • access to research infrastructure
  • capability development, including postgraduate teacher training
  • a mentoring programme
  • support to develop scientific networks and to secure interdisciplinary research at the highest level

As part of the Aarhus University Tenure Track Programme, the University carries out a mid-way evaluation to review the progress of the tenure track candidate after three years, according to the same criteria used in the final tenure review. The final tenure review is conducted after five and a half years. If the review is positive, the candidate will be offered a tenured position as Associate Professor at Aarhus University.

Please refer to the tenure track guidelines for the tenure review criteria and for the tenure review process.

Application procedure
Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the assessment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. The selection is made on the basis of an assessment of who of the candidates are most relevant considering the requirements of the advertisement. All applicants will be notified within 6 weeks whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee and will receive his/her assessment.

Read the full text and apply online

jobs.title: Telineasentaja, rakennustelineet ja sääsuojarakenteet (Helsinki)
jobs.description:
Kiinteistöjen rakennus- ja saneeraustöiden tekeminen laadukkaasti sekä turvallisesti edellyttää tarkoituksenmukaisia teline- ja sääsuojaratkaisuja. Erikoistuminen ja tasokas ammattiosaaminen pitää yrityksen tilauskannan positiivisena seesteisinäkin aikoina ja ympäri vuoden sekä luo kasvupotentiaalia. Etsimmekin nyt telineasentajaa alalla jo vuosikymmeniä toimineen asiakasyrityksemme tehtäviin pääkaupunkiseudulle pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen.

Työt koostuvat rakennustelineiden ja sääsuojarakenteiden / sääsuojien asennus- ja purkutehtävistä. Työt tehdään ryhmässä tai asentajaparin kanssa. Työkohteet sijaitsevat pääkaupunkiseudulla sekä ympäristökunnissa ja niihin tyypillisesti kuljetaan omalla autolla. Työntekijälle maksetaan TES:n mukainen korvaus päivittäisistä matkakustannuksista kotoa työkohteeseen sekä km-korvaus mahdollisista työkohteiden välisistä ajoista. Tekijän asuinpaikasta riippuen useimpiin työkohteisiin pääsee joustavasti myös julkisilla liikennevälineillä.

Työ on arkisin tehtävää päivätyötä klo 7:00 - 15:30, pääasiassa 40 h/vko. Työpäivien pituudessa voi esiintyä jonkin verran vaihtelua. Tehtävässä noudatetaan rakennusalan työehtosopimusta. Palkkaus kokemuksen ja sopimuksen mukaisesti.

Arvostamme hakijassa luonnollisesti kokemusta vastaavista asennustöistä, sillä telineiden ja konsoleiden asennus lujasti ja turvallisesti on ensisijaisen tärkeätä. Otamme haussa huomioon myös alaa kokemattomat tehtävään soveltuvat hakijat. Työssä menestymiseen siivittää halu sekä kyky aktiiviseen ja fyysiseen tekemiseen sekä vastuullinen työote. Oleellista on säilyttää toimintakyky korkeammallakin työskennellessä. Tehtävään annetaan asianmukainen perehdytys ja kollegoiden tuki sekä työhön kuuluvat varusteet.

Tehtävässä voidaan aloittaa pikaisestikin sopivan henkilön löydyttyä kauttamme määräaikaisella vuokratyösuhteella, jonka päätteeksi tekijän on tarkoitus jatkaa vakituisessa työsuhteessa asiakasyrityksessämme pitkäaikaisesti.

Tässä on toimeliaalle tekijälle hyvä työ hyvin hoidetussa ja työntekijöistään välittävässä yrityksessä. Tarjoamme työvaatetuksen, perustasoa kattavammat työterveyspalvelut sekä Clickin oman yhteyshenkilön vahvan tuen.

Haastatteluja tehdään jo hakuaikana, joten täytähän pikaisesti hakemus oheisen linkin kautta. Voit laittaa hakemuksen ja ansioluettelosi myös sähköpostilla. Kerro hakemuksessa mahdollisimman tarkasti osaamisestasi ja aikaisemmasta työkokemuksestasi. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa rekrytointia hoitava rekrytointikonsultti Jan Kollin puhelimitse arkisin klo 9.00-16.00. Puh. 050 411 0390 ja sähköposti on muotoa etunimi.sukunimi@click-hp.fi

jobs.title: Are you studying for an IT degree and looking for a student job where you'll gain hands-on experience with modern workplace technology, cloud services, cybersecurity, and IT operations? Then join us!
jobs.employer: International Council for The Exploration Of The Sea
jobs.description:
We have an exciting opportunity for a service-minded IT student to join our team as a Student Assistant in Copenhagen.

About ICES

The International Council for the Exploration of the Sea (ICES) is an intergovernmental organization which advances marine science and promotes sustainable use of the seas. Our Secretariat is located in central Copenhagen and consists of approximately 85 staff representing more than 30 nationalities.

We are a small, collaborative workplace with an international outlook and a strong focus on learning, innovation, and knowledge sharing.

Your role

As our new Student Assistant, you'll help support the day-to-day IT needs of colleagues across an international workplace. Working alongside four other members of the IT team, you'll gain practical experience with modern workplace technologies while helping ensure that staff can work securely and effectively both in the office and remotely.

Responsibilities
You will help with:

  • IT support and troubleshooting

  • Device setup and user administration

  • Microsoft 365 services and workplace technology

  • Meeting room and conferencing equipment

  • IT improvements, documentation, and security activities

  • Support cybersecurity and compliance activities, including CIS controls, using cloud and Microsoft 365 security solutions.

Who we are looking for

We are looking for a student who has completed at least 3 years of education within IT, computer science, business informatics, technical engineering, or a related field, and who is currently pursuing further studies.

You do not need to know everything already. We are more interested in your curiosity, motivation, and willingness to learn.

For this role, we expect you to have:

  • A strong interest in IT support and workplace technology

  • Good understanding of Windows and Microsoft 365

  • Confidence troubleshooting common technical issues

  • Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken

  • A structured and detail-oriented approach to your work

  • The ability to work independently while also being a strong team player

Experience with Microsoft 365 administration, cloud technologies, device management, cybersecurity, or scripting is an advantage, but not required.

Why join ICES?

At ICES, you'll do more than provide IT support. You'll gain practical experience with modern workplace technology, work closely with experienced colleagues, and help support an international community of staff and scientists. We offer flexible working hours to fit around your studies, along with plenty of opportunities to learn and develop your skills.

Terms of Appointment

This is a paid student role, and the working hours are 15 hours per week. This position will be established with an initial duration of 6 months, with a starting date as soon as possible (preferably January 2027).

Apply Now!

Don’t miss out on this opportunity to kickstart your IT career with us! Submit your application (CV and letter of motivation) by clicking the following link: Student Assistant (IT Support and Cybersecurity) Vacancy - ICES

Deadline for application submission is midnight 28 October 2026.

Questions about the role can be directed to IT Team Lead and Enterprise Architect, Nasrullah Iqbal (nas@ices.dk)

For more information about ICES, please visit our website:  www.ices.dk

jobs.title: SPAR NORD ARENA SØGER BY BANEFORVALTER
jobs.description:
Spar Nord Arena - Aalborg Væddeløbsbane SØGER NY BANEFORVALTER

Da vores nuværende baneforvalter ønsker at gå ned i tid, søger vi en ny til at afløse ham.

Spar Nord Arena – Aalborg Væddeløbsbane er med 40 årlige løbsdage Danmarks mest aktive væddeløbsbane. Vi afvikler både trav- og galopløb på vores 18 ha. store område, og som baneforvalter får du ansvaret for at både vores baner og vores område spiller til såvel løb som træning. Stillingen er fuld tid, og vores nye baneforvalter skal i tæt samarbejde med ledelsen og tre kollegaer der hjælper med at passe bane og område, sikre at vi opretholder et højt niveau på vores sportslige faciliteter og omgivelser.

Dine vigtigste arbejdsopgaver bliver:

·At passe opvisnings- og træningsbaner.

·At foretage reparationer / vedligehold på maskiner og bygninger.

·At passe vores grønne område.

·Øvrigt forefaldende arbejde.

Din profil: Vi lægger vægt på at du har erfaring med traktorer, redskaber og maskiner i almindelighed. Du må gerne have hænderne skruet rigtigt på, så du uden problemer kan udføre løbende reparationer.

Indgangsvinklen til jobbet kan f.eks. være maskinfører, landmand, greenkeeper, vicevært, banemand eller aktiv udøver.

Da vores løb afvikles når andre har fri (aften og/eller weekend), er det et krav, at du kan arbejde på disse dage.

Vi tilbyder: Et godt og stabilt job med frihed under ansvar. En løn som matcher dine kvalifikationer.

Vi ønsker stillingen besat hurtigst muligt, men vi venter gerne på den rette. Da vi afholder samtaler løbende, opfordrer vi dig til at søge stillingen hellere i dag end i morgen.

RAUMA

jobs.title: Perheohjaaja, Lastensuojelun laitospalvelut, Turku
jobs.description:
Tehtäväsi

Työskentelet perheohjaajana Turussa sijaitsevassa lastensuojelun perhekuntoutusyksikössä, joka on osa Varsinais-Suomen hyvinvointialueen omien lastensuojelulaitosten kokonaisuutta.

Perheohjaajana vastaat yhdessä työryhmän kanssa perheiden tilanteen kartoituksesta sekä tavoitteellisesta kuntoutusprosessin mukaisesta työskentelystä. Asiakasperheiden elämäntilanteet ovat usein kriisiytyneitä, ja he tarvitsevat tehostettua lastensuojelullista tukea. Työskentelysi voi tapahtua päivittäin kuntoutusasunnossa perheen arjen rinnalla tai intensiivisesti perheen omassa kodissa.

Työtäsi ohjaavat suhdeperustainen työote, systeeminen ajattelu sekä muutokseen tähtäävä tavoitteellisuus. Hyödynnät työssäsi mentalisaatio- ja kiintymyssuhdeperusteista arviointia ja kuntoutusta.

Toimit osana moniammatillista tiimiä ja laajaa verkostoa, jossa lapsi ja hänen perheensä ovat kaiken työn keskiössä. Vahvistat työssäsi lapsen asemaa ja näkökulmaa perheessä sekä hyödynnät erilaisia työmenetelmiä ja tiimin yhteistä osaamista.

Työpaikan osoite on Kunnallissairaalantie 36, 20810 Turku.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Tarjoamme sinulle merkityksellisen työn lastensuojelun perhekuntoutuksessa, jossa pääset työskentelemään tiiviisti perheiden arjen ja muutoksen tukena.

Saat työsi tueksi säännöllisen työnohjauksen sekä perheterapeutin konsultaation. Työskentelet moniammatillisessa tiimissä, jossa osaamista jaetaan ja kehitetään yhdessä.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Arvostamme hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja, itseohjautuvuutta sekä kykyä kuunnella ja kohdata empaattisesti. Tärkeää on myös valmius ottaa asioita puheeksi rakentavalla tavalla.

Toivomme sinulta kiintymyssuhdeymmärrystä sekä traumasensitiivistä työotetta. Aikaisempi kokemus lastensuojelutyöstä luetaan eduksi.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on soveltuva sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon korkeakoulututkinto tai aikaisempi opistotasoinen tutkinto. Tehtävässä edellytetään hyvää suomen kielen taitoa.

Odotamme hakemustasi - tule mukaan tekemään vaikuttavaa työtä perheiden kanssa!

jobs.title: Diakon
jobs.description:
Karis-Pojo svenska församling lediganslår en diakontjänst. Diakoniarbetarna i församlingen utför klient- och påverkansarbete, uppsökande arbete samt organiserar frivilligverksamheten och den samlande verksamheten inom diakonin. Församlingen utvecklar sitt diakonala arbete bland familjer, barn och ungdomar. Till arbetsuppgifterna hör också själavård, att hålla andakter samt att medverka i gudstjänstliv och i församlingens övriga verksamhet enligt behov.

Vi söker dig som har god samarbetsförmåga och förmåga till självständigt arbete.

Du har intresse och förmåga att arbeta med ungdomar, barn och familjer, att utveckla det diakonala arbetet bland dem samt erfarenhet av och förmåga till självständigt och mångsidigt klientarbete.
Uppgifterna kräver ofta förflyttning mellan församlingens olika områden, tillgång till bil är därför önskvärt. Församlingens arbetsspråk är svenska, men i samarbetet med andra aktörer behövs kunskaper i finska. I klientarbetet behövs också andra språk.

Behörighetskrav är fastställda i kyrkans författningssamling nr 162. Språkkrav enligt kap. 8 §4 i kyrkoordningen. Övriga kunskaper än svenska och finska ses som merit.
Lön utbetalas enligt kravgrupp 503 i KyrkTAK.
Den som utses till tjänsten förväntas vara konfirmerad medlem av den evangelisk-lutherska kyrkan (KL 6 §1).
Till ansökan bifogas meritförteckning samt arbetsintyg.
På tjänsten tillämpas sex månaders prövotid.
Den som väljs till tjänsten skall uppvisa i straffregisterlagens 6 § avsedda registerutdrag samt förete intyg över sitt hälsotillstånd.
Arbetet inleds 4.1.2027 eller enligt överenskommelse.
Ansökan inlämnas senast 3.11.2026.
Sökande ombeds reservera torsdag 5.11.2026 för eventuell intervju.

jobs.title: Asiakkuuspäällikkö
jobs.description:
Etsimme MainosLähde Oy tiimiin asiakkuuspäällikköä, joka haluaa olla mukana kehittämässä asiakkaidemme liiketoimintaa, rakentamassa pitkäaikaisia asiakassuhteita ja luomassa tuloksellisia markkinointiratkaisuja.

Asiakkuuspäällikkönä toimit asiakkaidemme keskeisenä yhteyshenkilönä ja vastaat sekä nykyisten asiakkuuksien kehittämisestä että uusien asiakassuhteiden rakentamisesta. Tehtävässä yhdistyvät asiakkuuksien johtaminen, tavoitteellinen myyntityö, markkinoinnin suunnittelu sekä projektien koordinointi yhteistyössä MainosLähteen asiantuntijatiimin kanssa.

Työskentelet monipuolisesti eri toimialojen yritysten ja organisaatioiden kanssa. Tavoitteenasi on ymmärtää asiakkaidemme liiketoimintaa, tunnistaa heidän markkinointiin ja näkyvyyteen liittyviä tarpeitaan sekä tarjota ratkaisuja, jotka tukevat asiakkaiden kasvua ja liiketoiminnallisia tavoitteita.

Keskeiset työtehtäväsi

**Asiakkuuksien hoitaminen ja kehittäminen**

- Vastaat nimettyjen asiakkuuksien kokonaisvaltaisesta hoitamisesta ja asiakastyytyväisyydestä.

- Rakennat ja ylläpidät pitkäaikaisia, luottamuksellisia asiakassuhteita.

- Tunnistat asiakkaiden liiketoiminnan tavoitteita ja kehität heidän markkinointiaan yhdessä asiantuntijatiimimme kanssa.

- Suunnittelet ja toteutat asiakastapaamisia sekä huolehdit aktiivisesta yhteydenpidosta.

- Tunnistat nykyisissä asiakkuuksissa uusia yhteistyö- ja kasvumahdollisuuksia.


**Uusasiakashankinta ja myyntityö**

- Vastaat aktiivisesta uusasiakashankinnasta ja uusien liiketoimintamahdollisuuksien tunnistamisesta.

- Kontaktoit potentiaalisia asiakkaita ja sovit asiakastapaamisia.

- Kartoitat asiakkaiden tarpeita ja esittelet heille soveltuvia markkinointi- ja viestintäratkaisuja.

- Laadit tarjouksia ja osallistut sopimusneuvotteluihin.

- Viet myyntiprosesseja suunnitelmallisesti eteenpäin ensimmäisestä yhteydenotosta asiakkuuden käynnistämiseen.

- Seuraat omaa myyntityötäsi ja sen tuloksellisuutta.


**Markkinoinnin ratkaisujen suunnittelu ja myynti**

- Osallistut asiakkaiden markkinoinnin tavoitteiden ja kehitystarpeiden määrittelyyn.

- Suunnittelet yhdessä asiantuntijoidemme kanssa asiakkaille sopivia palvelukokonaisuuksia.

- Myyt MainosLähteen palveluita, kuten verkkosivustojen suunnittelua ja toteutusta, hakukoneoptimointia (SEO), tekoälyhakuihin liittyvää näkyvyyden kehittämistä (GEO), Google Ads -mainontaa, sosiaalisen median markkinointia, sisällöntuotantoa, brändäystä sekä valo- ja videotuotantoja.

- Osallistut markkinointikampanjoiden suunnitteluun, tavoitteiden määrittelyyn ja tulosten arviointiin.

- Autat asiakkaita ymmärtämään markkinoinnin eri mahdollisuuksia ja niiden vaikutuksia liiketoimintaan.


**Projektien koordinointi ja yhteistyö**

- Toimit asiakkaan ja MainosLähteen tuotantotiimin välisenä yhteyshenkilönä.

- Huolehdit omalta osaltasi siitä, että asiakasprojektit etenevät sovittujen tavoitteiden, aikataulujen ja budjettien mukaisesti.

- Välität asiakastarpeet ja projektien tavoitteet selkeästi toteutuksesta vastaaville asiantuntijoille.

- Osallistut projektien suunnitteluun, aikatauluttamiseen ja seurantaan.

- Varmistat sujuvan asiakasviestinnän ja laadukkaan asiakaskokemuksen projektien eri vaiheissa.


**Asiakkuuksien ja myynnin tuloksellisuuden seuranta**

- Seuraat asiakkuuksien kehittymistä, myynnin tavoitteiden toteutumista ja asiakastyytyväisyyttä.

- Huolehdit asiakastietojen ja myyntimahdollisuuksien ajantasaisuudesta käytössä olevissa järjestelmissä.

- Osallistut asiakkuuksien kannattavuuden ja palvelukokonaisuuksien kehittämiseen.

- Tuot esiin uusia ideoita ja kehitysehdotuksia MainosLähteen palveluiden sekä toimintatapojen kehittämiseksi.


Millainen rooli sinulla on tiimissämme?

Asiakkuuspäällikön tehtävä on itsenäinen ja vastuullinen, mutta et työskentele yksin. Tukenasi on MainosLähteen markkinoinnin, digitaalisten ratkaisujen, visuaalisen suunnittelun ja sisällöntuotannon osaamista.

Sinun ei tarvitse itse hallita kaikkien markkinointipalveluiden teknistä toteutusta. Tärkeintä on, että ymmärrät asiakkaiden tarpeita, osaat keskustella markkinoinnin mahdollisuuksista ja pystyt rakentamaan toimivia ratkaisuja yhteistyössä asiantuntijoidemme kanssa.

Tehtävässä pääset vaikuttamaan omaan työskentelyysi, kehittämään asiakkuuksia pitkäjänteisesti ja osallistumaan myös MainosLähteen liiketoiminnan kasvattamiseen.

**Työn keskeinen tavoite on luoda kannattavia ja pitkäaikaisia asiakassuhteita, kasvattaa uusasiakashankinnan kautta yrityksen myyntiä sekä varmistaa, että asiakkaamme saavat markkinoinnistaan mahdollisimman paljon hyötyä.**

jobs.title: Kotisiivooja Pyhännälle
jobs.description:
Haluaisitko tehdä merkityksellistä ja joustavaa osa-aikatyötä apua tarvitsevien sympaattisten asiakkaiden, kuten ikäihmisten kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva helpperimme! Olit sitten opiskelija, eläkeläinen tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden, lasten ja oikeastaan ihan kaiken ikäisten apua tarvitsevien kotipalveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys. Tarjoamme iloa ja turvaa asiakkaidemme arkeen ja mottomme on: autamme kuin omaa äitiämme tai isäämme.

Mikä on helpperi? Helpperi on henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua, seuraa ja/tai tukee kodin puhtaanapidossa omaa nimettyä avustettavaa henkilöä, kuten ikäihmistä. Helpperin työ voi sisältää avustajan tehtäviä, kuten asiakkaan tukemista kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilussa, kauppareissuilla, roskien viemisessä tai ihan vain kahvitellen yhdessäolon ja jutustelun merkeissä. Etsimme myös avustajien lisäksi siivooja-helppereitä, joiden työtehtäviin kuuluu ammatillinen kotisiivous ja ikkunanpesu. Ajan myötä helpperistä ja asiakkaasta tulee usein jopa ystäviä työskentelyn myötä.

Helpperin työtä voivat tehdä kaikki yli 18-vuotiaat opiskelijoista eläkeläisiin. Tärkeintä on reipas työote ja aito halu auttaa.

Mitä helpperin työ vaatii? Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa. Avustajan työ ei vaadi muita erityisiä taitoja. Riittää, että haluat viettää aikaa apua tarvitsevien kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa ja helpompaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat myös hyvin joustavat. Siivooja-helppereiltä edellytämme kokemusta puhtaanapidon alalta.

Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä? Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:

- "Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."

- "Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."

- "Hembyn yhteisöön kuuluminen."


Helpperinä saat:

- Oman nimetyn asiakkaan, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana

- Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun tai osa-aikatyön ohelle. Tyypillinen työaika on 1-2 kertaa viikossa muutaman tunnin ajan.

- Kilpailukykyisen tuntipalkan: 13,20-15,98 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset.

- Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro-helpperiksi tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!


Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineer, R&D
jobs.description:
We are looking for aMechanical Design Engineer,R&D, with themain responsibility forfuel injection system and component design. You will join our innovative Fuel Systems team, which is working towards a decarbonised future. The preferred location for this position is Vaasa, Finland, but Turku and Helsinki, Finland are also possible locations. We offer thepossibility of hybrid work.





Your role and responsibilities



As a Mechanical Design Engineer,R&D, your work will include system and component design in NX, light FEM calculations, and design reviews with fuel injection suppliers manufacturing Wärtsilä designs. The role combines design work with collaboration across Testing & Validation, Calculation & Simulation, Service, and supplier networks.



On a typical day, you might start with design activities and finish by supporting testing and validation tasks. While the role requires a high level of independence, you will be supported by experienced experts and the Calculation & Simulation department.



You will work as part of the Fuel Systems team with diverse expertise. The tasks can also be adjusted based on your individual skills and interests.





Your work will focus on these responsibilities:



Create 3D models and detailed drawings


Perform light FEM calculations and support the Calculation & Simulation department


Participate in system and component design activities


Support fuel injection manufacturers during design implementation


Support Testing & Validation activities


Support Service with field experience-related matters


Participate in design reviews with suppliers






To be able to succeed in the position, we expect you to have:



A B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Machine Construction or a similar field


A few years of experience in mechanical design or product development


Experience in or understanding of hydraulics


Experience with NX or similar CAD tools


Good problem-solving skills


A proactive and innovative mindset


Confidence to ask questions and share ideas


Willingness to learn and continuously develop your expertise

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in tumor cell biology
jobs.description:
About the position

A 100% 3-year Postdoctoral Research Fellow position in tumor cell biology is available in the research group of Prof. Philippe Collas, project group of Dr. Marie Rogne, at the Department of Molecular Medicine, Division of Biochemistry, Institute of Basic Medical Sciences, University of Oslo (Collas Lab). The position is funded through the Norwegian Cancer Society.

Within the Institute, the Division of Biochemistry consists of a young and active community of nine research groups working on cancer biology, chromatin and nuclear dynamics, nuclear architecture, membrane trafficking, and adipocyte, muscle and vascular biology, using human, fly and mouse models. 


More about the position

The overall goal of the project is to establish knowledge of the innovative therapeutic potential of microproteins in advanced prostate cancer. In this context, the successful applicant will, in collaboration with the research team and external partners at Oslo University Hospital, examine how specific microproteins regulate the activity of the transcription factor RUNX2, using cancer cell lines and PDX mouse tumor models, for various cell-based assays. The work involves in vivo setups and is expected to necessitate optimizations. 

A postdoctoral position is intended for the employee to develop a research profile and competence that qualifies them to apply for an Associate Professor position. The position may also provide other competencies relevant to the postdoctoral fellow's future career.

A career plan shall be developed for the Postdoctoral Fellow, specifying the competencies the Postdoctoral Fellow should acquire. UiO is responsible for following up on the career plan and ensuring that the Postdoctoral Fellow has access to career guidance throughout the postdoctoral term.


Responsibilities
  • Design and execute PDX prostate cancer studies evaluating the effect of microprotein modulation and peptide therapy, using cell biological approaches.
  • Design and perform cellular assays to test microprotein function and transcription factor modulation.
  • Maintain accurate electronic lab records and contribute to data analysis and interpretation.
  • Present results at group meetings and scientific platforms and prepare manuscripts for publication.

Qualifications

Qualification requirements

  • Applicants must hold a doctoral degree – PhD or equivalent. 
  • If a doctoral degree is not yet awarded, the doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing application date. Hiring will however be contingent on obtention of a doctoral degree. 
  • Solid knowledge of, and experience in, (cancer) cell biology.  
  • Experience in tumor biology.
  • Experience with cell culture and/or patient-derived xenograft (PDX) tumor models.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English. 

Relevant Qualifications

  • Experience with molecular biology and/or epigenetics is positive. 
  • Authorization to work with laboratory animals (rodents) (e.g. LAS301, FELASA C) is a strong advantage. If you do not have such authorization, you will be required to acquire it in the first part of your employment. 
  • Experience with electronic lab-journal systems (e.g. Benchling or E-lab) is valued.

Personal skills
  • You are independent but enjoy working as part of a team towards shared, ambitious goals.
  • You are positive, structured, solution-driven and accurate, with grit and determination.
  • You have a result-oriented mindset and contribute scientific and practical inputs.
  • Communication with other team members is important: you will therefore have excellent communication and collaborative skills. 

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We offer
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • A professionally stimulating working environment and access to top-notch equipment and resources.
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Postdoctoral Fellow, position code 1352 in salary range NOK from 610 000 to 650 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.
  • Oslo’s family-friendly environment with rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities. 

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


Application

Your application should include:

  • Cover letter statement of your research interests and motivation for the position
  • CV summarizing education, positions, and academic work 
  • Copies of educational certificates (academic transcripts only)
  • Copy of relevant certification(s) for laboratory animal work, if this applies
  • List of publications and academic works; do not include the publications themselves or your dissertation. 
  • List of 3 reference persons (name, relation to you, e-mail, phone number) 

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge’s CV form and cannot be submitted only as an attachment. This requirement is intended to ensure correct documentation and record-keeping in accordance with the Public Administration Act, Section 15.

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com 

The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews. 

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian) and Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO.

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

jobs.title: Verkkoinsinööri / Power System Engineer
jobs.description:
Haluatko työskennellä sähköenergia-alan ytimessä ja vaikuttaa siihen, miten sähköverkot suunnitellaan ja miten ne toimivat tulevaisuudessa? Etsimme Power Engineering -tiimiimme verkkoinsinööriä, joka osallistuu uusiutuvan energian sähköverkkoprojektien suunnitteluun ja analysointiin eri puolilla Suomea sekä kansainvälisesti.

Power Engineering -tiimin tehtävä on auttaa asiakkaitamme heidän projekteissaan tuottamalla heille arvokasta informaatio sähköteknisen laskennan, analyysien ja suunnittelun avulla heidän hankkeissaan.

Tässä tehtävässä roolisi mukautuu osaamisesi ja kiinnostuksesi mukaan – voit keskittyä esimerkiksi verkostolaskentaan, tekniseen suunnitteluun tai asiantuntijatukeen projekteissa. Olemme edelläkävijöitä uusiutuvan energian suunnittelussa ja meillä voit rakentaa juuri sinulle sopivan asiantuntijaroolin, jossa voit hyödyntää ja kehittää osaamistasi. Desprolla työnteko ei ole sidoksissa paikkaan, vaan työtä voi tehdä joustavasti etänä tai toimistoiltamme useilla eri paikkakunnilta.



Tehtäväkenttäsi voi painottua eri tavoin – tässä esimerkkejä mahdollisista vastuualueista:

- Sähköverkon laskentojen tekeminen varmistaen verkon tehokkuuden ja luotettavuuden (kuormanjako-, loistehokapasiteetti-, vikavirta-, komponenttien kuormitus- ja mitoituslaskelmat sekä selektiivisyystarkastelut)


- Maadoituslaskelmat, -tarkastelut ja vaarajänniteselvitykset


- Verkkotietomallien ylläpito, kehittäminen sekä laskenta/analysointi


- Laskentatulosten analysointi ja raportointi suunnittelun tueksi

- Dokumentaation laatiminen


- Osallistuminen sähköverkkosuunnittelun kehitysprojekteihin

- Uusiutuvan energian järjestelmä- ja laitetuntemus


- Laskentaohjelmistojen (esim. PowerFactory, openDSS, PSCAD, PSS/E, Safegrid, Cableizer) hallinta

Katsomme eduksi myös oppimishalukkuuden ja sinut perehdytetään työhösi, eli voit hakea työpaikkaa myös, vaikka et vielä osaisi kaikkea edellä mainittua.

jobs.description:
4 chauffører/montører søges – fast makker, egen rute og kundeservice i topklasse!

N & S Transport Denmark ApS søger 4 dygtige og ansvarsbevidste chauffører/montører til levering, indbæring og montering af hvidevarer og TV.

I bliver fordelt på to teams med to medarbejdere i hver 8-pallers liftbil. Vi søger medarbejdere, der kan samarbejde, tage ansvar og sikre, at kunden får en god oplevelse fra ankomst til færdig montering.

Har du allerede en makker, som du arbejder godt sammen med? Så er I meget velkomne til at søge sammen! Du kan også søge alene, så sammensætter vi de rette teams.

Arbejdssted og arbejdstid

• Ruterne starter og slutter i Fredericia.
• Arbejdsdagene er mandag til fredag.
• Mødetid kl. 06.00 med forventet afslutning omkring kl. 15.00. Sluttidspunktet kan variere efter dagens opgaver.
• Forventet opstart den 2. november 2026 – den endelige dato aftales.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Sammen med din makker står du for sikker transport, indbæring, udpakning, placering og montering hos kunderne. Opgaverne omfatter:

• Opstilling og tilslutning af vaskemaskiner.
• Opstilling og tilslutning af opvaskemaskiner.
• Montering af integrerede opvaskemaskiner, herunder tilpasning og montering af frontlåge.
• Montering af integrerede køleskabe.
• Tilslutning af ovne og tørretumblere.
• Lednings- og tilslutningsopgaver, hvor de nødvendige kompetencer og eventuelle autorisationskrav er opfyldt.
• Vending af døre på køle- og fryseskabe.
• Montering af TV på væg, fod og stativ.
• Montering af udsugning/emhætte.
• Kontrol af, at leveringen og monteringen er udført korrekt.
• Registrering af leveringer, billeder og dokumentation i chaufførappen.
• Oprydning og håndtering af emballage samt eventuelle returvarer efter aftale.

Alle monterings- og tilslutningsopgaver skal udføres fagligt korrekt og efter gældende regler og producentens anvisninger.

Vi forventer, at du

• Har praktisk erfaring med levering og montering af hvidevarer og TV og kan arbejde selvstændigt med opgaverne.
• Har gyldigt kørekort til bilen og de nødvendige chaufførbeviser.
• Kan håndtere en liftbil og sikre godset forsvarligt.
• Trives med fysisk arbejde, herunder indbæring på trapper, og bruger hjælpemidler korrekt.
• Er mødestabil, omhyggelig og tager ansvar for både varer, bil og kundens hjem.
• Kan kommunikere med kunderne på dansk og forstå arbejdsinstruktioner.
• Er fortrolig med smartphone, navigation og registrering af leveringer.
• Er løsningsorienteret og bevarer en professionel tone, også når en opgave er krævende.

Vi søger medarbejdere med erfaring fra starten. Beskriv derfor tydeligt, hvilke monteringsopgaver du selv har udført, og hvilke du kan løse selvstændigt.

Vi tilbyder

• Fast kørsel mandag til fredag.
• Arbejde i et fast team med to medarbejdere pr. bil.
• En varieret hverdag med både kørsel, kundekontakt og praktiske opgaver.
• Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter overenskomst.
• En arbejdsplads med direkte kontakt til ledelsen, tæt samarbejde og fokus på kvalitet.

Søg alene – eller sammen med din makker

Send en kort ansøgning og dit CV til info@nstransportdk.dk med emnet: “Chauffør/montør – Fredericia”.

Fortæl os:

• Hvilken erfaring du har med kørsel, hvidevarer og TV-montering.
• Hvilke kørekort og chaufførbeviser du har.
• Hvornår du kan starte.
• Om du søger alene eller sammen med en makker.

Søger I sammen, må I gerne sende én fælles ansøgning med oplysninger og CV for jer begge.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet de rette fire medarbejdere.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Machine Learning Platform Engineer I
jobs.description:
Your Opportunity

We are looking for a Machine Learning Platform Engineer to join Mollie's Machine Learning Platform team, sitting within our broader Data Domain. Our ML Platform empowers Machine Learning Scientists to develop and deploy custom ML solutions at scale across Mollie, serving domains including Risk & Fraud, Payments, Merchant Experience, Financial Services, Go-to-Market, and more. As the central team responsible for Mollie's Machine Learning Platform, we own the maintenance and continuous enhancement of the platform, ensuring it remains reliable, scalable, and fit for production-grade workloads. We work closely with domain teams to bring custom ML models into products, bridging the gap between research and real-world impact, while also designing and developing custom GenAI tooling and platforms for both internal employees and Mollie's customers.

This is a hands-on role where you will spend the majority of your time writing Python and Terraform alongside a team of skilled ML Platform Engineers. Based at Mollie's Lisbon Hub, you will be part of a geographically distributed team spanning Amsterdam and Lisbon, working in a collaborative environment that embraces both remote and hybrid ways of working.

What you’ll be doing

 

As an ML Platform Engineer, you will:

 

  • Collaborate closely with ML Platform Engineers, Machine Learning Scientists, and engineers across Mollie's domain teams to deliver scalable Machine Learning solutions

  • Deploy and operationalize ML models to production in partnership with Machine Learning Scientists, bridging the gap between experimentation and real-world impact

  • Enhance and maintain our cloud-based ML Platform on GCP, writing production-grade Python and Terraform daily

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for ML model training and inference, ensuring reliable and automated workflows across environments

  • Deploy, manage, and scale model serving endpoints on Kubernetes, ensuring low-latency, high-availability inference for production workloads

  • Assist in extending, developing, and hosting custom and open-source AI tooling ; enabling teams to rapidly build and deploy AI-powered solutions.

  • Champion MLOps best practices, implementing standards around model versioning, experiment tracking, data validation, and automated retraining

  • Ensure platform reliability by setting up observability, monitoring, and alerting for both infrastructure and deployed models

  • Maintain and enhance open-source AI tooling hosted at Mollie (such as LiteLLM and LibreChat), and further support and expand our generative AI capabilities.

What you'll bring

  • 1+ year of experience deploying and maintaining ML models in production

  • Good understanding of MLOps principles, including matters such as experiment tracking, reproducibility, pipeline automation, model versioning, and monitoring in production

  • Strong hands-on Python programming skills, with proficiency across common ML and data libraries such as scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, XGBoost, LightGBM, and MLflow

  • Familiarity with at a major cloud platform, preferably GCP

  • Experience with containerization (Docker), with preferred familiarity in container orchestration tools such as Kubernetes and Kubeflow.

  • Strong context-switching ability with sharp attention to detail, adapting quickly to shifting priorities

  • Preferably familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools such as Terraform

  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for ML workflows

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy. If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you.

 

AI at Mollie

We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day.

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.
