jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in Diversity and Ecology of Marine Algae and Protistan Parasites
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a four-year PhD Research Fellow position in the Diversity and Ecology of Marine Algae and Protistan Parasites. The position will be based at the Natural History Museum, University of Oslo, Norway, and affiliated with the national research programme Arctic Ocean 2050 (Polhavet 2050). The successful candidate will also benefit from affiliation with the national graduate research school BIOCORE.

The PhD project will investigate how climate-driven warming is reshaping Arctic microbial eukaryote communities, with a focus on the northward expansion of toxic microalgae and protistan parasites. The successful candidate will join an international research environment and contribute to a better understanding of biodiversity change in the Arctic Ocean. The position includes 25% career-enhancing work, supporting both the museum’s activities and the candidate’s professional development. Depending on the candidate’s interests and the museum’s needs, this work may include collection curation, teaching, supervision, research support, work in the Botanical Garden, or public outreach. The selected candidate will be enrolled in the PhD programme at the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences. Within two months of commencing the position, the candidate must submit a PhD agreement, including a plan for the required doctoral courses and a project description.


More about the position / The PhD project

The Arctic Ocean is expected to undergo a high rate of species turnover as climate-driven changes in habitats, including declining sea-ice cover and rising seawater temperatures, enable new species to expand northward while others decline or disappear locally. These shifts are likely to substantially reorganize Arctic food webs, with cascading effects throughout the ecosystem. This PhD project will investigate how climate-driven warming is reshaping Arctic microbial eukaryote communities, with a focus on the northward expansion of toxic microalgae and protistan parasites, and includes the option to take part in research cruises. The project will use long-read metabarcoding to develop a pan-Arctic, DNA-based biodiversity database with high taxonomic resolution, use existing data and literature to distinguish generalist from specialist taxa, and identify potential entry routes and distribution patterns of the microalgae and parasites as Arctic waters warm. The project will also detect known and novel biological associations, as well as abundance changes in toxic microalgae and protistan parasites. Key findings will be validated against microscopy data collected during research cruises. The position includes translating results into outreach for stakeholders and contributing to predictive policy recommendations. The project therefore offers an exciting opportunity to combine field-derived Arctic samples, advanced molecular and imaging tools, and ecological theory to address emerging questions at the intersection of climate change, biodiversity, and ecosystem functioning.

The position is affiliated with the national research programme Arctic Ocean 2050. The programme brings together 18 Norwegian research institutions in a major interdisciplinary collaboration aimed at strengthening Norway’s knowledge base and strategic capacity in a rapidly changing Arctic Ocean. Its goals are to improve our understanding of the present-day Arctic Ocean and how it may change towards 2050, and develop the knowledge needed for future management, sustainable use, and a safe and secure region. The ten-year programme (2026–2035) combines basic research, applied science, and innovation – offering unique opportunities for professional development and cross-disciplinary collaboration. Arctic Ocean 2050 focuses on processes within the central Arctic Ocean, its interactions with the surrounding seas, and how these dynamics connect to broader climatic and political systems. Field activities will primarily take place in the Eurasian Basin, between Fram Strait and the North Pole, as well as including the adjacent continental slopes. Pan-Arctic perspectives will be ensured through remote sensing, research on broader sociopolitical drivers, and modelling tools that cover the entire Arctic Ocean, and extensive international research collaboration. As part of Arctic Ocean 2050, the candidate will join an ambitious research environment with high societal relevance and the opportunity to contribute to new knowledge on some of the world’s most remote and important ocean regions.

This position is also affiliated with the national graduate research school BIOCORE. Led by Norway’s four university natural history museums, BIOCORE aims to train the next generation of researchers in biodiversity science to address environmental challenges. BIOCORE provides specialised courses and workshops, research and training mobility, regular seminars and networking events, and opportunities to collaborate with non‑academic and policy partners. The successful candidate will become a full member of BIOCORE, and will undertake a funded research secondment at a partner museum and receive support for course‑related travel. The candidate will be connected to a national network of biodiversity researchers, and play an important role in co‑organising BIOCORE’s quarterly webinars as well as the annual Norsk symposium i biosystematikk.

The PhD position will be supervised by Professor Micah Dunthorn, and co-supervised by Associate Professor Adriana Lopes dos Santos, Professor Torsten Struck, and Professor Josefin Titelman at the University of Oslo, and Associate Professor Anna Vader at the University Centre in Svalbard.


Qualifications 

Required qualifications:

  • an MSc degree in metabarcoding, microbiology, biodiversity, bioinformatics, ecology, or a related field
  • excellent written and verbal communication skills in English*
  • experience with analysing large metabarcoding datasets, including the use of different programmes and pipelines
  • experience in molecular laboratory methods

*For English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/EEA countries and exemptions from the requirement, see: https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Desired qualifications:

  • clear alignment between the PhD position and the applicant’s motivation, research interests, and career plans
  • experience working with algae or protistan parasites
  • knowledge of the Arctic marine ecosystem
  • experience working with international collaborators

Grade requirements for admission to the PhD programme:

  • average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor's degree must correspond to C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • average grade point for courses included in the Master's degree must correspond to B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • Master's thesis must correspond to a grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

What are we looking for in you?

Personal Skills:

  • ability to engage constructively and communicate clearly with supervisors, colleagues, project partners, and stakeholders
  • ability to contribute to a supportive, inclusive, and collegial working environment that values diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences
  • strong organisational skills and reliability in managing laboratory, computational, and field-based research tasks

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. 

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We can offer you
  • exciting and meaningful work in an organisation with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development
  • committed colleagues in a good working environment
  • a strong interdisciplinary setting for research, training, and collaboration through the Natural History Museum, Arctic Ocean 2050, and BIOCORE
  • structured onboarding, follow-up, and support throughout the employment period
  • tailored career guidance and opportunities for career-enhancing work, aligned with your individual career goals and relevant both within and beyond academia
  • good welfare schemes
  • membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse (SPK), which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • salary in the position of Doctoral Research Fellow (position code 1017) with a salary ranging from NOK 550 800 - 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2% is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund (SPK)

How to apply

The application must include (as separate and numbered documents): 
1.    cover letter including a statement of motivation and research interests (maximum 2 pages)
2.    CV summarising education, positions, academic work, scientific publications, and other relevant experiences
3.    statement explaining how the PhD position fits into your career plans (maximum 1 page)
4.    MSc thesis (or equivalent) and any published papers directly resulting from the thesis (as a single PDF)
5.    copies of educational certificates and transcripts of records (as a single PDF) 
6.    names and contact details for two to three references (i.e., name, affiliation, relation to the candidate, Email, and phone number)
7.    documentation of English proficiency (if applicable)
8.    statement on the use of AI. If AI was used in preparation of your application document, please detail its use in any documents

Applicants must submit their application and supporting documents through the electronic recruitment system Jobbnorge by clicking “Apply for this job.” Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an interview.

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, you must upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Applicants with education from outside Norway are advised to include an explanation of their university’s grading system. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com 

The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews. 

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Natural History Museum at the University of Oslo is Norway’s largest and most comprehensive natural history museum, with extensive scientific collections and a strong research environment. For nearly 200 years, the museum has collected, studied and preserved specimens of animals, fungi, plants, rocks, minerals and fossils. The museum is located at two sites in Oslo: the Botanical Garden at Tøyen, which is not only popular for recreation but is a scientific collection in itself, and Økern. The museum has a modern DNA laboratory as well as access to the Norwegian Supercomputer facilities.

jobs.title: Cleaner
jobs.description:
**Do you want to do work that matters? Are you customer service-minded and like to see the results of your work right away?** At Siskon Siivous, our cleaners are professionals in cleanliness – they ensure that our customers' facilities are clean and safe.

We are now looking for a cleaner for a health care facility

**What does your workday look like?**

As a cleaner, you are responsible for the cleanliness and safety of the customer's premises. You will follow the agreed instructions and to-do lists to ensure that patient and treatment rooms and waiting rooms meet the required hygiene levels. The work requires special care and precision so that we can do our part to guarantee a high level of patient safety / but don't worry – we will provide you with proper orientation and the necessary training.

**You will succeed in your job if you have:**

- Experience in the cleaning industry

- Good organizational and interaction skills

- A positive service attitude and a responsible approach to work

- Fluent Finnish or English language skills, other language skills are a plus


**Why us?**

With us, you will be given responsibility, but you will not be left alone. Our work community is diverse and fair – we get things done at once. You will receive comprehensive orientation and the opportunity to further your education. In your work, you will be supported by your supervisor and meet your colleagues regularly, e.g. in team meetings. We use high-quality cleaning equipment and environmentally friendly substances.

**Work in a nutshell:**

- **Job location** Hämeenkyrö – please check the location before applying for a job

- **Fixed - term employment:** 16.12.2026 - 28.02.2027


- **Competitive salary** 12,59€/h

- **Weekly working hours** 7 h / week

- **Working hours** are Monday-Friday between 16:00-21:00

- **Honest employer** – we comply with the collective agreement for the facility services sector


**Interested?**

If you recognize yourself in the description, don't hesitate – send your application and join us in doing work that really matters. With us, you will be part of a professional team where cleanliness is not just cleaning – it is safety, well-being and smooth everyday life. Siskon Siivous Oy is a cheerful company founded in 1994, for which it is a matter of the heart to take good care of its employees and offer reliable and high-quality cleaning services to its customers.

jobs.title: Financial Manager
jobs.description:
Me EMU Growth Partnersilla yhdistämme modernilla tavalla tuotetut taloushallinnon ja palkanlaskennan palvelut monipuoliseen valikoimaan neuvonta-, HR-, laki- ja järjestelmäpalveluita. Haluamme luoda alan parhaan asiakaskokemuksen olemalla yrityksille inhimillinen huolenpitäjä ja luotettava suunnannäyttäjä. Ihmiskeskeiset arvot ovat tekemisemme ytimessä ja se näkyy sekä kuuluu jokaisessa päivässä.

EMU jatkaa kasvuaan ja etsimme uusia työkavereita rempseään joukkoomme! EMU on erilaisista taustoista tulevien ihmisten tiivis yhteisö, toimintamme keskiössä ovat EMUlaiset ja asiakkaat. Meitä EMUlaisia on jo reilu 100 kolmessa eri maassa ja haluamme, että meillä on taloushallintoalan paras yrityskulttuuri.

Haemme nyt joukkoomme uutta Financial Manageria!

Onko konsernitilinpäätös sinulle palapeli, jonka ratkaiseminen palkitsee? Kaipaatko työtä, jossa et jumiudu yhden yrityksen kuukausirutiiniin? Silloin tämä rooli voi olla sinulle.

EMUlla työskentelet useammalle erikokoiselle asiakkaalle, kasvuyrityksistä kansainvälisiin konserneihin. Yhtenä päivänä täsmäytät konsernin eliminointeja, seuraavana rakennat kasvuyritykselle ensimmäistä kunnon ennustemallia. Työsi ytimessä on asiakkaidemme konserniraportointi, ja sen rinnalla laajennat business controlling -tehtäviin asiakkaiden tarpeiden ja oman kiinnostuksesi mukaan. Näet talousjohtamista monesta kulmasta ja kehityt samalla.

Työssäsi:

- Vastaat konserniraportoinnista: Laadit kuukausi- ja kvartaaliraportit sekä koordinoit konsernitilinpäätökset ajallaan maaliin.

- Hoidat konsolidoinnin: Huolehdit sisäisistä eristä ja eliminoinneista, valuuttamuunnoksista, vähemmistöosuuksista sekä konsernirakenteen muutoksista.

- Hallitset työkalut ja rakenteet: Rakennat ja ylläpidät konsolidointityökalujen mappauksia sekä raportointirakenteita.

- Koordinoit ja ohjaat: Toimit yhteyshenkilönä konserniyhtiöiden kirjanpitäjille, ja varmistat aikataulujen, sisäisten saldojen täsmäytysten sekä kuukauden sulkemisen sujuvuuden.

- Ennustat ja raportoit johdolle: Teet konsernitason budjetointia ja ennustamista sekä laadit raportteja johdon ja hallituksen päätöksenteon tueksi.

- Kehität ja sparraat: Toimit yhteyshenkilönä tilintarkastajien suuntaan sekä kehität aktiivisesti asiakkaidemme talousprosesseja ja kontrolleja. Automatisoit toistuvan työn ja otat uusia työkaluja, myös tekoälyä, rohkeasti käyttöön.

Odotamme sinulta:

- Vahva tausta konsernilaskennasta: Vähintään 5 vuoden kokemus konserniraportoinnista ja konsernitilinpäätösten laatimisesta sekä vahva osaaminen erityisesti kirjanpitolain (FAS) mukaisesta konsernitilinpäätöksestä.

- Käytännön kirjanpito- ja järjestelmäosaaminen: Vahva kirjanpidon ja tilinpäätöksen käytännön osaaminen sekä kokemus vähintään yhdestä konsolidointityökalusta.

- Koordinointi- ja johtamistaidot: Hyvät koordinointitaidot ja kyky johtaa tekemistä – saat selkeillä ohjeilla, aikatauluilla ja seurannalla useamman yhtiön ja ihmisen toimittamaan oman osuutensa ajallaan.

- Järjestelmällinen ja tarkka työskentelyote: Pidät kokonaisuuden hallussa myös kiireessä. Huomaat, kun luvut eivät täsmää, ja selvität syyn.

- Selkeät viestintätaidot: Viestit sujuvasti ja selkeästi suomeksi ja englanniksi – niin asiakkaan johdolle kuin konserniyhtiöiden tekijöille. Ruotsin kielitaito on plussaa, mutta ei välttämätöntä.

Eduksi katsomme:

- BrightAnalytics-osaaminen

- IFRS-osaaminen

- Tilintarkastus- tai konsulttitausta

- Kokemusta kasvuyhtiöistä

- Vastuullisuusraportoinnin (ESG) tuntemus

Mitä tarjoamme:

- Nykyaikaiset työvälineet ja erinomaiset edut, mm. lounas-, työmatka-, terveys-, hieronta-, liikunta- ja kulttuuriedun sekä kattavan työterveyshuollon.

- Etätyömahdollisuuden ja joustavuuden oman osaamisen kehittämiseen.

- Jäykästä hierarkiasta vapaan työyhteisön.

- Persoonalliset, motivoituneet ja innostuneet kollegat.

- Loistavan työntekijäkokemuksen, jota mitataan ja tutkitaan säännöllisesti.

Työ on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen. EMUlla etätyö ja joustavuus ovat olleet normaaleja tapoja toimia jo pitkään. Etätyön lisäksi olet aina tervetullut EMUn toimipisteille Helsinkiin, Turkuun tai Kajaaniin.

Palkkahaarukka tehtävään on 5000–5700 euroa kuukaudessa osaamisesta ja kokemuksesta riippuen. Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan, mutta toivomme, että voisit aloittaa mahdollisimman pian. Täytämme paikan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, joten lähetäthän hakemuksesi jo tänään!

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Head of CFO Services Matias Helle, matias.helle@emu.fi puh. 0407070299. Tavoitat Matiaksen parhaiten puhelimitse 16.10 klo 9.30-10.30 ja 23.10 klo 10-11 välisenä aikana.

Voit tutustua tuleviin työkavereihin ja EMU-meininkiin EMUn Instagramissa (https://www.instagram.com/emulaiset/) ja EMUun työnantajana verkkosivuillamme (https://emugroup.com/ura-emulla).

jobs.description:
Vaskehjelp søkes – deltidsstilling i Oslo sentrum

Vi søker en pålitelig, selvstendig og ansvarsbevisst vaskehjelp til fast deltidsstilling i Pilestredet Park 21, Oslo sentrum.

Du trenger ikke være profesjonell renholder, men vi forventer at du er grundig, effektiv, selvstendig og ansvarsbevisst.

Hva vi ser etter

  • Erfaring med renhold er en fordel.

  • Selvstendig, grundig og effektiv.

  • Pålitelig og punktlig.

  • Fleksibel ved behov for ekstra arbeidsoppgaver.

  • Kan kommunisere på norsk eller engelsk.

  • Evne til å følge arbeidsrutiner og instrukser.

  • Søkeren må allerede være bosatt i Oslo eller nærområdet og kunne møte fast til arbeid. Stillingen er ikke aktuell som grunnlag for flytting til Oslo Norge

Arbeidsoppgaver

Fast ukentlig renhold -- 4 timer:

  • Renhold av hovedtrapper og baktrapper i en bygning med 5 etasjer.

  • Vask av inngangspartier, korridorer og øvrige fellesarealer.

  • Støvtørking og rengjøring av gelendere, dører og andre berøringsflater.

  • Renhold av et lite kontor.


  • Ekstra renholdsoppgaver ved behov:

  • Vask av kjøkken og garderober.

  • Flyttevask og klargjøring av leiligheter.

  • Andre forefallende renholdsoppgaver i våre eiendommer.

Vi tilbyr

  • Fast deltidsstilling i et etablert eiendomsselskap.

  • Selvstendig arbeid og forutsigbare faste arbeidsoppgaver.

  • Mulighet for ekstra renholdsoppdrag.

  • Lønn etter avtale


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Oslo CityApartments AS er en del av Nordic Group Holding AS, et etablert eiendomskonsern med virksomhet innen eiendomsutvikling, kjøp, salg og utleie av bolig- og næringseiendommer.

jobs.title: Ingeniør bygg/anlegg
jobs.description:
Vi søker deg som har teknisk forståelse, god gjennomføringsevne og evne til å samarbeide med både kunder, leverandører og kollegaer på tvers. 

 

Arbeidsoppgaver: 

  • Prosjekt- og byggeledelse
  • Driftsoppfølging av bygningsmasser, infrastruktur og tekniske installasjoner
  • Oppfølging av kontraktører og leverandører, inkludert anskaffelser
  • Teknisk tegning
  • Utvikling og innovasjon av industriområdet og konsernets forretningsområder

 

Vi ser gjerne at du har: 

  • Teknisk fagskole, bachelorgrad eller annen relevant utdanning. Lang og relevant erfaring kan kompensere for manglende formell utdannelse
  • Relevant erfaring fra prosjektledelse, gjerne innenfor teknisk drift eller eiendomsforvaltning 
  • Gode digitale ferdigheter
  • Erfaring med bruk av AutoCAD eller andre CAD baserte verktøy
  • God kommersiell forståelse
  • Sertifikat klasse B

 

Vi vet at du kanskje ikke har erfaring med alt, men dersom du kjenner deg igjen i flere av punktene så håper vi at du søker. Det er en bred rolle, men vi vil legge til rette for at du kan utvikle deg videre og få bruke dine styrker. 

 

Vi tror du vil trives og lykkes hos oss dersom du er en person som tar ansvar, og arbeider strukturert. Videre at du er serviceinnstilt, løsningsorientert, og kommuniserer godt med ulike interessenter. 

 

Vi tilbyr en spennende rolle i et selskap med stor betydning for lokal utvikling og arbeidsplasser. Du vil få en rolle med varierte arbeidsoppgaver og påvirkningsmulighet. Vi har et godt arbeidsmiljø, og gode velferdstilbud som trimrom, sosiale treff, og hytte på Stranda. Vi tilbyr konkurransedyktig lønn, og gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger. Utover dette er vi også en arbeidsplass med fokus på balanse mellom jobb og fritid. 

 

Spørsmål? Kontakt oss gjerne for mer informasjon om stillingen; Leder Teknisk Marita Jarstad, mobil 992 62 478, e-post marita.jarstad@fjordbase.no, eller Leder HR Marthe Opheim, mobil 466 50 701, e-post marthe.opheim@fjordbase.no.

 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Bli med og utvikle Fjord Base!
Fjord Base AS er en viktig del av Fjord Base Gruppen og er motoren bak utviklingen av Fjord Base i Florø. Med mer enn 1 100 000 m2 areal, 67 500m2 bygningsmasse og 600 meter kai skaper vi en unik arena for vekst, nyskapning og utvikling, med høyt fokus på bærekraft og miljøvennlige løsninger, og er vertskap for over 65 virksomheter.

Vi forvalter, utvikler og bygger fremtidens baseområde, med fokus på bærekraftige løsninger, effektiv drift og god kundeoppfølging. Dette innebærer alt fra utleie av bygg og areal, til utvikling av infrastruktur, teknisk vedlikehold, og gjennomføring av større prosjekter.

Nå søker vi deg som ønsker å bidra til videre utvikling av Fjord Base. Du blir en del av et faglig sterkt team på ni ansatte i Fjord Base AS, og et konsern med rundt 100 ansatte.

jobs.title: Plate fitters, Meyer Turku Oy, Turku
jobs.description:
We are looking for Plate Fitters for the Meyer Turku Shipyard in Turku, Finland. The employment contract will be made directly with Meyer Turku Oy, and StaffPoint will support you throughout the recruitment process. You will have the opportunity to help build some of the world's most impressive cruise ships as part of a community of more than 2,000 professionals.

Summary

Employer: Meyer Turku Oy
Location: Meyer Turku Shipyard, Turku, Finland
Employment Type: Permanent employment
Working Hours: 40 hours per week, willingness to work shifts required
Start Date: As soon as possible
Application Deadline: 8 November 2026
Number of Positions: 2

Job Description

As a Plate Fitter, you will manufacture and assemble steel structures and ship blocks in accordance with technical drawings, quality requirements, and production schedules.

Your responsibilities include:

- Reading technical drawings and work instructions

- Measuring, marking, cutting, bending, and fitting steel plates

- Assembling steel structures and ship blocks and verifying alignments and tolerances

- Tack welding and oxy-fuel cutting as part of the fabrication process

- Identifying and reporting deviations, quality issues, and safety risks

- Collaborating with welders, supervisors, and designers

The work is performed in production halls, around the shipyard area, and outdoors in varying weather conditions. The role includes working at heights and in confined spaces while always using the required personal protective equipment.

What We Expect from You

- Experience as a plate fitter, ship plate fitter, steel structure assembler, or in a similar role

- Ability to read technical drawings and work within specified tolerances

- Experience in steel plate processing, structural assembly, and the use of measuring equipment

- Safe working practices and a careful, proactive approach to work

- Ability to work independently and as part of a production team

- Readiness to work indoors and outdoors, at heights, and in confined spaces

- Ability to communicate in either Finnish or English regarding work-related matters

Relevant education in metalwork, manufacturing technology, or shipbuilding supports success in the role; equivalent competence may also be demonstrated through work experience.

The following are considered an advantage:

- Experience in shipbuilding or shipyard environments

- Experience in ship block construction

- Tack welding and oxy-fuel cutting skills

- Valid safety and professional certifications

What We Offer

- Direct employment with Meyer Turku Oy and the opportunity to work at the forefront of shipbuilding

- A challenging and varied plate fitter position alongside experienced professionals

- A work community where everyones contribution is essential to achieving shared goals

- Wellbeing and sports benefits, as well as support from the shipyards own occupational healthcare center

How to Apply

Submit your application and CV no later than 8 November 2026.

In your application, please describe:

- The types of steel structures or ship blocks you have assembled

- The materials, material thicknesses, and measuring tools you have worked with

- Your experience in tack welding and oxy-fuel cutting

- Your earliest possible start date

We review applications on an ongoing basis and make hiring decisions as soon as suitable candidates are found.

The selection process includes:

- StaffPoint interview

- Meyer Turku interview

- Verification of qualifications

- Medical examination and drug test

- Shipyard access permit and onboarding process

The selected candidate must provide a negative drug test result and be assessed as fit for the position in the occupational health examination.

Contact Information

Siiri Tietäväinen
Recruitment Consultant
siiri.tietavainen@staffpoint.fi
+358 44 420 4427

About Meyer Turku and StaffPoint

Meyer Turku Oy builds some of the world's most advanced and energy-efficient cruise ships, car ferries, and special-purpose vessels. The company holds approximately 17% of the global cruise shipbuilding market. Its largest customers include Royal Caribbean and the Finnish Border Guard.

Meyer Turku employs more than 2,000 professionals at the Turku shipyard, where ships have been built since 1737. Its subsidiaries include: Piikkio Works Oy, a cabin manufacturing facility in Piikkiö, Shipbuilding Completion Oy, providing turnkey solutions for ship public spaces, ENGnD Oy, a shipbuilding and offshore engineering company located in Rauma

Meyer Turku continuously strives toward more sustainable shipbuilding. The company has identified five UN Agenda 2030 Sustainable Development Goals where it can make a significant impact through its operations and cooperation with customers and partners.

StaffPoint is a Finnish HR services company and acts as Meyer Turkus recruitment partner in this hiring process.


Meyer Turku

Meyer Turku Oy rakentaa maailman uudenaikaisimpia ja energiatehokkaimpia risteilyaluksia, autolauttoja ja erikoisaluksia. Turun telakalla on rakennettu laivoja vuodesta 1737 lähtien.

Meyer Turun telakalla työskentelee yli 2 000 ammattilaista ja telakalla on yli 450 eri ammattia. Jokaisen työpanosta tarvitaan yhteisen päämäärän saavuttamiseen.

jobs.title: Welders, Meyer Turku Oy, Turku
jobs.description:
We are looking for welders for the Meyer Turku Shipyard. The employment contract will be made directly with Meyer Turku Oy, and StaffPoint will support you throughout the recruitment process. This is your opportunity to help build some of the worlds most impressive cruise ships, working with demanding steel structures.

Summary

Employer: Meyer Turku Oy
Location: Meyer Turku Shipyard, Turku, Finland
Employment Type: Permanent employment
Working Hours: 40 hours per week, willingness to work shifts required
Start Date: as soon as possible
Application Deadline: 8.11.2026
Number of Positions: 2

Job Description

As a welder, you will join steel components and structures using approved welding methods in accordance with technical drawings, Welding Procedure Specifications (WPS), and quality requirements.

Your responsibilities include:

- Welding steel structures and components and preparing joint surfaces

- Reading technical drawings and welding symbols

- Checking welding parameters and following WPS instructions

- Performing visual inspections of your own work and identifying and reporting welding defects

- Grinding, finishing, and approved repair work

- Cooperating with platers, supervisors, and inspectors

The work is performed in production halls, around the shipyard area, and in dry docks, including outdoor environments in varying weather conditions. The role requires working at heights, in confined spaces, and in different welding positions while always using the required personal protective equipment.

What We Expect From You

- Experience in welding within industry, shipbuilding, offshore projects, or construction

- Hands-on experience with the welding process required for the role

- Ability to read technical drawings and work according to WPS and quality requirements

- Ability to inspect your own welds and recognize common welding defects

- Strong commitment to safety and quality

- Readiness to work indoors and outdoors, at heights, and in confined spaces

- Ability to communicate in either Finnish or English regarding work-related matters

Experience in shipbuilding or heavy steel structures, proficiency in multiple welding processes, and relevant vocational education in metalworking or welding are considered advantages.

Welding Skills and Qualifications

Approved welding methods may include:

- MIG/MAG

- TIG

- FCAW

- MMA

The exact welding process required will depend on the project.

Main Requirements

- Welding process: primarily 136 and 138

- Base material and thickness range: primarily carbon steel, 5 mm to 60 mm

Please attach copies of any available welding certificates to your application. The certificates will be reviewed for:

- Welding process

- Base material

- Material thickness range

- Welding positions

- Joint type

- Validity of certification

What We Offer

- Direct employment with Meyer Turku Oy

- Opportunity to work at the forefront of global shipbuilding

- Challenging and diverse welding tasks alongside experienced professionals

- A work community where everyones contribution is essential to achieving common goals

- Employee wellbeing and sports benefits, as well as support from the shipyards own occupational healthcare center

How to Apply

Submit your application and CV no later than 8.11.2026.

In your application, please describe:

- Welding processes you have used

- Materials and thicknesses you have welded

- Welding positions and joint types you are familiar with

- Your experience with WPS documentation and technical drawings

- Your valid welding certifications

- Your earliest possible starting date

We review applications on an ongoing basis and make hiring decisions as soon as suitable candidates are found.

The selection process includes:

- StaffPoint interview

- Meyer Turku interview

- Verification of qualifications

- Medical examination and drug test

- Shipyard access permit and onboarding process

The selected candidate must pass a drug test and be declared fit for the position through the occupational health assessment.

jobs.title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a member of our Security Operations Team, you will collaborate with a global team of engineers to monitor and respond to security events, lead security incidents as Incident Commander, and lead digital forensic investigations in support of Employee Relations, Legal, Compliance, or Information Security cases.

Although you will be focused on security incident response, you will also have the opportunity to create and maintain runbooks, and automated workflows, and assist in process refinement and implementation. You will collaborate with a diverse team of engineers, and key stakeholders on security initiatives across the company. Above all, your focus is bringing Security expertise to the table in a collaborative, humble, and practical manner.

Location: This role is open to candidates residing in Netherlands

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will: 

  • Monitor security events and provide technical analysis on alerts
  • Lead information security incidents and employee insider investigations by developing the incident response strategy, lead the execution through incident closure, while providing incident updates to key stakeholders throughout the incident
  • Deliver security guidance clearly and concisely for incident response and insider threat initiatives
  • Coordinate the building of services, capabilities, integrations, and implementations of technologies to support security operations, incident response, and insider threat
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Participate in our on-call rota covering weekends

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years of experience in Security Incident Response
  • Ability to communicate investigative findings and strategies to technical staff, executive leadership, and legal
  • Ability to build scripts or tools to support Samsara's investigation processes, with proficiency in Python
  • Mentor and train security operation engineers on data collection, analysis, and reporting technical analysis
  • Practical experience acting as a lead during security incident response, including monitoring and triaging alerts, and coordinating across teams
  • Understanding of analysis and forensics techniques on macOS, Windows, and Linux
  • Experience utilizing SIEM tools to perform log reviews
  • Experience in cloud architecture and security (AWS, GCP) and cloud-based services
  • Participation in an on-call rotation, with the potential to work outside standard business hours, including late evenings, when responding to high-severity incidents as part of our global incident response team.
  • This role will be part of our EMEA so your hours will be aligned to the UK. As an operational time you may be expected to work flexible hours around this to support the load of the team

An ideal candidate also has:

  • 2+ years of experience working on insider threat initiatives or employee investigations
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field - or relevant industry experience
  • GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH) or similar Certification
  • Familiarity with common security frameworks and standards, including NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001, FedRAMP

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.title: Director, Global Operations Excellence
BDR Talent Programme (Amsterdam)
jobs.description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

About the Programme

This is a structured 18–24 month global programme designed to launch high-potential commercial careers. You don’t need prior sales or payments experience; what you need is ambition, curiosity, resilience, and the drive to build relationships and solve complex problems.

You will join a global cohort of Business Development Representatives (BDRs) with structured learning, dedicated coaching from sales leaders, and real commercial responsibility from month one. Throughout the programme, you will master enterprise sales: researching strategic accounts, engaging senior decision-makers, conducting sharp discovery conversations, and building pipeline that drives real business growth.

High performers transition into Sales, Account Management, and other commercial roles across the business. Many of our top commercial leaders, including our Chief Revenue Officer, started their journey at Checkout.com as BDRs or interns. Whether you are a recent graduate, an early-career professional with 1–3 years of experience, or a career switcher, what matters most is your hunger to learn and achieve.

What You’ll Do

  • Research Strategic Accounts: Identify high-value targets by researching key organizations, industries, and executive stakeholders.

  • Initiate High-Impact Outreach: Open doors with senior decision-makers using personalized outreach across email, phone, and LinkedIn.

  • Build Qualified Pipeline: Drive consistent growth momentum through disciplined prospecting, rigorous follow-up, and account mapping.

  • Run Consultative Discovery: Uncover merchants' technical and business challenges to align Checkout.com’s solutions with their goals.

  • Partner on Live Deals: Work alongside Sales Representatives to support opportunities through to deal execution.

  • Leverage AI & Modern Tech: Use CRM, intent data, and approved AI tools to streamline research, refine outreach, and work smarter.

Who We’re Looking For

We welcome applications from recent graduates and professionals with 1–3 years of experience looking to change careers. Regardless of your background, we are looking for the following core skills to set you up for success:

  • Driven & Goal-Oriented: You set high personal standards, work hard, and stay motivated when tackling challenging commercial goals.

  • Resilient & Adaptable: You bounce back quickly from rejection, view obstacles as practice, and maintain consistent output.

  • Relational & Engaging: You genuinely enjoy starting conversations, asking sharp questions, and building trust with diverse stakeholders.

  • Track Record of Achievement: You demonstrate drive and ownership through professional, academic, athletic, or entrepreneurial success.

  • Commercial & Tech Curiosity: You are eager to learn complex fintech products and use AI and sales tools to work smarter.

  • Coachability & Clear Communication: You listen well, articulate ideas clearly, and actively apply feedback to improve performance.

What You’ll Get Out of It

A 2-year structured programme that ensures you have a successful career in sales. A clear progression pathway built around key pillars:

  • Fintech & Enterprise Sales Mastery: Build deep expertise in global payments, digital commerce, and complex deal execution alongside experienced Account Executives.

  • AI-Native Commercial Skills: Master modern sales tools, intent data, and AI to automate routine tasks and focus on high-impact prospecting.

  • Coaching & Leadership Growth: Receive 1:1 mentorship from sales leaders, earn certifications, and take on senior BDR responsibilities, from mentoring peers to working on live deals through pricing and signing

  • Direct Career Acceleration: Graduate with a tight-knit global network and a direct pathway into Account Executive, Account Management, or Commercial Strategy roles.

Want to Stand Out?

When we review your CV, ensure you show us why you're great for this role. Ensure and share something you’ve built, led or achieved, whether that’s hitting a target, launching a side project, or leading a team effort.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

  • Who should apply? Recent graduates, early-career professionals (1–3 years experience), and career changers with strong commercial drive.

  • When does the programme start? We have start dates in March and September 2027.

  • What is the application deadline? Apply early for the best chance of being reviewed. We will close once we receive a sufficient number of applications.

  • Where are the roles located? We have roles in London, New York, Barcelona, Amsterdam, Riyadh, Dubai, and Shanghai.

  • Do I need a second language? Fluent English is required. Specific local language proficiency may be required depending on the hiring region.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

jobs.title: International Supply Chain Manager (m/f)
jobs.description:
International Supply Chain Manager
Luxembourg
Full time
R69674

Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We're working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!
Join our Luxembourg team where your expertise directly contributes to humanity's greatest adventure, while maintaining the work-life harmony that makes great engineering possible. Be part of a collaborative, inclusive culture where safety and technical excellence drive every decision as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight from the heart of Europe.
At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We're working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!
As part of a hardworking team of supply chain professionals, technicians, and engineers, you will play a crucial role in ensuring our organization adheres to all relevant regulations, develops automated compliance reports, and educates our teams on designing compliant processes. The International Supply Chain Manager manages relationships with non-US external vendors and suppliers, ensuring contractual obligations are fulfilled while protecting the organization's interests, maintaining compliance, and optimizing.

Special Mentions:

Relocation provided
Travel expected up to 25% of the time
Interviews may will include a technical assessment

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Global Supplier Development & Relationship Management

Identify, evaluate, and onboard suppliers across international markets based on quality, capacity, reliability, and cost
Build and nurture cross-cultural business relationships that respect regional practices and communication styles
Monitor supplier performance against KPIs and implement improvement strategies across global operations

International Contract & Financial Management

Negotiate and administer agreements compliant with multiple legal jurisdictions and international standards
Leverage global market intelligence to secure optimal pricing while balancing quality and risk
Manage currency fluctuations, payment terms, and financial controls across international transactions
Maintain comprehensive documentation of all contract activities and changes

Global Compliance & Risk Mitigation

Ensure adherence to international trade regulations, export/import laws, and country-specific requirements
Identify and address risks unique to global procurement (political instability, logistics disruptions, trade disputes)
Implement appropriate risk management strategies through contract terms, insurance requirements, and contingency planning
Coordinate quality assurance across international suppliers to maintain consistent standards

Global Supply Chain Optimization

Manage international logistics, customs clearance, and documentation requirements
Implement efficiency improvements in global procurement processes and inventory management
Generate performance analytics on international supplier metrics and compliance reporting
Stay informed about international market trends and regional business conditions that impact supply chain decisions

Strategic Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with legal, finance, engineering, and logistics teams across global operations
Align international procurement activities with organizational objectives and program requirements
Facilitate effective communication between international suppliers and internal stakeholders
Serve as subject matter expert on global sourcing strategies and international supply markets

Minimum Qualifications:

Education: Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, international business, or related field
Experience: 5+ years in international procurement or supplier management
Language Skills: Proficiency in multiple languages relevant to key supplier regions
Knowledge: Understanding of international trade laws, customs regulations, and global logistics
Travel Capability: Willingness to travel internationally (typically 20-30%)
Cultural Competence: Demonstrated ability to work effectively across cultures and business environments
Technical Skills: Proficiency with global procurement systems and international payment platforms
Domain Expertise: Engineering, Manufacturing or Procurement experience across multiple aerospace domains and commodities

Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelors degree and/or previous working experience as an Engineer, Apprentice or Technician
Experience working in a multi-cultural environment with both internal and external customers and stakeholders
Experience with ISO 9001, AS9100, or other quality management systems in aerospace
Fluent in multiple languages

Culture Statement

Don't meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right
candidate for this or other roles.

Criminal Record Check

Given the nature of the work we do at Blue Origin, which allows access to sensitive and proprietary information of our company and customers, please be aware that, in accordance with the amended law of 29 March 2013 on the organisation of criminal records, the selected candidate will be requested to provide an extract from the criminal record (bulletin n°3)

We're committed to building the road to space so our children can build the future. We are a mission-driven company focused on ideas and innovation, and encourage fresh perspectives from bold voices. At Blue, our team is building the future as their unique selves. Thank you for your interest in working at Blue Origin

jobs.description:
International Private Bank Managed Investments Platform – Product Owner, Vice President, Luxembourg

• Job Identification 210784789
• Job Category Product Management
• Business Unit Asset & Wealth Management
• Locations 6 route de Treves, Building H, Senningerberg, Luxembourg, L-2633, LU

• Job Shift Day

Job Description

Build the platform that helps advisors deliver exceptional investment experiences for clients around the world. You'll own meaningful outcomes—turning user needs into scalable product capabilities that improve proposals, portfolio implementation, and ongoing servicing. You'll grow your product leadership through mobility, mentorship, and exposure to senior stakeholders across business, technology, and control partners. You'll join a collaborative team that values curiosity, accountability, and inclusive problem-solving. If you're energized by complex challenges and tangible impact, you'll thrive with us.

As a Product Owner (Vice President) in the International Private Bank Managed Product team, you will shape and deliver enhancements to our managed investments platform that supports advisors, portfolio managers, and partners globally. You'll translate user needs into a clear roadmap and actionable delivery plans, balancing scalability, resiliency, and stability. You'll work with us in a fast-paced, partnership-driven culture where you can influence outcomes and learn from diverse perspectives. Together, we'll improve the tools and workflows that help teams serve clients with excellence.

Job responsibilities

• Partner with advisors, portfolio managers, and stakeholders to understand investment workflows and prioritize platform opportunities
• Collaborate with business stakeholders, technology and operations partners to deliver resilient, scalable, and stable platform capabilities
• Lead discovery activities, including user research and journey mapping, to define problems and validate solutions
• Define product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned to business outcomes and user needs
• Translate requirements into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized backlogs for delivery teams
• Use data, performance metrics, and qualitative feedback to inform prioritization and design decisions
• Facilitate cross-functional decision-making and align stakeholders across multiple initiatives and timelines
• Communicate progress, dependencies, and trade-offs through clear updates and governance routines
• Identify risks and issues early and escalate appropriately to keep delivery on track
• Drive continuous improvement across product processes, controls, and user experience

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

• Demonstrated experience owning a digital product or platform from discovery through delivery
• Proven ability to build and manage a product roadmap and translate strategy into measurable outcomes
• Strong capability to gather requirements, write user stories, and manage a prioritized backlog
• Experience partnering cross-functionally with technology, operations, and business stakeholders to deliver outcomes
• Ability to navigate ambiguity, competing priorities, and tight timelines while maintaining high standards
• Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics for different audiences
• Comfort presenting to and influencing senior stakeholders through structured updates and clear recommendations
• A collaborative, inclusive working style and commitment to shared team success

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

• Experience supporting wealth management or private banking investment workflows (proposals, portfolio implementation, servicing)
• Knowledge of investments products, platforms, or related operating models
• Experience contributing to platform modernization or strategic transformation initiatives
• Experience working across multiple regions and time zones with globally distributed partners
• Background partnering with risk, controls, and governance functions within a regulated environment

jobs.title: Human Resources Intern (m/f)
jobs.description:

Human Resources Intern
Bascharage - Luxembourg
Oct 08, 2026
Full time
R2026-3997

Are you looking for an internship where no two days are the same and where you can discover the many facets of Human Resources? Join our Luxembourg HR team and gain hands-on experience in an international environment where your ideas, curiosity and initiative will be valued.
You will take ownership of day-to-day absence administration while contributing to a broad range of HR activities, including employee communication, engagement events, training, recruitment and HR projects. As your confidence grows, you may also lead selected initiatives from idea to implementation and, if you are interested, gain exposure to payroll preparation.
This internship is designed as a genuine learning experience: you will work closely with an experienced and collaborative HR team, interact with employees and managers, and see how HR supports both people and the business.

Key responsibilities

• Track and follow up on employee absences, including sickness, parental and maternity leave, holidays, business trips, training and other leave types.
• Maintain accurate and up-to-date HR data in the relevant systems and trackers, and complete routine data entry activities on time.
• Collect, check and file employee documents, ensuring records are complete, well organized and handled confidentially.
• Respond to day-to-day employee questions, provide guidance on HR processes and escalate sensitive matters when required.
• Draft employee communications, practical guides, presentations and intranet content, and support their review, formatting and publication.
• Help organize employee events and engagement initiatives, coordinating communications, suppliers and on-site logistics.
• Support training activities, including registrations, coordination with employees, managers and providers, session logistics, attendance records and follow-up documentation.
• Support recruitment and onboarding by preparing job postings, screening applications, scheduling interviews, coordinating with candidates and interviewers, and welcoming new hires.
• Contribute to HR projects, process improvements and digitalization initiatives; depending on scope and readiness, independently lead selected projects.
• The scope of the internship may evolve over time based on business needs as well as the intern's skills, interests, initiative and readiness to take on new challenges.

What we're looking for

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, Psychology, Communication or a related field.
• Organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage recurring administrative activities accurately and meet deadlines.
• Curious, proactive and comfortable suggesting ideas, improving ways of working and taking ownership of tasks.
• Interpersonal and written communication skills, with an interest in supporting employees and working as part of a team.
• Able to handle personal information with discretion and maintain confidentiality.
• Comfortable using Microsoft Office; good Excel and PowerPoint skills are an advantage.
• Fluent in English; French or German is an advantage. Any additional language is welcome.
• Previous HR experience is not required—we are looking above all for motivation, reliability and the willingness to learn.

What you will gain

• Practical experience across HR operations, employee engagement, learning and recruitment—not just observation.
• Real responsibility, regular feedback and the opportunity to develop project ownership.
• Exposure to an international business and a broad understanding of how an HR team operates day to day.

• Inclusion - We value diversity in people, ideas, and experiences.

jobs.description:
Senior Relationship Manager - Private Banking - Belgian Market (M/F)

Luxembourg | req1177

Founded in 1856, Banque Internationale à Luxembourg is the oldest multi-business bank in the Grand Duchy. From its foundation, the BIL has always played an active role in the development of the Luxembourg economy. It currently operates in retail, private and corporate banking, as well as on major capital markets. Employing more than 2 000 people, BIL is present in the financial hotspots that are Luxembourg, Switzerland, and China.

As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

Your next challenge:

You will be responsible for acquiring and building relationships with new clients and intermediaries from Belgium. The position is based in Luxembourg.

What will you do?

• Join a multidisciplinary team and participate in a growth strategy in a core market.
• Develop your business plan and use all the capabilities that BIL offers to gradually create your own client portfolio.
• Attend and coordinate events (seminars, conferences) as needed to develop your own portfolio.
• Conduct research to identify business opportunities with new clients.
• Build and establish long-term, trusting client relationships.
• Maintain an in-depth knowledge of current market conditions to detect and/or anticipate potential business opportunities for clients.
• Collaborate across business lines to help you develop new business leads and ensure excellent after-sales service to guarantee client satisfaction.
• Use the internal CRM to track your business development activities.

Your skills:

You have:

• A proven track record in Wealth Management, as a Relationship Manager  
• A strong network of private customers and financial intermediaries in Belgium
• An excellent knowledge of the products and services that Belgian private customers and financial intermediaries typically require (asset management, wealth planning, financing solutions)
• Excellent interpersonal skills, an entrepreneurial spirit and the ability to build sustainable relationships
• Proven negotiation skills and the ability to close deals
• A high level of integrity and ethics
• A relevant University background in Finance
• CFA / CAIA / CISI or other related financial certifications are seen as an advantage

You are:

Senior Financial Crime Compliance Officer (CDI)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   (Ref:MIBLSFCCO_092026)

About the Role

The role focuses on coordinating the collection, consolidation, and analysis of compliance information, performing oversight reviews, assessing compliance governance arrangements, and supporting the implementation and maintenance of effective compliance and reporting frameworks across the organization.

Responsibilities

• Coordinate the collection, consolidation and analysis of compliance information received from affiliated entities and internal stakeholders for governance, oversight, and reporting purposes.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Law, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

jobs.title: Contrôle de Gestion / Chargé(e) de Pilotage Commercial - AXA Luxembourg - CDI (m/f)
jobs.description:
Contrôle de Gestion / Chargé(e) de Pilotage Commercial - AXA Luxembourg – CDI

Notre environnement de travail

Fière d'appartenir au Groupe AXA, une marque d'assurance internationale et un leader mondial des services financiers, la société AXA Assurances Luxembourg est un acteur majeur du secteur des assurances au Grand-Duché.
Nous aidons nos clients à traverser les petites et grandes difficultés de la vie. Chaque jour, nous agissons ensemble pour inventer la meilleure manière de les protéger et voulons donner à chacun les moyens de vivre une vie meilleure.
Un challenge qui donne le sourire et envie de se lever le matin !

Chez AXA, nous sommes persuadés que pour bien prendre soin de nos clients, nous devons commencer par bien prendre soin de nos collaborateurs. C'est pour cette raison que nous menons une politique RH engagée qui favorise la diversité, qui préserve l'équilibre vie privée-vie professionnelle et accompagne le développement des compétences et des carrières.
Quelle que soit l'équipe que vous rejoignez au sein de notre organisation, certaines choses sont vraies pour nous tous : une culture forte fondée sur la confiance, le respect et où nous sommes bienveillants les uns avec les autres, parce que c'est la meilleure façon d'être les meilleures versions de nous-mêmes. Nous cherchons toujours à attirer des talents dans notre entreprise, tout en continuant à développer notre personnel existant.
  
Vos missions

Au sein du département Finance d'AXA Assurances Luxembourg S.A., la fonction est rattachée au service Contrôle de gestion et Pilotage Commercial. Votre rôle consiste à participer au suivi et au pilotage de l'activité commerciale.

Dans ce rôle, vous serez amené(e) à :

Responsabilités récurrentes :

• Définir les objectifs de chiffre d'affaires des points de vente, en cohérence avec le plan stratégique de la société.
• Assurer le suivi mensuel de la performance commerciale, au niveau total, par réseau de distribution, par point de vente et par ligne de business : chiffres d'affaires, nouvelles affaires, chutes, taux de rétention, prime moyenne.
• Analyser les variations par rapport aux objectifs et par rapport à l'année précédente, en coordination avec la Direction Commerciale, en comprendre la cause et définir des plans d'actions adéquats pour sécuriser la réalisation des objectifs.
• Définir les actions commerciales dites « challenges » en coordination avec la Direction Commerciale : définir les critères en cohérence avec les priorités du plan stratégique, en prenant en considération les aspects de disponibilité des informations, de communication fluide et transparente avec les réseaux et les contraintes de compliance.
• Assurer le suivi des actions commerciales, notamment mesurer la performance commerciale (taux de conversion, etc).
• Suivre la rentabilité des points de vente en coordination avec l'actuariat business et notamment, calcul de l'intéressement technique pour les points de vente concernés.

Responsabilités ad-hoc :

• Mener des analyses ciblées, à la demande et en conjonction avec la direction commerciale, par exemple sur le taux de multi-détention, l'impact d'une campagne marketing sur le chiffre d'affaires…etc
• Participer aux réflexions et mesures d'impact en cas de modification des conventions et des schémas de rémunération des intermédiaires, en étant vigilant et critique face aux contraintes règlementaires et à l'enjeu de rester attractif pour nos clients & intermédiaires.

Assurer un lien continu entre les Directions Finance et Commerciale :

• Favoriser une culture financière au sein de la Direction Commerciale en apportant un angle financier aux réunions de suivi commercial en fournissant aux ARMAs les outils et tableaux de bord nécessaires à l'animation du réseau. Le cas échéant, organiser des formations ciblées.
• Analyser la performance commerciale, à la lumière des informations remontées du terrain.

Assurer un lien avec la Direction IT / Equipe Data :

• Solliciter la Direction IT / Equipe Data pour la production des rapports et des extractions nécessaires à l'exécution des missions.
• Veiller à la qualité des données mises à disposition des équipes commerciales et des intermédiaires, notamment les données de rémunération des intermédiaires.
• Mise en place de contrôles et de réconciliations avec les reportings Finance.

Votre profil  

• Vous êtes titulaire d'un master à orientation économique, en mathématiques ou statistiques.
• Vous bénéficiez d'une expérience de 3 à 5 ans au sein d'une Direction Finance ou d'une Direction Commerciale. L'expérience dans le secteur financier ou assuranciel représente un atout.
• Vous maitrisez Excel et les outils de bases de données.
• Vous manifestez une forte appétence, à la fois commerciale et pour l'analyse et les chiffres. Vous manifestez une aisance pour manipuler, synthétiser et expliquer les chiffres.
• Vous avez une fibre commerciale et une excellente orientation client.
• Vous possédez d'excellentes capacités à travailler en équipe avec plusieurs Directions.
• Vous travaillez en autonomie et vous bénéficiez d'une excellente capacité d'organisation.
• Vous maîtrisez le français et l'anglais.

Vos avantages

Vous avez envie de mettre votre énergie et votre talent au service de nos clients et de la société dans son ensemble ? Faites partie de notre grande famille en rejoignant :

• Un cadre stimulant où la formation continue permet sans cesse d'enrichir ses compétences et développer son employabilité ;
• Une entreprise très attachée à la qualité de vie au travail de ses salariés et qui offre de nombreux avantages collaborateurs (télétravail, programme de Well-being et santé, activités sportives en dehors du temps de travail, 35,5 jours de congés, etc.) ;
• Une entreprise responsable menant une politique volontaire pour reconnaître et valoriser les différences individuelles dans un environnement de travail inclusif ;
• Une compagnie où sont organisés des événements culturels, sportifs et conviviaux tout au long de l'année (Staff Days, visites des musées gratuites, city trips etc) ;
• Un employeur citoyen qui agit en faveur de causes sociétales et environnementales en tant qu'assureur, investisseur et entreprise notamment au travers de l'association AXA Atout Cœur.

Digital Risk Oversight Expert (m/f/d)

Job Description

Find your purpose at KPMG Luxembourg
We see a world of opportunity. From uncovering ways to digitalize, to enabling new sectors to take off, to building sustainability and resilience into economies, we know insights reveal new opportunities for all.

Job Description

We are seeking for a Digital Risk Oversight Expert.

The Digital Risk Oversight Expert will play a crucial role in ensuring that the organization's digital security risks are effectively identified, monitored, and managed. This position focuses on oversight and governance, ensuring that solutions, processes, and behaviors align with KPMG policies, standards, and security best practices. The expert will provide independent oversight and advisory support to the first line of defense, contributing to a robust digital risk management framework.
What you will be working on

Independent Reviews

• Conduct independent reviews of security controls and provide actionable recommendations for improvement.
• Assess and validate the adequacy of security measures implemented by the first line of defense.

Security Processes Implementation

• Elaborate, implement, and monitor security-related processes to ensure compliance with established standards.
• Lead investigations on security incidents, containing, mitigating, and reporting the impact effectively. Ensure root cause analysis and lessons learned are addressed effectively.

Reporting & Metrics

• Produce regular reports on the state of information security and key risks for senior management and stakeholders.
• Track key performance indicators (KPIs) and key risk indicators (KRIs) to evaluate security effectiveness.
• Identify, evaluate, and report on the criticality of identified vulnerabilities and prioritize remediation based on potential business impact.

Training & Development

• Elaborate and deliver training sessions to all stakeholders to strengthen the security culture within the organization.
• As an Expert, coach, motivate and review the work done by junior team members.

Collaboration & Liaison

• Work closely with the first line of defense to address security gaps and vulnerabilities.
• Liaise with third parties, auditors, and regulators on security matters, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations.

What we look for

Technical Skills & Qualifications

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT, ideally with a specialty in Information Security.
• At least 8 years of experience with information security concepts and practices.
• Knowledge of IT security standards (ITIL, ISO27001, OWASP, etc.).
• Proficiency in IT security tools (Firewall, EDR, IPS N/H, WAF, SIEM, DLP, Compliance, etc.).
• Strong knowledge in network security and incident management.
• Strong Cloud security knowledge and IT Security certifications are an advantage e.g. CCSP, AZ- 500
• Strong Knowledge on development technologies and languages.

Experience & Knowledge

• Ability to lead security assessments and audits.
• Strong understanding of cybersecurity threats and vulnerabilities
• Experience in vulnerability management and cloud security.
• Excellent communication and management skills.
• Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.
• Motivated and organized, capable of taking ownership of projects from A to Z while respecting tight deadlines and being receptive to new ideas.
• Strong issue resolution skills with a focus on risk controls and client focus.

What will you get

We offer more than jobs. With our flexible work model, you can enjoy work and rest and recharge. Our competitive compensation packages, paid time away from work, recognition bonuses and dedicated programs for personal development and wellbeing help to keep everyone refreshed and motivated.

jobs.title: POST-DOC SOIL HEALTH AND REMEDIATION (m/f)
