jobs.description:
SD-26155- POST-DOC SOIL HEALTH AND REMEDIATION

Fixed term contract | Belvaux | 24 Months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defense technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

As part of LIST's SUSTAIN unit (Environmental Sustainability Assessment and Circularity), the Environmental Policies (EPS) group provides science-based input to the definition and implementation of environmental policies at national and EU level, in particular policies around chemical safety, soil pollution, circular (bio-)economy (e.g. construction, textile, water), and climate - and feeds, at the interface of science, technologies and policies, the regulatory perspective into RDI projects around these topics.

As postdoc (R&T Scientist), you will further strengthen the activities around soil health and the management of contaminated sites via contributing to:
• The further development (implementation-phase) of an Urban Soil Living Lab in Luxembourg (Horizon Europe project URSOILL - Innovative Solutions for Sustainable Urban Soil Restoration Through Living Labs) and participation in a working group on soil remediation and stabilization with nature-based solutions, especially phytoremediation and phytomanagement. Main tasks: literature review; design of field experiments and monitoring protocols across multiple urban sites; support and supervision of fieldwork; data analysis and interpretation; stakeholder engagement in the Living Lab; and scientific publications and project deliverables.
• The establishment of a cross-border network of ‘Lighthouses' of phytomanagement for soil remediation, biodiversity and the regenerative economy in the Greater Region (Interreg project Light4Green),
• Scientific and regulatory support, e.g. via bibliography and the preparation of a review article, on nature-based remediation solutions for Persistent organic pollutants (POPs) contamination (Interreg project Naturem),
• The set-up of a laboratory for testing and evaluating soil remediation technologies (especially bioremediation and phytoremediation),
• Support the definition, submission and implementation of research and collaborative project proposals of the group, and participate to the network of LIST's different activities around soil protection.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!
Education

• You hold a Master's degree and a PhD in soil or environmental sciences/engineering, or another relevant natural science or engineering domain.
• You have practical and solid experience in the design, testing, evaluation and application of nature-based soil remediation technologies, e.g. phytoremediation, bioremediation, mycoremediation.
• Interdisciplinary thinking, well-developed communication skills (oral and written) and team spirit to successfully integrate into the multicultural, multilingual and multidisciplinary work environment at LIST and effectively communicate with LIST's partners,
• Client orientation mindset and great sense of service are required. The candidate should be highly motivated, pro-active and open for new challenges and can work independently,
• Not mandatory but considered an asset:
o First experience in an RTO/academic environment, scientific/technical consulting, authorities, or industry on contaminated site management, pollution risk assessment or remediation
o Knowledge of Luxembourg and the Greater Region

Language skills

• Fluency in English, both oral and written. Other relevant languages, especially French, German, or Luxembourgish are a strong asset.

Your LIST benefits

• An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects
• Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society
• Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square metres, including innovations in all that we do
• An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas
• Personalized learning programme to foster our staff's soft and technical skills
• Multicultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforce
• Diverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfil their personal and professional ambitions
• Gender-friendly environment with multiple actions to attract, develop and retain women in science
• 32 days' paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month salary, statutory health insurance
• Flexible working hours, home working policy (not remote) and access to Digital lunch vouchers

Apply online

Your application must include:

• A motivation letter oriented towards the position and detailing your experience
• A scientific CV with contact details
• List of publications (and patents, if applicable)
• Contact details of 2 references

SD-26151 JUNIOR R&T ENGINEER - CLOUD NATIVE INFRASTRUCTURE
Fixed term contract | 24 months | Belval

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.
Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

We are opening an Junior R&T Engineer position focused on Platform Engineering. You will design, build, and operate the core infrastructure and platform components that power AI, Data, and Digital Twin workloads across heterogeneous Research IT environments.

As an autonomous engineer, you will contribute to the development of internal platforms, manage cloud landing zones and Kubernetes-based clusters, and streamline the delivery of reproducible research demonstrators. You will define best practices for infrastructure automation, platform reliability, and secure software delivery, while collaborating closely with research teams to transform their needs into scalable and maintainable platform services.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

Your duties may include:

• Platform Engineering & Infrastructure Automation: Design, build, and operate cloud native foundational components (Kubernetes clusters, shared services, IaC modules, internal tooling) to support the team's AI and Data assets.
• Cloud & On Prem Integration: Manage and evolve cloud landing zones (provided by corporate IT) and on premise research clusters; ensure consistent infrastructure automation patterns across environments.
• Internal Developer Platform (IDP) Enablement: Create reusable, self service infrastructure blueprints enabling researchers to deploy demonstrators, pipelines, and experiments efficiently and safely.
• Infrastructure as Code & GitOps: Implement and maintain Terraform/CloudFormation modules, GitOps workflows, policies, and automation to ensure reproducible and secure deployments.
• Platform Observability: Design and maintain robust observability stacks (metrics, logs, traces) to monitor platform health and guide performance improvements.

• Project Contribution: Participate in infrastructure, integration, and platform related work packages for projects such as CitCom.ai, NextLogic, and the AI Factory.

Education

Experience and skills

• Ability to communicate complex architectural concepts to non technical stakeholders.

Language skills

As a Research Data Specialist, you will support researchers in managing data across the research lifecycle. jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer
jobs.description:
We are AI builders

Since 2018, Enjins has done one thing: ship AI that works in production. From Utrecht and Berlin, we build machine learning systems, data infrastructure, and agentic AI layers for European tech companies, with a deliberate focus on climate and energy, where we believe the biggest technological shift of our generation should meet its most critical challenge.

We embed directly with the engineering teams of high-growth scale-ups like Crisp, PlanBlue, NextSense, and Groendus. We take ownership of the full technical lifecycle: from first architecture decision to a production-grade system running inside our partner's infrastructure, long after go-live.

The role

As Lead AI Engineer, you are the technical owner of client engagements. You architect the solution, ship it to production, and make sure it still performs a year later. Alongside the other Leads, you shape the engineering team and the way we build.

In practice:

  • Design AI roadmaps with client leadership and own them through to production
  • Create and implement the AI solution architectures to deliver on those roadmaps
  • Set and uphold Data Platform and MLOps standards across your client portfolio, so systems stay healthy after handover
  • Mentor engineers and weigh in on hiring, team growth, and accounts
  • Push our engineering practice forward, including how we use agentic coding workflows to build faster without compromising reliability. We test, document, and share what works, so the whole team levels up
  • Elevate our product mindset to ensure we build the right things, not just more things

Why a Lead role here, not somewhere else

You'll work across more stacks, clouds, and frontier frameworks in a year than most engineers see in five, with the collective knowledge of the whole team behind you, not the isolation of freelance work. And because our clients build grid software, energy forecasting, and climate infrastructure, you develop real domain expertise in energy and climate systems on top of production-grade AI engineering.

In your first months you'll join a client project alongside an experienced Enjins engineer, supported by a dedicated coach. Within half a year, you own the technical roadmap of at least one engagement, mentor engineers, and have a recognised voice in our Asset strategy.

Requirements

What matters most: you think in systems, own outcomes end-to-end, and grow the people around you.

  • 5+ years building and scaling data & AI solutions in production environments
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals: you write production-grade code and know your way around infrastructure (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, data pipelines)
  • Mastery of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP) and experience leading MLOps/LLMOps architectures
  • Proven experience taking LLM-based or agentic systems to production
  • Experience mentoring engineers, overseeing delivery, and managing client accounts
  • You can translate technical complexity into clear decisions for non-technical stakeholders
  • Fluent in English and eligible to work in the Netherlands

Benefits

We publish our salary ranges and keep terms straightforward. No surprises.

Compensation

  • €5,950 - €7,800 gross per month (excl. holiday allowance, pension, bonus, equity, and AI-Leap benefits)
  • Annual performance bonus of 1.5 months' salary
  • Equity participation (VSOP)


Growth

  • AI-Leap: our structured development programme with a dedicated certification budget and a specialised track for Leads
  • 1-on-1 mentoring with our founders and external coaching to close your specific gaps


Team & culture

  • Office on the Oudegracht in Utrecht (note: not yet fully accessible for individuals with physical disabilities); hybrid setup
  • 28 vacation days, flexible across 3 national holidays
  • Monthly team events and the annual two-day Enjins Summer Summit on AI × Climate
  • OV-First travel policy, fully covered; meat-free catering
  • Apple MacBook Pro and the tools you need

jobs.description: Uvjeti (potrebna znanja i kvalifikacije) koje kandidati moraju zadovoljiti za navedeno radno mjesto su: • SSS/KV – tehničkog smjera (vodoinstalater, monter strojarskih instalacija ili srodni stručnjaci strojarskog ili građevinskog smjera) • vozačka dozvola B kategorije Opis poslova radnog mjesta: • organizira i samostalno obavlja složeni popravak svih vrsta vodomjera radi pripreme za njihovo mjeriteljsko ispitivanje i ovjeru • organizira raspoređivanje rezervnih dijelova vodomjera unutar servisa • prema potrebi izrađuje pojedine dijelove vodomjera • sudjeluje u radovima remonta baždarnice Izabrani kandidat obavljat će poslove radnog mjesta MONTER I (822416) u Odjelu izmjene vodomjera, temeljem ugovora o radu na neodređeno vrijeme s probnim radom u trajanju od 6 (šest) mjeseci. Uz predaju ponude koja sadrži kontakt podatke (broj telefona ili mobitela, e-mail adresa) kandidati trebaju obvezno priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta, kako slijedi: • životopis s opisom dosadašnjeg rada • dokaz o odgovarajućem stupnju obrazovanja u skladu s uvjetima iz javnog natječaja (presliku svjedodžbe, odnosno rješenje o priznavanju inozemne stručne kvalifikacije koju je izdalo nadležno tijelo) • uvjerenje da se ne vodi kazneni postupak (ne starije od 3 mjeseca od dana objave natječaja) • presliku važeće vozačke dozvole Ponude na javni natječaj podnose se elektroničkim putem. Rok za dostavu tražene dokumentacije je 14 dana od dana objave, na adresu elektroničke pošte: vio.karijera@zgh.hr S naznakom „Za javni natječaj za radno mjesto MONTER I (822416) u Odjelu izmjene vodomjera“. jobs.title: Tech Lead Full-Stack Rails Engineer
jobs.description:
About Mitre Media

Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

About the Role

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and maintain Rails applications (Rails 8)

  • Integrate LLMs into our microservices architecture for state management and real-time user experiences.

  • Enhance front-end experiences with Hotwire, StimulusJS, or React, ensuring seamless AI-driven interactions.

  • Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing.

Required Technical Skills

Back-End

  • Ruby (5+ years, expert-level)

  • Ruby on Rails (Rails 6-8 preferred)

  • PostgreSQL (or MySQL)

  • Elasticsearch

  • Redis

  • Docker

Front-End

  • StimulusJS or JavaScript ES6

  • Tailwind CSS

  • HTML

  • HTTP

AI Integration

  • Experience integrating AI/ML models (e.g., LLMs, NLP) with web applications

  • Familiarity with LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Hugging Face) or APIs (e.g., xAI, Anthropic)

Nice-to-Have Technical Skills

  • Kubernetes for microservices orchestration

  • React for advanced front-end components

  • Graph databases for complex financial data

  • Contributions to open-source RoR or AI projects

Required Soft Skills

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for AI and FinTech

  • Natural leader who mentors and inspires teammates

  • Problem-solver with a “get things done” mentality

  • Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration

  • Attention to detail, ensuring clean, maintainable code

  • Team player comfortable as an individual contributor

Why Join Us?

  • Impactful Work: Build AI-powered tools that help millions of investors make informed decisions from data-driven insights.

  • Cutting-Edge Tech: Work with Rails 8, LLMs, and modern tools like Hotwire, Databricks, and xAI’s API in a microservices architecture.

  • Autonomy and Influence: Collaborate directly with our CEO and CTO to shape our AI-driven platform, with freedom to innovate.

  • Competitive Compensation: $160,000–$200,000 CAD/USD (based on experience) and benefits.

  • Remote Flexibility: Remote-first (±3 hours from ET) with hybrid in office collaboration in Toronto or NYC

  • Growth Opportunities: Budget for AI and Rails conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, RailsConf), plus access to cutting-edge AI tools for experimentation.

  • Dynamic Culture: Join a small, no-ego team passionate about trust, innovation, and making a difference in FinTech.

About Mitre Media’s AI-Driven Platform

Mitre Media powers premium financial brands like Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com with the Mitre Platform. This platform integrates traditional content management, financial data, first-party data, ad revenue, and subscription tools, all enhanced by LLMs for rich, user-focused experiences. Our data-derived insights delight users, while our advertising solutions deliver unmatched performance for partners like BlackRock and Vanguard, leveraging advanced targeting and first-party data.

How to Apply

 

Submit your resume, GitHub profile, and a brief note on why you’re excited about building AI-driven FinTech to jobs@mitremedia.com.

Work tasks: Hausing is a dedicated property management software platform that helps commercial property managers and owners save time through automation and gain a real-time overview with centralized portfolio data. jobs.title: Asennustyönjohtaja / vastaava työnjohtaja
jobs.description:
_Me Parmacolla uskomme, että rakennusten tulisi olla yhtä joustavia kuin yhteisöt, joita ne palvelevat. Muutamme yhteiskuntaa dynaamisella arkkitehtuurilla – muunneltavilla, siirrettävillä ja kiertotalouteen perustuvilla rakennuksilla, jotka elävät käyttäjiensä mukana. Tule mukaan tekemään tilaa kestävälle tulevaisuudelle!_

Haemme kokenutta **asennustyönjohtajaa / vastaavaa työnjohtajaa** itsenäiseen ja vastuulliseen rooliin johtamaan rakennushankkeitamme Helsingin seudulla. Vastaat samanaikaisesti yhden tai useamman hankkeen päivittäisestä johtamisesta ja varmistat, että työt etenevät turvallisesti, laadukkaasti, aikataulussa ja suunnitelmien mukaisesti.

Rakennustemme moduulit valmistetaan tehtaillamme ja asennetaan sekä viimeistellään valmiiksi työmaalla. Johdat työmaata kokonaisvaltaisesti, vastaat työmaan viranomaisvelvoitteista, sovitat yhteen työvaiheita ja aliurakoitsijoiden työtä, koordinoit toimituksia sekä laadit tarvittavat työmaasuunnitelmat ja -dokumentaation. Seuraat ja raportoit työn etenemistä, ratkaiset työmaalla syntyviä tilanteita sekä osallistut työmaakokouksiin, katselmuksiin, tarkastuksiin ja luovutuksiin. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä projektinjohdon, suunnittelun, hankinnan, asiakkaiden, aliurakoitsijoiden ja tehtaidemme kanssa.

Tehtävässä ei ole ennalta määriteltyä päivittäistä työaikaa, vaan suunnittelet ja rytmität työsi itsenäisesti hankkeiden tavoitteiden ja työmaiden vaiheiden mukaan. Tämä tuo työhön vapautta, mutta edellyttää myös valmiutta mukauttaa työpäivää työmaiden tilanteisiin.

Työskentelet pääasiassa Helsingin seudun rakennuskohteissa. Tehtävään kuuluu lisäksi satunnaisia käyntejä Parmacon tehtailla Hämeenlinnassa, Leppävirralla ja Pyhäjoella. Voimassa oleva B-ajokortti vaaditaan, mutta omaa autoa ei edellytetä.

**Menestyt tehtävässä hyvin, kun**

jobs.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager, Campaign Strategy & Execution
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is looking for an experienced Lifecycle Marketing Manager, Campaign Strategy & Execution to develop and execute campaigns that help users discover value, adopt key workflows, and deepen their use of Notion.

You'll own campaigns end to end: translating business and customer opportunities into clear strategies, defining audiences and journeys, coordinating creative and technical production, launching across email and in-product channels, and measuring incremental impact.

This role combines strategic judgment with hands-on execution. You'll partner closely with Lifecycle Marketing, Product Marketing, Product Growth, Data Science, Marketing Operations, and creative partners. You should be equally comfortable shaping a campaign brief, building a journey in Customer.io http://Customer.io, resolving execution details, and interpreting results.

Scope guardrails: this role owns campaign strategy, hands-on execution, cross-functional delivery, and performance analysis. It is not the primary Customer.io http://Customer.io architect or incident-response owner, a general intake coordinator, or a production-only role receiving prewritten briefs. The person should operate as an independent campaign owner who can take work from an ambiguous opportunity to a high-quality, measured launch.

This role may be based in either our San Francisco or New York City offices. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the campaign portfolio. Independently lead a portfolio of launch, one-off, and evergreen lifecycle campaigns with clear prioritization and predictable delivery.

 - Turn opportunities into strategies. Translate product launches, lifecycle moments, and business priorities into clear objectives, audiences, journeys, channel plans, and success metrics.

 - Build high-impact lifecycle programs. Develop campaigns across onboarding, activation, adoption, collaboration, monetization, retention, and resurrection.

 - Execute from brief to measurement. Own audience creation, build, QA, localization, launch readiness, and post-campaign analysis across email and in-product messaging.

 - Improve foundational journeys. Audit existing programs and recommend which should be maintained, improved, rebuilt, or retired; lead the rebuild of priority onboarding or adoption journeys.

 - Raise the experimentation bar. Develop testable hypotheses and use segmentation, personalization, holdouts, and A/B tests to understand incremental impact.

 - Measure customer and business outcomes. Connect campaigns to activation, product adoption, collaboration, conversion, retention, or qualified sales outcomes—not only opens and clicks.

 - Lead cross-functional delivery. Coordinate dependencies across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Product Marketing, Marketing Operations, Demand Generation, Sales, and external partners.

 - Create repeatable systems. Turn recurring campaign work into templates, playbooks, and reusable operating patterns that improve quality and velocity.

 - Enable safe self-service. Help cross-functional partners execute effectively while maintaining Lifecycle's strategic, customer-experience, and quality standards.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Significant experience owning lifecycle, CRM, growth, or product-marketing campaigns from strategy through execution.

 - A track record of independently leading complex, cross-functional campaigns at meaningful scale.

 - Strong customer-journey thinking across activation, adoption, engagement, conversion, and retention.

 - Hands-on experience with a lifecycle platform such as Customer.io http://Customer.io, Braze, Iterable, or Salesforce Marketing Cloud.

 - Strong audience segmentation, personalization, experimentation, and campaign-measurement skills.

 - Ability to use data to prioritize opportunities, evaluate results, and change strategy; working knowledge of SQL or self-serve analytics is a plus.

 - Excellent project leadership: clear briefs, dependable execution, proactive risk management, and crisp stakeholder communication.

 - Strong editorial and customer judgment—you care about sending useful, relevant messages rather than maximizing message volume.

 - Comfort operating in a product-led, highly cross-functional environment with incomplete information.

 - Experience with B2B or product-led growth, product telemetry, in-product messaging, or AI-assisted campaign workflows is a plus.

 - 8+ total years relevant + transferrable experience.
   
   


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THE FIRST SIX MONTHS:

 - Establish a clear operating rhythm for launch, one-off, and evergreen campaigns.

 - Independently own a meaningful portfolio from strategy through performance analysis.

 - Launch a materially improved onboarding, activation, or adoption journey with a defined experiment and measurement plan.

 - Establish consistent briefs, segmentation standards, QA, launch-readiness checks, and post-campaign readouts.

 - Demonstrate credible incremental movement in a product or business outcome.

 - Create meaningful capacity for senior Lifecycle teammates to focus on systems architecture, journey strategy, personalization, and modernization.

The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $190,000 – $220,000 per year.

A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow position in Knowledge-Grounded LLM Agents for Defensive Cyber Operations
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a PhD Research Fellow position in Knowledge-Grounded LLM Agents for Defensive Cyber Operations, available at the Digital Security Research Group within the Department of Informatics at the University of Oslo.

Starting date as soon as possible and no later than 01.05.2027. The fellowship period is three years.

A fourth year may be considered, which would involve 25% other career-promoting work. Other career-promoting work may consist of teaching, supervision, and/or research assistance. This depends on the applicant's qualifications and the department's current needs.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.


Project description

The position will investigate knowledge-grounded and neuro-symbolic approaches to large language models and agentic AI for defensive cyber operations. The PhD project will be carried out in close collaboration with the Norwegian Defence Research Establishment (FFI), including co-supervision from FFI with potential to connect the research to relevant cybersecurity and cyber-defence challenges.

The research will explore how heterogeneous cybersecurity intelligence and evidence sources, including telemetry and observations, can be transformed into structured cybersecurity knowledge, represented through semantic knowledge graphs, and combined with symbolic reasoning, modern language models, and autonomous agents to support security analysis, situational awareness, decision-making, and response. Particular emphasis will be placed on developing trustworthy, reliable, interpretable, and secure AI systems, including methods for grounding, reasoning, validation, and the control of agentic behaviour in security-critical environments. 

The security and robustness of LLM-based and agentic systems, including adversarial manipulation, uncertainty, provenance, and the validation of AI-generated decisions and actions, may also be explored as part of this position.


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in cybersecurity, computer science (informatics), artificial intelligence, or a closely related field. Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • Strong foundation in computer science or artificial intelligence/machine learning, with knowledge of cybersecurity or a demonstrated motivation to apply AI/ML in cybersecurity
  • Strong programming and software development skills, demonstrated through relevant projects, research, or equivalent experience
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English

Candidates who have not yet completed their master’s degree must have completed all requirements for the degree by 31.12.2026.

The position will involve cooperation with stakeholders related to Norwegian national security, and candidates' suitability for this will also be taken into account.

Desired qualifications:

  • Knowledge of or experience with large language models (LLMs), agentic AI, and related AI/ML methods
  • Knowledge of or experience with semantic technologies, including knowledge graphs, ontologies, knowledge representation, and/or symbolic reasoning
  • Knowledge of or experience with cybersecurity, particularly cybersecurity operations, security analysis, threat detection and response, cyber threat intelligence, or security automation
  • Knowledge of or interest in trustworthy and secure AI, including robustness, interpretability, validation, uncertainty, or the security of LLM-based and agentic systems
  • Previous research experience, for example, through a master’s thesis, scientific publication, research project, or equivalent work, is considered an advantage

Language requirement:

  • Good oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:
    https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Grade requirements:
The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

For more information see:

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. 

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to work independently and take initiative, while also contributing effectively to collaborative research
  • Analytical, critical, and structured approach to research and problem-solving
  • Curiosity and willingness to learn, with the ability to adapt to new research questions, methods, and technologies
  • Good communication and collaboration skills, and the ability to engage constructively in interdisciplinary research
  • Positive attitude and the ability to handle hectic periods

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organisation with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment
  • Good welfare schemes
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Career development programmes
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • Salary in position as PhD Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 550 800 - 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund 

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter (statement of motivation, summarising scientific work and research interest)
  • CV (summarising education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience and other qualifying activity)
  • Transcripts of records, copies of the original Bachelor’s and Master’s degree diplomas (see below)
  • Documentation of English Language requirements. The appointed candidate cannot start in the position until approved documentation of English language proficiency has been submitted.
  • A complete list of publications and related academic or research works, including software artefacts that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".
Foreign applicants should attach an official explanation of their University's grading system.

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to post doctoral and research posts at UiO (Norwegian) and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.  

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The Department of Informatics (IFI) is one of nine departments belonging to the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences. IFI is Norway’s largest university department for general education and research in Computer Science and related topics. 

The Department has more than 1800 students on bachelor level, 600 master students, and over 240 PhDs and postdocs. The overall staff of the Department is close to 370 employees, about 280 of these in full time positions. The full time tenured academic staff is 75, mostly Full/Associate Professors.

jobs.title: Pædagogiske og sundhedsfaglige medarbejdere samt en sygeplejerske med fokus på kvalitet og undervisning
jobs.description:
Vil du bruge din faglighed til at skabe tryghed og udviklingsmuligheder for børn og unge? Hos MerVib søger vi både medarbejdere til det daglige arbejde på vores børne- og ungehjem i Herrestrup og Grevinge og en sygeplejerske til sundhedsfaglig kvalitet, medicinhåndtering og undervisning.

Vores tilgang
Et barn eller en ung kommer med erfaringer, interesser og håb – og ofte med andres fortællinger, der med tiden kan være blevet til faste sandheder om, hvem de er.

Hos MerVib er vi nysgerrige på barnets egen oplevelse: Hvad er vigtigt? Hvad lykkes? Og hvad kan vi voksne have overset?

På vores fire børne- og ungehjem arbejder vi for, at børn og unge oplever tryghed, tilhørsforhold og indflydelse på eget liv. Vores narrative tilgang præger, hvordan vi taler med og om børnene. Vi undersøger vores egne antagelser og får sammen med barnet øje på færdigheder, initiativer og håb. Barnets perspektiv er med til at forme vores støtte.

Pædagogiske og sundhedsfaglige medarbejdere til Herrestrup og Grevinge
Du arbejder med tydelig struktur, professionel omsorg og relationer – både i fællesskaber og i individuelle opgaver med 1:1-støtte. Du tilpasser støtten til det enkelte barn og bidrager til en tryg og forudsigelig hverdag.

Vi søger dig der
  • Har en relevant faglig uddannelse og erfaring med børn og unge i sårbare positioner.
  • Har viden om og erfaring med autisme, ADHD og omsorgssvigt.
  • Har erfaring med eller interesse for narrativ praksis og TEACCH.
  • Er nysgerrig på barnets perspektiv og kan tilpasse støtten inden for trygge, tydelige rammer.
  • Arbejder ud fra en Low Arousal-tilgang, tager ansvar, dokumenterer systematisk og er åben for faglig sparring.

Du kan eksempelvis være uddannet pædagog, socialpædagog, pædagogisk assistent, social- og sundhedsassistent, sygeplejerske, socialrådgiver, skolelærer, fysioterapeut eller ergoterapeut. Du kan også have en anden relevant socialfaglig, sundhedsfaglig eller pædagogisk uddannelse.

Der er tale om faste fuldtidsstillinger med 12-timers dagvagter, 24-timers døgnvagter og weekendarbejde. Arbejdsstederne er vores børne- og ungehjem i Herrestrup og Grevinge.

Sygeplejerske til sundhedsfaglig kvalitet medicinhåndtering og undervisning
Som sygeplejerske skal du have et solidt fagligt og lovgivningsmæssigt fundament. Du kombinerer praktiske medicinopgaver med undervisning og kvalitetsudvikling og hjælper ledelsen og medarbejderne med at omsætte gældende regler til tydelige og forsvarlige arbejdsgange.

Dine opgaver omfatter at
  • Varetage medicinopgaver, herunder dispensering efter gældende ordinationer og instrukser.
  • Undervise og vejlede medarbejderne i medicinhåndtering og følge op på oplæring og kompetencer.
  • Gennemgå, opdatere og versionsstyre sundhedsfaglige instrukser i overensstemmelse med gældende regler og vejledninger samt følge op på, at de anvendes korrekt i hverdagen.
  • Omsætte faglige krav til brugbare arbejdsgange inden for blandt andet ansvar og kompetencer, journalføring, samtykke, hygiejne, utilsigtede hændelser og egenkontrol.
  • Indgå i det pædagogiske arbejde i husene i dagtimerne eller i weekender. Tilrettelæggelsen aftales med udgangspunkt i dine interesser og stillingens øvrige opgaver.

Vi søger dig der
  • Er uddannet og autoriseret sygeplejerske med solid erfaring med medicinhåndtering, dispensering og sundhedsfaglig dokumentation.
  • Har solidt kendskab til relevant sundhedslovgivning, herunder regler om medicinhåndtering, journalføring, samtykke, tavshedspligt og delegation af sundhedsfaglige opgaver.
  • Kender og kan anvende relevante vejledninger fra Sundhedsstyrelsen og Styrelsen for Patientsikkerhed og holder dig ajour med ændringer.
  • Kan underbygge din vejledning med gældende regler og faglige kilder og afklarer tvivlsspørgsmål, før du vejleder eller ændrer en instruks.
  • Kan skrive klare instrukser og gøre faglig viden anvendelig for medarbejdere med forskellige uddannelsesbaggrunde.
  • Kan undervise og vejlede præcist og praksisnært samt følge op på, at medarbejderne forstår deres opgaver, ansvar og kompetencegrænser.
  • Arbejder systematisk og selvstændigt og trives i et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde.
  • Møder børn og unge med respekt, nysgerrighed og blik for deres perspektiv.

Erfaring fra et børne- og ungehjem eller et andet socialt tilbud er en fordel.

Stillingen er en fast fuldtidsstilling med opgaver på MerVibs børne- og ungehjem i Herrestrup, Grevinge og Jyderup. Vi har desuden undervisningslokaler i Herlev. Du skal være villig til at bruge egen bil.

Hos MerVib får du
Et arbejdsfællesskab med varme, engagement og høj faglig standard. Du introduceres til vores hverdag, værdier og metoder og deltager fra start med støtte fra kolleger og ledelse.

Vores årshjul rummer intern og ekstern undervisning samt faglige oplæg gennem hele året. Derudover får du tæt ledelsesmæssig sparring og supervision.

For begge stillingsprofiler gælder:
  • Løn og tiltrædelse efter aftale.
  • Pension og sundhedsforsikring.
  • Kørekort til almindelig bil (B) er et krav.
  • Vi indhenter børne- og straffeattest før ansættelse.

Ansøgning og kontakt
Fortæl os, hvorfor du har lyst til at bringe din faglighed i spil hos MerVib.

Angiv tydeligt i din ansøgning, om du søger en medarbejderstilling i Herrestrup eller Grevinge eller stillingen som sygeplejerske med fokus på sundhedsfaglig kvalitet og undervisning.

Upload din ansøgning, CV og dit uddannelsesbevis via linket "Ansøg" her på siden.

Vil du høre mere om stillingerne, er du velkommen til at kontakte:
  • Medarbejderstillinger i Grevinge: Afdelingsleder Rikke Gjesing, telefon 92 90 42 24.
  • Medarbejderstillinger i Herrestrup: Afdelingsleder Nada Shouhani, telefon 92 90 42 16.
  • Sygeplejerskestillingen: Gitte Praastrup, specialkonsulent – drift, HR og kommunikation, telefon 92 90 42 22 eller job@mervib.dk .

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når de rette kandidater er fundet.

jobs.title: Kiinteistö- ja turvallisuuskoordinaattori
jobs.description:
Primary location:
TUUSULA

Haemme kiinteistö- ja turvallisuuskoordinaattoria Meira Novan logistiikkakeskukseen Tuusulaan.

Tehtävässä huolehdit logistiikkakeskuksemme kiinteistöjen arjen sujuvuudesta ja turvallisuuteen liittyvien käytäntöjen koordinoinnista. Tuet turvallisuus- ja kiinteistöpäällikköä ylläpidon, kunnossapidon, toimitilaturvallisuuden ja työturvallisuuden tehtävissä sekä varmistat, että sovitut toimenpiteet etenevät suunnitelmallisesti.

Koordinoit huolto-, korjaus- ja tarkastustoimenpiteitä palveluntuottajien ja sisäisten sidosryhmien kanssa. Seuraat sovittujen töiden toteutumista, ylläpidät kiinteistö- ja turvallisuusasioihin liittyvää dokumentaatiota sekä osallistut poikkeamien, havaintojen ja korjaavien toimenpiteiden käsittelyyn. Työssäsi huomioit kiinteistö-, tuote- ja työturvallisuuden sekä liiketoiminnan jatkuvuuden vaatimukset.

Tehtäviisi kuuluvat lisäksi palveluntuottajien työn seuranta, turvallisuuskierrokset, kulunhallinta, henkilöstöviestintä, riskienarvioinnit, pelastussuunnittelu ja harjoitukset. Kehität toimintatapoja jatkuvasti, ja tehtävän tarkempi sisältö muotoutuu osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi perusteella.

Näillä taidoilla menestyt
Tehtävässä menestyt, kun sinulla on soveltuva teknisen, turvallisuus- tai kiinteistöalan koulutus tai muulla tavoin hankittu vastaava osaaminen sekä kokemusta kiinteistöjen ylläpidosta, turvallisuustekniikasta tai vastaavasta koordinointitehtävästä. Työskentelet järjestelmällisesti ja oma-aloitteisesti, osaat priorisoida ja viet sovitut asiat loppuun. Sinulla on hyvät yhteistyö- ja viestintätaidot sekä valmius käyttää turvallisuus- ja kiinteistöjärjestelmiä, hallita käyttöoikeuksia, käsitellä poikkeamia ja seurata korjaavia toimenpiteitä. Eduksi katsomme kokemuksen palveluntuottajien ohjaamisesta, laadunvalvonnasta, auditoinneista tai turvallisuusjärjestelmien pääkäyttäjätehtävistä.

Tule voittavaan joukkueeseen
Arvostamme itsenäistä ja vastuullista työotetta sekä halua kehittää toimintaa yhdessä. Toimit tiiviissä yhteistyössä logistiikkakeskuksen henkilöstön, esihenkilöiden, palveluntuottajien ja muiden kumppaneiden kanssa. Tehtävässä raportoit turvallisuus- ja kiinteistöpäällikölle.

jobs.title: Consultant Interventional Cardiologist - PCI On-Call Service
jobs.description:
The opportunity
Are you an experienced interventional cardiologist looking to join a highly specialised university hospital with a strong clinical, academic and collaborative environment?

The Department of Cardiology at Aalborg University Hospital is seeking one or more Consultant Interventional Cardiologists from the EU/EØS to join our team. We welcome applications from candidates who are already qualified to participate in a PCI on-call service, as well as experienced PCI operators who are motivated to develop the additional competencies required for on-call duties.

The position is available as soon as possible or by mutual agreement.

This is an opportunity to work in a busy interventional cardiology environment, contribute to the development of specialised cardiac care and collaborate with highly skilled colleagues across cardiology, cardiac surgery and other disciplines.

The position
Your primary clinical responsibilities will be within interventional cardiology, particularly percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI).
The position includes participation in the department's PCI on-call service.

You will be part of a multidisciplinary team providing specialised care for patients with ischaemic heart disease, including patients requiring urgent and complex coronary interventions.
Depending on your experience, qualifications and the department's clinical needs, there may also be opportunities to contribute to the development of other specialised interventional services, including transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI) and chronic total occlusion (CTO) procedures.

Alongside your clinical responsibilities, you will contribute to the department's research, teaching and professional development activities, as well as relevant administrative and organisational tasks.

What we offer
The opportunity to work in a busy university hospital with an established PCI service and a broad range of specialised cardiology services.
Professional development: Opportunities to further develop your interventional skills and, where appropriate, expand your expertise into complex PCI, TAVI or CTO procedures.
A strong multidisciplinary team: Close collaboration with cardiologists across subspecialties, cardiothoracic anaesthetists and cardiac surgeons.
An academic environment: Opportunities to participate in clinical research, teaching and the development of new treatment pathways.
Supportive colleagues and leadership: We value professional respect, constructive collaboration and a positive working environment.
Flexible working arrangements: Working hours and duty schedules are organised within the applicable employment framework.
An international perspective: The opportunity to join a university hospital committed to clinical excellence, research, education and continuous improvement.

Qualifications and experience
Essential requirements
You hold specialist certification in cardiology.
You have or are able to obtain a Danish Authorization to practice medicine
You are fluent in or command a professional working proficiency in Danish. Norwegian or Swedish (B2/C1 level)
Or are willing to learn Danish
You can perform PCI procedures independently.
You have the clinical judgement and professional skills required to manage patients with ischaemic heart disease.
You communicate effectively and work constructively with colleagues across clinical disciplines.
You can maintain an overview and make sound clinical decisions in a demanding and sometimes unpredictable environment.
You are committed to high standards of patient care, patient safety and continuous professional development.
You are willing to contribute to the department's clinical, organisational and educational activities and to take on the leadership and supervisory responsibilities associated with a consultant position.

Desirable qualifications
Experience participating in a PCI on-call service.
Experience from a university hospital or another highly specialised cardiac centre.
Experience in complex PCI, TAVI or CTO procedures.
A PhD, or other research qualifications or a strong record of scientific publications.
Experience in clinical research, teaching or quality improvement.
Experience in a PCI on-call service is an advantage but is not essential, provided you are an independent PCI operator and are motivated to acquire the necessary competencies following an appropriate period of training and induction.

About the Department
The Department of Cardiology at Aalborg University Hospital is a large, specialised and research-active department providing advanced care across a broad range of cardiovascular conditions, including ischaemic heart disease, cardiac arrhythmias, heart failure, valvular heart disease, thoracic aortic aneurysms, pericardial diseases, thromboembolic disorders and dyslipidaemia.

Our department performs approximately:
6,000 invasive procedures annually
8,000 inpatient admissions annually
More than 30,000 outpatient consultations annually
Approximately 14,000 echocardiographic examinations annually

Our medical team comprises doctors at different stages of postgraduate training and 32 consultant cardiologists, including two professors.
We provide inpatient and outpatient services, operate a cardiac catheterisation laboratory and maintain a dedicated cardiology research unit.
Our work is guided by a shared commitment to clinical excellence, patient safety and involving patients and their families in shared decision-making. We also have a strong responsibility for undergraduate medical education and postgraduate specialist training.
The department operates across three hospital sites in Aalborg, Thisted and Hobro, with the vast majority of clinical activity based at the newly built Aalborg University Hospital.

Salary and terms of employment
This is a full-time position. Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the applicable Danish collective agreement.
The position includes participation in the department's PCI on-call service.
Further details regarding the on-call arrangement and employment conditions can be discussed with the Head of Department or Lead Senior Physician Bent Raungaard tlf. 27201096, e-mail: b.raungaard@rn.dk

Application
Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and interviews will be arranged continuously.
Please include:
Curriculum Vitae (CV).
Letter of motivation
Proof of specialist certification in cardiology.
List of publications, if applicable.

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator, EMEA
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The People Team at Notion exists to help build a generational company - one that enables people to do their best and most meaningful work. Hiring exceptional talent, at the right time and with care, is central to that mission.

We’re looking for a Recruiting Coordinator to partner closely with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to create a thoughtful, well-run, and genuinely human candidate experience. This role sits at the center of our hiring process and plays an important role in how candidates experience Notion.

This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:




CREATE A CANDIDATE EXPERIENCE THAT REFLECTS NOTION

You’ll be one of the first and most consistent touchpoints candidates have with Notion. From scheduling interviews to answering questions and resolving issues, you’ll help ensure every interaction feels organized, respectful, and intentional. You’ll collaborate closely with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to continually refine our processes—so candidates leave feeling excited about what we’re building, regardless of the outcome.


COORDINATE INTERVIEWS WITH CARE AND PRECISION

You’ll manage and schedule a high volume of interviews across primarily GTM roles, balancing speed with attention to detail. You’ll anticipate needs, communicate clearly, and keep candidates and interviewers aligned - making the process feel smooth and predictable, even as things move quickly.


BUILD STRONG RECRUITING FOUNDATIONS

This role is designed for someone early in their recruiting career who wants to build durable fundamentals. Over time, you’ll gain exposure to how we plan, execute, and scale hiring at Notion. With support from the team, you could take on light sourcing work, process improvements, and additional ownership as your skills grow - creating a strong foundation for future growth in recruiting, operations, or people-focused roles.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 2+ years of experience in recruiting coordination or interview scheduling, ideally in a high-volume environment

 - Strong organizational and prioritization skills - you’re proactive, reliable, and thoughtful about details

 - A steady, calm approach in fast-moving environments

 - Ability to navigate ambiguity with optimism

 - Clear, kind, and professional communication skills - you’ll represent Notion to a large and diverse group of candidates

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience supporting both GTM roles, including remote and in-person interview scheduling

 - Experience with Ashby, Workday, Slack

 - Experience in a high-growth or startup environment



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €68,000 - €76,000.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Project Engineer – HVAC Systems, Shipbuilding
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Project Engineer to take technical responsibility for HVAC systems in demanding shipbuilding projects. In this role, you will manage system design and development from the basic design phase through procurement, approvals, testing, commissioning and production support.

You will act as the technical owner and primary specialist for your assigned systems, ensuring that solutions meet project requirements and comply with shipyard, shipowner, authority and classification society standards. The position combines hands-on engineering with multidisciplinary coordination, supplier cooperation and technical decision-making related to quality, functionality and cost. The work will be carried out at our customers premises in Helsinki or Turku area. Depending on the project, you may also work remotely.



Systems within your scope may include

· heating, cooling and air conditioning

· fire Extinguishing systems

· water treatment systems



Key responsibilities

· take technical ownership of the assigned HVAC system throughout the project and ensure compliance with client, shipyard, authority and classification society requirements.

· prepare, maintain, and submit comprehensive technical documentation—including system and piping diagrams, component lists, material information, system descriptions, calculations, and arrangements—for approval by the client, classification society, and relevant authorities.

· define equipment, components and materials, prepare technical procurement specifications, evaluate supplier proposals and provide technical support for purchasing.

· manage system-related changes and assess their impact on interfaces with other systems.

· coordinate with other designers, shipbuilding, production, project personnel and suppliers to ensure functional system interfaces.

· prepare test programmes, participate in FAT inspections and technical reviews, and support commissioning.

· provide technical support to production and resolve design- and installation-related issues.



What we expect from you

· a degree in mechanical engineering, HVAC engineering or another relevant technical field.

· at least five years of relevant experience in the design or development of one or more of the listed HVAC-related systems.

· experience in shipbuilding and an understanding of marine project practices.

· knowledge of equipment sizing, system calculations, material and component selection, and technical documentation.

· experience working with classification society, authority or client requirements.

· proficiency in AutoCAD or MagiCAD; experience with relevant project, document or material management systems is an advantage.

· strong coordination, problem-solving and stakeholder communication skills.

· good command of English, Finnish language skills are considered an advantage.



The salary range for this position is approximately €4,500–5,500 per month.



What we offer

We offer you a diverse and interesting role and the opportunity to influence your own job description. With us, you will take part in varied projects and be surrounded by an excellent and inspiring network of colleagues.

According to our personnel survey, Comatecs strengths are meaningful work tasks, skilled colleagues and a healthy work-life balance.

At Comatec, you can contribute to the solutions of tomorrow. We look forward to receiving your application.

You can learn more about Comatec and what it's like to work with us here [https://www.comatec.fi/en/]



Interested?

Please submit your application and CV, including your salary request as soon as possible, but no later than 1st November 2026 via our recruitment system. We review applications already during the application period.

For security reasons, we only accept applications through our recruitment system. We do not process applications sent by email.

Please note that we require applicants to have a valid work or residence permit to work in Finland or the EU-area.

For more information about the position, please contact Engineering Manager, Marine Industry Mrs. Paula Rivasto


050 575 0716 (available on Tuesdays, 20th and 27th October, from 13:30 to 15:00)
paula.rivasto@comatec.fi



Comatec Group

Comatec is a group of 550 professionals with twenty locations in Finland, Sweden, Poland, Estonia, and Romania. As a leading engineering company, we solve technological challenges for companies that deliver the best solutions to their own customers – regardless of industry.

Comatec professionals are particularly strong in projects related to working machines, commercial vehicles, industrial automation, the marine industry, and machine modernizations, as well as material handling, production systems, power plants, and boilers. Our focus is firmly on growth and internationalization. Therefore, we are continuously looking for new experts, especially in the fields of mechanical, electrical, and automation design, as well as project management. Join us!

Read more about us at comatec.fi [http://comatec.fi]

jobs.title: Software Architect for Research Cloud Services at the SDU eScience Center
jobs.description:
The eScience Center at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) develops and operates large-scale IT infrastructure dedicated to research in all fields. The center is a leading national provider of supercomputing resources and facilities, often provided in close collaboration with other Danish universities. 

Our mission is to support research via the development of advanced IT infrastructure and by providing support and expertise to researchers. The key areas of the center are High Performance Computing (HPC), Cloud Services, Data Analytics and Data Management Services. We assist a large research community, educational and government institutions, as well as commercial companies. The center has developed a user-friendly and advanced private cloud system called UCloud, which is the core of the DeiC national system for interactive HPC and cloud computing.

We address stimulating new technological challenges. The SDU eScience Center offers a research-like environment where we encourage the study of innovative solutions and personal growth. We firmly believe in open-source and web technology as means to reach our goals.

Job description:

The center is expanding its staff in one of its core areas: research cloud services. 

We seek an expert in the following areas:

  • Distributed and concurrent systems

  • SQL databases

  • Software development for HPC environments

  • Experience with Slurm, Kubernetes or OpenStack

  • Software development experience using Go, C or C++

  • Container and virtualization technology

Experience in at least two of the above areas is required, and candidates with previous experience with Go, Kubernetes and distributed systems will be strongly preferred.

The successful candidate will become part of the cloud team at the eScience Center. Tasks under the user cloud team include, but are not limited to: Designing, developing, and maintaining high-performance distributed systems and services. Integrating with HPC schedulers such as Slurm and container orchestration platforms like Kubernetes. Participating in the full feature lifecycle, from requirements gathering and architectural design to coding, automated testing, deployment, and ongoing monitoring of production environments.

The cloud team at the eScience Center currently consists of four employees with long expertise in building cloud computing infrastructure, programming and software engineering. 

Required qualifications for the position:
 

  • Proven experience in at least two of the areas in the job description.

  • Strong background in Linux systems.

  • Programming skills (e.g. in Go, C, C++, bash, …).

  • Proven ability to work productively both independently and as part of an interdisciplinary team balancing divergent objectives involving research, code development, supporting software and consulting with scientists.

Other relevant qualifications (not required):

  • MSc or PhD in a relevant field of science or engineering.

  • Experience with DevOps practices (e.g. git and GitHub, continuous integration and deployment, software documentation).

While the positions offer flexibility and the possibility of remote work, the candidates are expected to be on-site in Odense.

Condition of Employment

The starting date for the positions is 15 January 2027 or as soon as possible. Appointments are for full time positions for a limited time period of at least 1 year based on the candidate’s profile with the possibility of extension. 

All inquiries are welcome. Please contact:

Dan Sebastian Thrane
Team leader for Cloud Services
SDU eScience Center
Dept. of Mathematics and Computer Science
University of Southern Denmark
Email: dthrane@imada.sdu.dk

Or:

Prof. Director Claudio Pica
SDU eScience Center
Dept. of Mathematics and Computer Science
University of Southern Denmark
email: pica@cp3.sdu.dk 

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

We recommend that you read how to apply before you apply.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

jobs.title: Myyjä, Sale Jäkärlä, Turun Osuuskauppa
jobs.description:
Primary location:
TURKU

Etsimme myyjää Sale Jäkärlään ihan tavallisiin töihin, harvinaisen mukavien työkavereiden joukkoon!
Tehtävä on vakituinen ja osa-aikainen 15 tuntia viikossa. Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan, kuitenkin viimeistään joulukuussa 2026.

Salessa myyjän työpäivät koostuvat ihan perus tehtävistä, kuten asiakaspalvelusta, kassa- ja hyllytystyöstä, robotilauksien keräilystä sekä myymälän yleisestä järjestelystä ja siivouksesta. Työssä muun muassa varmistat tuotteiden saatavuuden ja tuoreuden sekä sen, että myymälä on asiakkaille houkutteleva. Työskentely on nopeatempoista ja vaatii kykyä hypätä työtehtävästä toiseen. Käytät kaupan järjestelmiä, huolehdit saldojen oikeellisuudesta ja näin vaikutat omalla tekemiselläsi suoraan myyntiin ja hävikkiin. Seuraat myymälän toimintatapoja ja viestintää, huolehdit turvallisista ja ergonomisista työtavoista sekä osallistut tarvittaessa uusien työntekijöiden perehdyttämiseen. Myymälässä työskentely on fyysistä, sillä liikumme päivän aikana paljon, nostamme ja siirrämme tavaraa ja olemme koko päivän jaloillamme.

Työhön sisältyy myös hetkiä, jolloin työskentelet vuorossa yksin, joten edellytämmekin sinulta täysi-ikäisyyttä. Työvuorot vaihtelevat arkisin ja viikonloppuisin kello 6.30–21.10 väillä. Varmistathan, että sinulla on mahdollisuus kulkea toimipaikkaan kaikkina kaupan aukioloaikoina.

Olet saletisti etsimämme myyjä, jos sinulla on reipas ja positiivinen työskentelyote. Haluat olla luomassa onnistunutta asiakaskokemusta ja tervehtiminenkin tulee sinulta luonnostaan. Nautit työskentelystä hektisessä myymäläympäristössä, jossa toimit sovittujen toimintatapojen mukaisesti ja edistät omalla tekemiselläsi yhteisten tavoitteiden saavuttamista. Olet valmis tarttumaan oma-aloitteisesti erilaisiin työtehtäviin ja pidät tiimityöskentelystä, jossa pääset jakamaan omaa osaamistasi työkavereille sekä auttamaan muita onnistumaan. Lisäksi sinulle sopii fyysinen vuorotyö, jossa työskentelet vaihtelevissa vuoroissa ja työtehtävissä sekä kohtaat paljon ihmisiä päivän aikana. Eduksi katsomme aiemman työkokemuksen vastaavista työtehtävistä, mutta tärkeintä on halu oppia, toimia tehokkaasti ja tavoitteellisesti sekä työskennellä asiakaslähtöisesti.

Myyjän palkka perustuu Kaupan alan työehtosopimukseen palkkaluokkaan B. Tuntipalkka on koulutuksesta ja kokemusvuosista riippuen 10,89-14,57 €/h. Vuorotyössä ilta- ja viikonloppulisät tuovat mukavaa lisää peruspalkan päälle. Lisäksi sinulla on mahdollisuus kannustepalkkioon, joka voi olla jopa 1,20 € per tehty työtunti.

Liity meidän porukkaan, niin tarjoamme sinulle:

Ihan tavallisia töitä, epätavallisen hyvillä henkilöstöeduilla! Työskennellessäsi meillä, saat rahanarvoisia ostoetuja S-etukortillasi, kuten S-ryhmän ravintoloista –25 %,Sokos ja Emotion myymälöistä -15 % tai autopesusta –50 %

Työpäiviä poikkeuksellisen rennossa porukassa yhdessä Suomen innostavimmassa työpaikassa

Mahdollisuuden kerryttää osaamista sekä lisätienestiä tekemällä lisävuoroja muissakin Sale-myymälöissä sekä kaikissa TOK:n toimipaikoissa koko Varsinais-Suomen alueella!

Kattavan perehdytyksen työtehtävääsi ja mahdollisuuden ammatilliseen kasvuun, jota tukevat S-ryhmän monipuoliset oppimis- ja valmennusmahdollisuudet


Jos ihan tavalliset työt houkuttaa, laita hakemusta tulemaan 21.10. mennessä! Me ollaan sinuun yhteydessä sähköpostitse tai puhelimitse 010 764 –alkuisesta numerosta. Kannattaa seurata myös roskapostia, sillä meidän viestit voivat eksyä myös sinne.

Haluaisitko kuulla lisää tehtävästä ja Turun Osuuskaupasta? 📞 MyymäläpäällikköSuvi Ylikojolakertoo mielellään lisää.Suvintavoitat parhaiten arkisin klo 7–14 numerosta 010 7644217.

Turun Osuuskauppa on osa S-ryhmää ja yksi alueensa suurimmista työllistäjistä. Meillä työskentelet vakaassa organisaatiossa, jossa pääset kehittämään osaamistasi ja rakentamaan entistä parempia asiakaskokemuksia yhdessä ammattilaisten kanssa. Me Turun Osuuskaupassa työskentelemme ihan tavallisissa töissä. Tavallisuus ei tarkoita, että meillä olisi tylsää tai osaamatonta porukkaa töissä – päinvastoin! Meillä on harvinaisen hyvä työilmapiiri, epätavallisen hyvät henkilöstöedut ja poikkeuksellisen paljon monipuolisia työmahdollisuuksia. 82 % työntekijöistämme suositteleekin meitä työpaikkana. Meitä tokkilaisia on reilu 2600, ja työskentelemme neljällä eri toimialalla. Työskentelemme pilke silmäkulmassa ja tavoitteenamme on olla asiakkaiden ykkösvalinta!
