jobs.title: Software Engineer, User Database Infrastructure
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

This role will be based in San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 

You’ll build the systems that let any knowledge worker leverage fast, scalable databases without having to become a DBA.

You’ll be a hands-on technical leader, helping set the architectural direction and roadmap as we take a new product from early alpha to general availability. You’ll work directly with early customers to shape foundational technical and product decisions. Then, together, we’ll work on scaling as adoption and workloads grow.

This is a backend-leaning role with work spanning the stack. You might build the systems that provision and manage a fleet of customer Postgres instances, design how user-defined schemas evolve safely, or make complex queries execute efficiently. You’ll also follow those systems into the product: improving how a table loads, how users understand a slow operation, or how an agent safely works with their data.

You’ll help shape the architecture and the product together. Some problems call for a better abstraction, others for a better default, and others for rethinking what we ask the user to do in the first place. You’ll work with teammates and customers to find those answers, ship practical solutions, and evolve them as usage grows.



Our stack includes Postgres, Go, TypeScript, Node.js, and React.




ABOUT THE TEAM:

The people who understand a business best aren’t always the people who can build its software. A support lead knows how tickets should be triaged. An operations manager knows how inventory should move. But turning that knowledge into a reliable system often means finding an engineer, provisioning a database, and building an application.

We’re building database infrastructure for everyone else. We want everyday knowledge workers to bring their data into Notion, connect it, and build workflows around it. And do so with the power of a real database (Postgres!) and the approachability of a tool they already know.

AI agents make that opportunity even bigger: helping people build and operate systems they couldn’t have created on their own.

For our team, this is much more than putting a friendly interface on Postgres. It means making hard database problems disappear from the user’s workflow without sacrificing correctness, performance, or flexibility. How do you let someone reshape a live database as easily as editing a document? Make the right indexes exist without asking someone to become a DBA? Let a weekend experiment grow into a company’s system of record without anyone having to rearchitect it?




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Take a new product from alpha to general availability. Work with early customers to understand what matters, iterate on feedback, and help shape what we ship.

 - Make real customer workloads fast. Improve query execution, indexing, and client data loading so performance holds up as datasets grow and workflows become more demanding.

 - Build systems businesses can trust with their data. Make schema changes, concurrent writes, permissions, and recovery reliable enough for customers to build essential workflows on top.

 - Make powerful capabilities approachable. Turn database provisioning, migrations, and indexes into a reliable, easy-to-use product experience that gives people the power of a database without the burden of managing one.

 - Build for the customers who come next. Automate database provisioning and fleet operations, strengthen observability, and evolve the architecture so we can serve many, many customers.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Production relational database experience (e.g., Postgres or MySQL). You’ve made decisions about schemas and indexes, analyzed database performance, and debugged issues involving transactions, locking, or concurrency. Your experience goes beyond accessing a database through an ORM.

 - Engineering experience and technical leadership. You bring 10+ years of experience building and operating production software, with a track record of setting technical direction and leading complex, cross-team initiatives from concept through delivery. You identify the most important problems to solve, turn ambiguous goals into a technical strategy, and align engineers and partner teams around a practical plan. You stay hands-on while helping others make better decisions through design reviews, mentorship, and clear technical guidance.

 - Strong backend engineering fundamentals. You’ve built services that need to remain correct under concurrency and failure. You can reason about retries, partial failures, consistency, and the trade-offs involved in reliable reads and writes.

 - A systematic approach to performance. You use query plans, traces, profiles, and experiments to find bottlenecks and verify improvements. You’re willing to follow a problem across storage, services, and client code rather than stopping at a team boundary.

 - Product judgment. You’re interested in who will use what you build, not just how it works. You can turn a customer’s problem into a technical approach and recognize when a better default or simpler workflow would solve it more effectively.

 - Willingness to work across the stack. You bring backend depth, but you’re comfortable learning unfamiliar systems and working in client code when that’s what delivering a good experience requires.

 - Fluency with AI-assisted engineering. You use AI to accelerate exploration, implementation, and testing while taking responsibility for understanding and validating the result.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience managing fleets of databases or building database platforms, including provisioning, upgrades, backups, and recovery.

 - Deep Postgres expertise, such as advanced query optimization, performance tuning, or workload isolation for large datasets and high-concurrency workloads.

 - Experience building query layers, sync engines, change-data-capture pipelines, permission systems, or other reusable data abstractions.

  • No more hunting for clients or negotiating rates — let us handle the business side of things so you can focus on what you do best.
  • We'll manually find the best project for you according to your skills and preferences.
  • Choose a schedule that works best for you. It’s possible to communicate async or minimally overlap within team working hours.
  • We respect your seniority so you can expect no micromanagement or screen trackers.
  • Most of our projects involve working in a fast-paced startup environment. We hope you like it as much as we do.

 

Requirements — Data Scientist:

  • 3+ years of commercial experience with Python is a must

  • Experience with RAG and LLM is a must

  • Clear and effective communication in English — advanced ability to discuss business tasks, justify decisions, and communicate issues. Good self-presentation is also essential for upcoming client calls.

  • Strong self-organizational skills — ability to work full-time remotely with no supervision.

  • Reliability — we want to trust you and expect that you won’t let us and the client down.

  • Adaptability and Flexibility — the ability to onboard the project promptly after accepting it and start delivering results quickly.

 

NOT YOUR TECH STACK?

jobs.title: Senior Independent Software Developer
jobs.description:
You must be located in the Americas, Europe, or Israel to apply.


A·Team is a VC-backed, stealth, application-only home on the internet for senior independent software builders to team up with hand-picked, high-growth companies on their next big thing. 

After talking with hundreds of independent engineers, designers, and product folks, we heard over and over that finding vetted, high-quality, consistent clients is hard, and projects are often too small to be rewarding. A·Team matches small teams of the most talented builders in the world with companies backed by a16z, YC, Softbank, General Catalyst, etc. on a contract basis for many of their most important initiatives. We quietly launched in May 2020, and have helped A·Teamers earn $85+ million since.

As part of A·Team, you can expect:

  • High-paying, meaningful missions with the most audacious companies sent your way; generally $90-$150+/hr, with vetted, fascinating clients doing work that matters. We're picky about who we partner with; new clients only come in via trusted referral. We've worked with Lyft, McGraw Hill, ClearCo, Pepsi, Walmart, the former CEO of Waze, the leading vaccine production software, several new unicorns we can't say here, and dozens of startups backed by a16z/YC/Softbank/Insight/Tiger/etc.
  • Work alongside friends old & new: our niche is small/diverse product teams, since clients with larger budgets and higher-impact work tell us they want teams, not individuals. Of course, we keep friends together whenever we can.
  • Full autonomy: say "no" to things that don't excite you. The most talented builders often juggle a few things at once, so there's never pressure to join an A·Team mission if you don't have the bandwidth. If we're no longer a fit, it's easy to leave or pause too. 
  • Small, curated, off-the-record gatherings: for conversations hard to have elsewhere. Long-term, we're creating micro-communities for the world's top builders to become friends around the things they care about.
  • Keep 100% of what you earn: if you charge $120/hr, you get $120/hr. A·Team makes money by charging a small, flat, transparent platform fee on top of your rate.

 

 

How to apply:

Go here: https://build.a.team/remotivereferral + mention Remotive. We respect your time so the application is short. We're also much more interested in seeing what you've made, and excited to chat more if there’s a fit.

What you’ll do:

  • Once part of A.Team, you’ll regularly be invited to impactful missions that match your interests. Find the right pick from early-stage incubations with world-class founders, to fast-growing super-funded companies, to old school non-tech incumbents looking to build as a tech giant would

  • Missions usually involve building an ambitious piece of software from 0 to 1 as part of a small 3-4 person team. 

  • You’ll be paid to scope it out, give the client options, guide strategy, and execute on the selected solution. Sometimes the client has a clear vision, sometimes not; which is why A.Team builders tend to be senior folks who can work together to find the right direction. 

Who A·Team is for:

  • Senior software developers who left large companies and high-growth startups to pursue their craft with autonomy.

  • Those who prefer consistent contract work over a full-time role, who want to create a variety of new products alongside other top-tier builders.

  • The majority of A.Teamers spend most of their time doing independent work, but a sizeable percentage are either employed full-time (but testing out client work), bootstrapping a side project, or looking for their next big thing

Who A·Team is not for:

  • People looking for small gigs

  • Folks looking to build simple wordpress/wix/squarespace-style websites

  • Those still early in their careers (<4 years) and recent university/bootcamp grads (at least not yet)

Our long-term vision:

A·Team is a new type of company for a new kind of independent software builder. We call them "unhirables": people who traditional companies couldn’t hire full-time even if they wanted to, but who want to do their most meaningful work with their favorite people in small, autonomous, distributed expert teams. 

To help us secure amazing missions, we raised $60 million+  from Insight Partenrs, Tiger Global, NFX, RocNation, along with the former CEO of Upwork, the founders of Fiverr and Lemonade, Apple's Global Head of Recruiting, YC Partner Aaron Harris, Wharton's Adam Grant, and Duke's Dan Ariely.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.description:
DomainTools is looking for a Principal Product Manager to join its Product team. Data is the backbone of our products, and this role will be responsible for growing and refining the data products that drive our threat intelligence solutions, with API-first delivery and integration into UI, AI and third-party experiences and workflows. This is a strategic role for the company that has a high impact on the companyâs success, and has a great deal of visibility both inside and outside the company. The ideal candidate is a strong leader and successful product manager with a track record of delivering market-leading data products, with insights derived from direct customer interaction and big-data analysis. If you want to make a big impact in an established, growth-stage company, and if you love data product management, DomainTools is the place to be!

The product manager is expected to contribute to her/his team a solid knowledge of the various constraints of the business, and a prioritized assessment of the opportunities that the business can capitalize on. The product manager must also contribute to the product team a deep knowledge of our users and customers, and an understanding of the platforms that our customers use to engage with our products. Finally the product manager is expected to track industry trends and the competitive landscape as they pertain to their products.Â 

While each member of the product team may be accountable for a specific area, we look for product managers that understand that consistent innovation is the result of each member of the product team contributing their passion and their ideas.Â  The product manager must collaborate closely with engineering, marketing, sales and solutions engineering teams to deliver world-class solutions to market.

This job, as with the other roles on the product team, is an individual contributor role. You will need to be able to influence your teammates, colleagues, stakeholders, and key executives, through your use of data and logic.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Minimum 7 years in cybersecurity or data-related product management, delivering data-driven analytics and products
  • Deep knowledge of their business and its customers, understanding how data products are utilized by its users, and valued by buyers
  • Experience working with threat intelligence products, threat feeds, APIs, and related technologies
  • Experience interacting with customers who leverage data warehousing, data science, and Big Data technologies
  • Experience with integration of data products into third-party environments (both customer and partner ecosystems)
  • Experience working with Agile (kanban/scrum) development teams and processes
  • Excellent people skills, working with cross-functional teams across the organization to bring a solution from ideation to market
  • Excellent writing, communication, and presentation skills
  • US-based, with a willingness to accommodate core hours that overlap at least 9am-3pm US Pacific time

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with real-time data collection, processing and delivery
  • Experience with large language models (LLMs) and agentic workflows
  • Experience with data products that leverage predictive analytics / machine learning (ML)

jobs.title: Design Engineer (Web & Brand)
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

We're looking for a Design Engineer with strong visual taste to help drive our creative initiatives across web and brand. When it comes to design and code, we’re looking to work with experienced people who can pick up any problem and solve it. For us, it’s both how it works and how it looks. At its core, Linear is a developer tool where speed, interactions, and small details matter. We expect a broad set of design skills and the ability to create high-quality designs, interactions, and prototypes.

In this role, you will help communicate Linear's story—what we're building and why it matters—as part of our internal creative agency: the Magic Team.

What you'll do

 - You will be responsible for building complex and interactive UI web/app experiences

 - Build beautiful, responsive websites, landing pages, and internal tools

 - Implement creative animations and interactions in code

 - Explore visual design in Figma and translate it to web-native experiences

What we're looking for

 - Eye for good design

 - Strong frontend engineering skills

 - Experience building end-to-end websites and landing pages

 - Experience with React and TypeScript

 - Experience using agentic coding tools as part of the design process (from exploring ideas to building production-quality interactions)

 - A portfolio or Twitter profile showcasing a range of technical skills, a creative use of code, and prototyping skills

What we offer

 - Interesting and challenging work

 - Work life balance

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms (extended exercise)

 - Paid lunch and coffee during work days

 - Work remotely, no commuting to the office

 - Paid co-working space/desk at an office

 - Regular team events and offsites

 - 5 weeks paid vacation

 - 4 months paid parental leave

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, India
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer focused on migrations to join our growing team in India. You will help deliver complex, production-grade data migrations, integrations, and automations for customers across APAC.

This is initially an internally focused, hands-on engineering role. You will partner closely with regional Forward Deployed Engineers, who own customer discovery, solution architecture, stakeholder communication, risk management, and final customer validation. You will own the behind-the-scenes technical execution layer from feasibility assessment and implementation through testing, production rollout, QA, reconciliation, reporting, and operational handoff.

You will work across multiple customer environments and source systems, often with incomplete requirements, imperfect data, and real-world constraints. Success requires strong engineering fundamentals, sound judgment, careful validation, and the ability to turn one-off delivery work into reusable tools and repeatable playbooks.

As a founding engineer in India, you will help build a new regional engineering capability from the ground up. You will create migration infrastructure, standards, and reusable tooling used by FDEs across APAC, while establishing practices that can scale globally. The role offers an opportunity to become a technical authority for production migration delivery, shaping how Notion approaches reliability, validation, and operational quality across complex customer environments. As the team grows, the role may also expand toward customer-facing FDE work, technical leadership, or a deeper engineering path, depending on business needs and demonstrated capability.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the technical execution layer after customer requirements, scope, and solution architecture have been established with the regional FDE. Contribute to feasibility assessment, estimation, implementation planning, and risk identification while the regional FDE remains accountable for customer discovery, scope, architecture, stakeholder communication, and final acceptance.

 - Apply a repeatable migration lifecycle covering source inventory and sampling, scope and pruning decisions, compatibility and degradation assessment, transformation design, pilot or dry run, user acceptance testing, production cutover, reconciliation, remediation, hypercare, and documented handoff.

 - Translate approved customer and regional FDE requirements into clear technical designs, implementation plans, test strategies, runbooks, and delivery estimates.

 - Build production-quality migration utilities, backend services, data pipelines, integrations, and automations using Python, SQL, APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure.

 - Investigate source-system behavior, data quality issues, permissions, rate limits, authentication constraints, and edge cases, then recommend practical solutions.

 - Design and validate permissions, ownership, and inheritance mappings against the approved migration plan. Make unsupported or ambiguous access requirements explicit, obtain the required decision or approval, and preserve evidence of validation.

 - Design migrations for reliability, scale, security, observability, idempotency, failure recovery, and safe reruns.

 - Execute migrations only through approved environments, devices, accounts, and tooling. Follow least-privilege access, customer-specific security and data-residency requirements, and approved handling procedures. Do not store customer data in unmanaged local or external systems, and escalate privacy, security, or sovereignty concerns before execution.

 - Build validation and reconciliation frameworks that provide clear evidence of migration completeness, accuracy, and exceptions.

 - Debug failures across application code, infrastructure, customer data, third-party systems, and the Notion platform, then drive issues through resolution.

 - Manage multiple implementation workstreams, dependencies, and priorities while communicating scope, progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly.

 - Surface scope changes, unsupported requirements, timeline risks, and material effort increases early. Document assumptions and trade-offs, and escalate with options and a recommended path rather than silently absorbing additional work.

 - Maintain an auditable record of scope, decisions, risks, approvals, validation evidence, and customer acceptance criteria in the agreed shared workspace or channel.

 - Convert repeated delivery patterns into reusable components, automation, documentation, and playbooks that improve speed, quality, and cost over time.

 - Bring field learnings back to Notion's Product and Engineering teams as actionable platform feedback and technical requirements.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 3 to 6 years of hands-on experience in backend engineering, data engineering, integration engineering, implementation engineering, technical consulting, solutions engineering, or a similar technical role.

 - Strong hands-on Python development experience.

 - Working experience with Node.js, JavaScript, or TypeScript.

 - Strong SQL skills and a solid understanding of relational databases, data modeling, and data transformation.

 - Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, authentication, webhooks, and system integrations.

 - Experience owning a production migration, integration, or technical implementation through mapping, transformation, testing, rollout, validation, and handoff.

 - Experience taking a technical problem from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and production operation.

 - Experience with Git, code review, automated testing, release practices, and production deployment.

 - Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills across code, data, infrastructure, and external systems.

 - Evidence of working on production systems, not only prototypes or proof-of-concept projects.

 - Clear written and verbal English communication, with the ability to explain technical decisions, constraints, and risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 - High agency and ownership. You are comfortable making progress with incomplete information, challenging assumptions, and escalating with options and a recommendation.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, job orchestration, or infrastructure automation.

 - Experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure.

 - Familiarity with message queues, event-driven systems, distributed-system patterns, retries, concurrency, and rate limits.

 - Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, or other observability tools.

 - Experience with enterprise SaaS applications, professional services, or large-scale customer implementations.

 - Experience migrating large volumes of content or structured data between enterprise platforms.

 - Experience with AI or LLM applications, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation frameworks, or agentic workflows.

 - Familiarity with MCP, tool calling, Notion Workers, Custom Agents, or similar extensibility platforms.

 - Experience working with distributed global or APAC teams.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

In your first 90 days, you will:

 - Learn Notion's migration and implementation ecosystem, engineering standards, and APAC delivery model.

 - Establish a productive working rhythm with regional FDE partners.

 - Contribute to at least one migration or integration workstream through production delivery.

 - Leave behind clear technical documentation, validation evidence, and an operational runbook.

Within your first six months, you will:

 - Independently own production migration or integration workstreams from technical design through rollout and handoff.

 - Deliver measurable improvements in migration turnaround time, validation quality, delivery cost, or regional FDE execution hours through reusable engineering.

 - Help establish repeatable quality controls, code review practices, runbooks, and observability patterns for the India team.

 - Demonstrate effective prioritization and communication across multiple concurrent APAC engagements.

 - Turn at least one repeated delivery pattern into a reusable tool, component, or playbook that is adopted by a subsequent engagement.




LOCATION:

This role is based in Hyderabad, India. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our Anchor Days, because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We're looking for someone who's excited to work alongside the team during those days.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Danish-speaking Assistance Coordinator in Spain
jobs.description:
Viking Travel Care is looking for Danish-speaking Assistance Coordinators to join our travel insurance assistance centre in Spain.

At Viking Travel Care, you will assist Nordic travellers around the world when they experience illness, accidents or other unexpected situations while travelling. You will provide important support to customers who need reassurance, information and practical assistance.

This could be an exciting opportunity for you if you already live in Spain or are considering moving here.

What does the role involve?

As an Assistance Coordinator, you will often be the first person a customer speaks to when something has happened.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Answering telephone calls and emails
    Listening to customers and understanding their situation
    Opening and following up on cases
    Providing information about insurance coverage
    Assisting with arrangements involving doctors, clinics, transport, hotels or repatriation when required
    Working with insurance companies, doctors, clinics and other partners

Our assistance centre operates 24/7, and working hours are organised across daytime, evening, night and weekend shifts.

Who are we looking for?

You do not need a particular educational background to apply. What matters most is that you enjoy helping people, communicate well and are comfortable working in a busy environment.

Experience in customer service, travel, healthcare, insurance, hospitality or other people-focused roles may be relevant, but it is not a requirement.

A background in areas such as languages, travel and tourism, healthcare, law, insurance or international studies may also be relevant, but is not required.

We are looking for someone who:

    Speaks and writes Danish fluently
    Speaks and writes English confidently
    Is comfortable communicating by telephone and in writing
    Is organised and accurate
    Enjoys finding solutions
    Works well both as part of a team and independently
    Learns new systems quickly
    Is flexible and positive

Additional languages are an advantage.

To proceed in the recruitment process, you must be able to provide a clean criminal record certificate.

What we offer

    A full-time position in accordance with Spanish employment law
    Thorough and structured training
    A competitive salary and good employment conditions
    A social and inclusive working environment
    Varied working days where you can make a genuine difference
    Opportunities for personal and professional development
    Attractive offices in Torrevieja or Fuengirola

How to apply

Please submit your application and CV. Applications will be reviewed and interviews conducted on an ongoing basis.

Interviews will be held on an ongoing basis.

We look forward to hearing from you!

About Viking

Viking Travel Care assists travelers and expatriate employees around the world on behalf of travel insurance companies. We coordinate assistance for Nordic travelers and, through our global network of medical providers and partners, provide support in situations ranging from minor travel-related incidents to complex medical emergencies.

Viking Travel Care is part of Viking Assistance Group, a leading Nordic provider of roadside assistance, vehicle-related services and assistance solutions. Viking has offices in Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen, Helsinki, Torrevieja and Fuengirola, Spain.

jobs.title: Technical Product Lead AI Finance App
jobs.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

Â 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Â 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

Â 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

Â 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

    Â 

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

    Â 

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

    Â 

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Identity & Authorization
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.




ABOUT THE TEAM

Product Platform builds and owns the shared foundations the rest of Replit is built on, spanning the full stack so every other team can ship features safely and quickly.

Identity & Authorization defines how people, agents, sandboxes, and services prove who they are and what they can do. These systems protect critical product and service interactions across Replit's web product, Agent, enterprise controls, and internal services.

Our work is high-leverage and horizontal: when identity and policy are clear, reliable, and easy to adopt, every other team can move faster without rebuilding security controls.

We are a small, collaborative team that values curiosity and clear thinking over pedigree, and we work in the open by bringing each other the problem rather than just the request. We care more about how you reason and build than the route you took to get here.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Software Engineer, you will design, build, and operate the identity and authorization systems that protect critical interactions on Replit, including Agent acting on behalf of a user or holding their own identity.

The work is guided by a few simple questions:

 - Can every protected request prove which workload made it, which principal it represents, and who is acting on that principal's behalf?

 - Can product teams express policy once and trust the same decision across web, mobile, Agent, and internal services?

 - Can enterprise administrators control who can access each workspace, app, connector, and Agent capability without navigating a permission maze as well as having a legible ledger of decisions?

 - Can Agent act for a user across long-running and durable work without receiving broad or long-lived credentials?

 - Are identity and authorization fast, reliable, highly available, and observable enough for the product flows that depend on them?




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design and operate central authorization interfaces with typed principals, actions, resources, decisions, explainable deny reasons, privilege attenuation, delegations, and obligations

 - Evolve enterprise roles, groups, app access, entitlements, and workspace policy so common cases stay simple and advanced cases remain possible

 - Build and operate Replit's Security Token Service and workload identity using OAuth 2.0 token exchange, JWT/OIDC, SPIFFE/SPIRE, and mTLS

 - Threat-model delegation, confused-deputy risks, and cross-tenant movement, then make secure, fail-closed behavior the default

 - Lead compatible migrations with shadow evaluation, feature gates, telemetry, and rollback plans, and own the SLOs, incidents, and operational health of the systems you ship

 - Partner with Agent, Connectors, Enterprise, Security, and Infrastructure teams to turn product requirements into shared platform primitives

 - Research and develop new innovative approaches to Authx in the Agentic world




AREAS YOU MIGHT WORK IN

 - Authorization policy: evolve Replit's central policy decision point and migrate fragmented authorization checks to its typed contract.

 - Agent delegation: extend the current delegation foundation so the user is the subject and Agent is the authenticated actor, with continuous validation and dynamic permission envelopes as work runs.

 - Enterprise access control: evolve roles, groups, workspace policy, and app-level grants for both simple collaboration and complex organizations.

 - Agent and service identity and reliability: operate the token and workload-identity systems that protect service-to-service traffic.




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

 - Experience shipping and operating security-sensitive backend or distributed systems in production, including reliability, performance, incidents, and observability

 - Depth in authentication, authorization, or identity systems, such as OAuth 2.0/OIDC, JWT, mTLS, Identity Federation, RBAC, ReBAC, PBAC, Zanzibar, Macaroons, Biscuits, Cedar, or policy engines. You do not need prior experience with every item

 - Strong understanding of multi-tenant security, least privilege, delegation, privilege attenuation, auditability, and threat modeling

 - Experience migrating security-sensitive systems without breaking callers. Approaches can include typed contracts, shadow evaluation, and staged enforcement

 - Fluent in at least one production backend stack. Our systems use TypeScript, Go, Rust, Postgres, gRPC/Protobuf, Kubernetes, Envoy, and Restate

 - Able to make and communicate tradeoffs across security, reliability, latency, product experience, delivery speed, and long-term maintainability



If you're excited about this role but don't meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

Location & work mode

jobs.title: Product Partnerships Manager, Consumer/SMB
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE:

We're hiring a Product Partnerships Manager to own Replit's most important strategic partnerships end-to-end: from identifying the opportunity to shipping the outcome and measuring the impact.

This is a product-focused role where you will work with our consumer technology partners, such as Stripe, Shopify, Google, and the broader connector ecosystem. You'll work at the intersection of product strategy, ecosystem thinking, and deal execution. You'll need to be a serious Replit power user. You'll speak credibly with engineers. You'll negotiate with senior partner stakeholders. And you'll be the person accountable for turning ambiguous ecosystem opportunities into shipped product and business outcomes.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Develop a clear point of view on Replit's partner landscape and build a prioritized pipeline of high-leverage opportunities across consumer tooling, AI tooling, cloud and infrastructure, and payments technology partners.

 - Lead partner conversations from early exploration through joint product thesis, business case, commercial terms, launch plan, and post-launch iteration.

 - Partner with Product, Engineering, Partner Engineering, Legal, Finance, Marketing, and Sales to turn agreements into shipped outcomes.

 - Work directly with Partner Engineers to scope integrations, demos, prototypes, reference apps, and partner enablement assets.

 - Define success metrics before every launch activation: retained usage, apps created, deployments, revenue, partner-sourced users, and use them to decide when to scale, iterate, or sunset a partnership.

 - Build lightweight operating systems: partner scorecards, launch checklists, partner roadmap tracking, and repeatable frameworks for evaluating new opportunities.

 - Represent the partner internally with strong product judgment; inform roadmap changes only when they create clear leverage for Replit users.



WHO YOU ARE

You're probably one of these:

 - A product partnerships or BD person from a developer platform, AI platform, API company, cloud platform, or builder tool.

 - A former PM or founder who can sell and negotiate externally while staying close to the product.

 - A technical ecosystem operator who has shipped integrations, partner programs, or AI-native workflows.

In all cases, you're a builder. You can open Replit and put together a credible demo. You're not expected to write production integration code but you need enough technical depth to scope the work, ask the right questions, and earn trust with engineers.



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - Experience sourcing, structuring, negotiating, and launching strategic partnerships.

 - Strong product judgment: you can explain why a partnership should or shouldn't influence the roadmap.

 - Technical fluency with APIs, auth, cloud and deployment, databases, LLMs, agents, and developer workflows.

 - Hands-on familiarity with Replit or comparable AI-native developer tools; ability to build credible demos and prototypes.

 - Ability to run an ambiguous, multi-party process from discovery through signed agreement, launch, and measurement.

 - Credibility with both senior external partners and internal engineers.

 - Strong written and verbal communication.

 


BONUS QUALIFICATIONS

 - Background in AI, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, API companies, or creative/productivity software.

 - Experience with MCP-style integrations, agent workflows, or AI model/tooling ecosystems.

 - Founder, PM, DevRel, solutions engineering, or technical BD background



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Manager -London
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Manager of Forward Deployed Engineering on Notion’s Services team, you will lead a team responsible for the hands-on technical delivery of our most complex customer engagements. Your team will design, build, and deploy production-ready solutions that help enterprise customers integrate Notion as the operating layer for their business.

You will combine people leadership, technical judgment, and customer-facing delivery. You will coach Forward Deployed Engineers through discovery, architecture, implementation, and launch while remaining close enough to the work to guide difficult technical decisions, unblock delivery, and build trust with senior customer stakeholders.

The team’s work includes custom code, production-grade agents and AI workflows using MCP, Agent APIs, and Notion’s automation and execution infrastructure, as well as integrations, data pipelines, enterprise migrations, and complex challenges involving scale, permissions, and governance.

You will help establish how Services delivers complex technical implementations across EMEA. This includes building a high-performing team, improving delivery standards and reusable technical assets, partnering with Sales, Product, CX, and Engineering, and turning lessons from customer deployments into product and platform improvements.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Lead, coach, and develop a team of Forward Deployed Engineers delivering complex enterprise customer engagements across EMEA.

 - Create a high-performance team environment with clear expectations, strong technical standards, effective feedback, and meaningful career development.

 - Own the quality and outcomes of engagements from technical discovery and requirements gathering through solution design, implementation, launch, and handover.

 - Act as a trusted technical and delivery advisor to customer engineering, IT, security, and business leaders, helping them make informed architectural decisions and deepen their use of Notion.

 - Guide the design, build, and operation of custom agents, integrations, automations, and data pipelines that connect Notion with customers’ systems and workflows.

 - Oversee large-scale content and data migrations, including discovery, scoping, data modeling, transformation logic, validation, cutover, and post-migration optimization.

 - Review technical designs and implementation plans, identify delivery risks early, and step in directly when an engagement requires senior technical leadership.

 - Partner with Sales and Services leaders on qualification, feasibility, scoping, effort estimation, staffing, and delivery planning for strategic opportunities.

 - Balance customer priorities, team capacity, and technical complexity to make sound staffing and sequencing decisions.

 - Help define and scale the operating model for Forward Deployed Engineering, including hiring, onboarding, delivery methodologies, quality reviews, documentation, and engineering best practices.



SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 8+ years of experience in forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering, professional services, customer engineering, software engineering, or a similar hands-on technical role.

 - 2+ years of experience managing, coaching, or leading engineers responsible for customer-facing technical delivery.

 - A strong track record of hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing technical teams.

 - Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Java, JavaScript, Node.js, SQL, or Python, with the technical depth to review production-quality code and guide implementation decisions.

 - Hands-on experience with APIs, integrations, authentication, data transformation, and production systems.

 - Experience leading technical discovery, assessing feasibility, identifying risks, scoping work, estimating effort, and translating ambiguous requirements into executable plans.

 - Strong architectural judgment and debugging skills, with the ability to isolate root causes across code, APIs, permissions, integrations, data quality, automation logic, system limits, and customer-specific environments.

 - Demonstrated success managing multiple complex customer engagements while maintaining quality, team health, and clear stakeholder communication.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and business audiences from practitioners through executive stakeholders.

 - A customer- and outcomes-oriented approach, with sound judgment about when to standardize, when to customize, and how to manage tradeoffs.
   
   
   


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience building or scaling a Forward Deployed Engineering, professional services, or customer engineering function in a startup or high-growth environment.

 - Experience deploying AI agents in complex coding or business workflows.

 - Experience designing or implementing AI-powered workflows involving MCP, APIs, LLM applications, prompt engineering, retrieval or RAG systems, or workflow orchestration.

 - Experience with ETL or ELT workflows, schema mapping, validation scripts, and large-scale content or data migration tooling.

 - Experience partnering with product and engineering teams to influence roadmaps or architectural decisions based on customer implementation needs.

 - Experience supporting pre-sales and early engagement phases, including technical discovery, migration scoping, feasibility analysis, effort estimation, prototypes, and custom scripts.

 - Experience establishing technical delivery standards, quality review processes, discovery methodologies, or internal engineering tooling from the ground up.

 - A strong track record of successful enterprise implementations across multiple industries or regions.

jobs.title: Premium Support Engineer (NYC, Weekend Shift)
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


As a Premium Support Engineer at Replit, you’ll be the front line for our highest-value customers — delivering fast, expert, and reliable technical support when it matters most. You’ll handle complex product issues, guide customers through critical incidents, and ensure every interaction meets the highest standard of quality and speed.

Replit is at the forefront of AI-driven software development, and how we support customers is constantly evolving. You’ll play a critical role in shaping how Premium Support adapts to new products, new customer expectations, and AI-assisted workflows, operating effectively in ambiguity and driving clarity for your team.

You’ll combine deep technical troubleshooting with calm, confident communication to keep builders moving — whether it’s an enterprise team deploying at scale or a top-tier developer relying on Replit to power their business.






IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Provide swift, high-priority support to Premium customers, responding within strict SLAs.

 - Diagnose, reproduce, and resolve complex technical issues across the Replit platform.

 - Escalate and track high-impact issues with Product and Engineering, ensuring timely fixes and transparent communication.

 - Lead customer-facing communications during outages or incidents.

 - Identify recurring issues and collaborate internally to reduce time-to-resolution.

 - Contribute to internal tooling, automation, and documentation that improves team efficiency.

 - Partner with Engineering, Product, Sales and other internal teams to ensure Premium customers receive a consistent, high-quality experience.

 - Help onboard and mentor other support engineers, raising the team’s overall bar for responsiveness and quality.




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 3+ years in technical support, developer support, or systems engineering.

 - Experience providing rapid-response support to high-value or enterprise customers.

 - Strong debugging skills with JavaScript, Python, or similar languages.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication under time pressure — able to convey technical concepts clearly and calmly.

 - Familiarity with support tools like Zendesk, Linear, Slack, and internal debugging utilities.

 - Proven ability to manage multiple high-priority issues simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and composure.

 - A proactive, ownership-driven mindset and genuine empathy for customers building on Replit.




NICE TO HAVE:

 - Has used Replit in the last 3 to 6 months.

 - Experience working with IDEs, terminals, or other common developer tools.

 - Experience with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.)




WHAT WE VALUE:

 - Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach complex operational challenges systematically and devise effective solutions

 - Self-directed and autonomous: Capable of working independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams

 - Strong communication skills: Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Continuous learning: Passion for staying current with industry best practices and new technologies

 - Focus on automation: Strong belief in automating repetitive tasks and building self-healing systems



This is a full-time role that can be held from our NYC office. The schedule follows a Saturday through Wednesday work week, with an in-office requirement on Mondays and Wednesdays.

jobs.title: Kiemsargis
jobs.description:
1.    Palaikyti švarą ir tvarką mokyklos teritorijoje.
2.    Kasdien nušluoti takelius, šaligatvius, iškaupti žolę takeliuose ir žaidimų aikštelėse, surinkti šiukšles (1–2 val. prieš ateinant vaikams).
3.    Vasaros, rudens ir pavasario laikotarpiu prižiūrėti bei laistyti gėlynus, pjauti žolę.
4.    Prižiūrėti ir tinkamai eksploatuoti naudojamą techniką: žoliapjovę, žoliapjovės traktorių, trimerius (valyti, tikrinti techninę būklę, atlikti smulkų remontą, laiku informuoti apie gedimus).
5.    Užtikrinti tinkamą technikos saugojimą, laikymą ir priežiūrą ne darbo metu.
6.    Vykdyti kuro sunaudojimo apskaitą, racionaliai naudoti kurą ir kitas eksploatacines medžiagas.
7.    Žiemą nukasti sniegą nuo takelių, šaligatvių, žaidimų aikštelių, įėjimų į pastatą, barstyti takelius smėliu.
8.    Kasdien apžiūrėti inventorių; esant gedimams – remontuoti savo jėgomis arba informuoti pavaduotoją ūkio reikalams.
9.    Perdažyti lauko įrenginius, atlikti smulkų jų remontą.
Kiemsargio atsakomybė: už mokyklos teritorijos priežiūrą ir tvarką; už sanitarinių higieninių reikalavimų vykdymą; už saugos darbe ir priešgaisrinės saugos reikalavimų laikymąsi; Už patikėtos technikos, įrankių ir inventoriaus saugumą, tinkamą naudojimą bei priežiūrą; už kuro ir eksploatacinių medžiagų racionalų naudojimą; už aukščiau išvardintų pareigų vykdymą.
Kiemsargis privalo: vykdyti mokyklos direktoriaus, pavaduotojo ūkiui arba įgaliotų asmenų su darbu susijusius nurodymus. Mokėti saugiai dirbti ir netrukdyti saugiai dirbti kitiems. Laiku tikrintis sveikatą. Laikytis įstaigos vidaus tvarkos taisyklių, darbe nevartoti alkoholinių gėrimų bei narkotinių medžiagų. Laikytis įrenginių naudojimo instrukcijų reikalavimų, asmens higienos reikalavimų.

jobs.title: Security Engineer, Corporate Security
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT US:

Notion helps you build beautiful tools for your life’s work. In today's world of endless apps and tabs, Notion provides one place for teams to get everything done, seamlessly connecting docs, notes, projects, calendar, and email—with AI built in to find answers and automate work. Millions of users, from individuals to large organizations like Toyota, Figma, and OpenAI, love Notion for its flexibility and choose it because it helps them save time and money.

 

In-person collaboration is essential to Notion's culture. We require all team members to work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our designated Anchor Days. Certain teams or positions may require additional in-office workdays.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE:

Millions of people rely on Notion to do their most important work. Protecting that trust starts with protecting the people who build Notion: our employees, their laptops, their identities, and the SaaS apps they rely on every day.



We are looking for a hands-on Corporate Security Engineer to own and improve the technical controls that keep our workforce and corporate environment safe. This is a security engineering role focused on building scalable controls and automation across identity, endpoints, SaaS, and workforce infrastructure, not a traditional IT support or corporate engineering role.



You'll own and evolve core security controls, design systems and automation that scale with the company, and help make security both stronger and easier to use. You'll partner closely with IT, Infrastructure, GRC, and Detection & Response to improve the security foundations that employees rely on every day.

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Harden our identity and access management stack, including Okta and Google Workspace, with phishing-resistant MFA, strong SSO and SCIM lifecycles, and least-privilege access across SaaS.

 - Run our endpoint security program across a macOS-first fleet, including MDM, EDR, and configuration baselines, with working coverage for Windows and ChromeOS.

 - Secure AI tool usage at the endpoint, including governance of large language models, AI agents, and model context protocol (MCP) integrations; detect and prevent unauthorized or risky AI service access and data exfiltration through AI-enabled tools.

 - Reduce SaaS risk at scale through SSPM tooling and custom automation, including detection of risky OAuth grants, excessive permissions, shadow IT, and configuration drift.

 - Write code (Python, Terraform) to automate access reviews, onboarding and offboarding, configuration drift detection, and audit evidence collection.

 - Partner with Detection & Response to ensure corporate systems produce the telemetry needed to detect identity, endpoint, and SaaS abuse.

 - Support SOC 2, ISO 27001, and customer audits as a byproduct of good engineering, not a separate workstream.

 - Partner with Detection & Response on investigation and response for corporate security incidents, including phishing, account compromise, lost devices, and BEC.

 


SKILLS YOU NEED TO BRING:

 - Have 5+ years of hands-on experience in corporate security, enterprise security, or IT security engineering at a cloud-native company.

 - Have working knowledge of a major identity provider (Okta, Entra, or Google Workspace) and the underlying protocols (SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM).

 - Have hands-on experience operating endpoint management and detection tooling across macOS and enterprise environments.

 - Write production-quality scripts and automation in Python or Bash, and have shipped Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code for security configuration.

 - Are familiar with SaaS security risks (OAuth governance, audit logging, SSPM) and the realities of integrating a long tail of vendors.

 - Have working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) at the security configuration level.

 - Communicate clearly in writing and work effectively across IT, Engineering, Legal, People, and GRC.



NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience at a fast-growing tech or AI company where the security program had to outpace headcount.

 - A background in IT engineering, SRE, or production engineering that transitioned into security engineering.

 - Experience building internal security tooling or workflows that improved employee or developer experience.

 - Contributions to the security community through open-source tools, blog posts, or conference talks.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Growth Enablement
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT REPLIT

Replit is building the world's most ubiquitous AI coding agent. Replit Agent can be used by anybody to bring their ideas to life. Whether it's an app for yourself, the next great startup idea, or a tool to make you more productive at work, Replit Agent can help build it. Replit is also the leader in secure vibe coding. We protect apps, give users features to manage security risks, and help them vibe code more safely.





ABOUT THE ROLE:

Replit is changing how people and companies turn ideas into software. Reaching those customers requires engineering that connects acquisition to the product experience and gives teams trustworthy evidence about what works.


This role goes beyond operating conventional marketing technology. You will rethink growth systems for a world where agents can observe performance, diagnose problems, take action, and learn from the result.


As the founding engineer for Growth Enablement, you will set the technical direction for this area. You will build agentic systems alongside shared foundations for attribution, audiences, lifecycle engagement, referrals, and promotions. The work spans web, mobile, billing, and data.


You will work directly with marketing, sales, and partnerships to find the highest-leverage problems and ship the first solutions. Successful projects will become platforms that help these teams move faster and give Replit a clearer view of what drives durable growth.





YOU WILL:

 - Design agentic growth systems that monitor performance, diagnose failures, run approved experiments, and improve from the results.

 - Explore AI-native approaches to answer engine optimization, campaign operations, audience discovery, and measurement.

 - Build acquisition measurement across web and mobile, including click-ID capture, identity matching, server-side conversion APIs, and warehouse attribution.

 - Create a shared standard for deep links and context transfer across web, iOS, Android, and app-store handoffs.

 - Build reusable systems for promotions, referrals, campaign landing pages, fraud controls, attribution, and holdout measurement.

 - Build audience pipelines that sync warehouse-defined cohorts and exclusions to each delivery channel.

 - Work directly with marketing, sales, and partnerships to turn business needs into technical systems.



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend expertise in TypeScript/Node, Python, Go, or a similar language.

 - Strong SQL skills and experience working with a data warehouse and event instrumentation.

 - Hands-on experience with attribution, marketing technology, deep linking, payment webhooks, or high-scale event pipelines.

 - A record of working with non-engineering partners to turn ambiguous business needs into shipped systems.




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Built growth or martech infrastructure at a consumer or PLG company, such as referral systems, promotion platforms, lifecycle tooling, or CDPs.

 - Built agents that act on business data with clear evaluations, permissions, and human controls.

 - Experience with experimentation platforms such as Statsig and lifecycle tools such as Iterable.

 - Familiarity with privacy and consent handling in marketing data pipelines.




BONUS POINTS:

 - Experience shipping mobile attribution with OneLink, Universal Links, App Links, or SKAN.

 - Experience carrying attribution through payment systems such as Stripe or Razorpay.

 - Regular use of AI agents to plan, implement, test, or review your work.




WHAT WE VALUE:

 - Extreme ownership: identify important work, carry it through launch, and resolve blockers quickly.

 - Data-driven decisions: define hypotheses and success criteria before launch, then change direction when the evidence calls for it.

 - No borders: solve the highest-impact problem, whether it requires a PRD, a warehouse query, code, or campaign setup.

 - Speed through reversibility: ship the smallest step that produces useful signal, and slow down for decisions that are hard to reverse.

 - Strong communication: make technical constraints and business requirements clear to engineers and go-to-market partners.
   

This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The hybrid role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

WHO WE ARE

We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion has a very successful "land and expand" business model; our customers start using Notion for free, upgrade over time as they expand their teams, and embrace increasingly sophisticated use cases. jobs.title: Learning Experiences Creator
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Replit is where millions of people learn to build software - and our documentation and learning content are where they get going or give up. We're taking ownership of that experience, and we're looking for a Learning Experience Creator who can make it worthy of the product: someone who turns product knowledge into experiences people actually use - clear written docs, guided learning, short video, interactive experiences - findable at the moment of need, accurate every time, and genuinely enjoyable.

You're a learning-experience creator first. You understand how people actually learn a product - what they're trying to accomplish, where they get stuck, what format serves each moment - and you move fluidly between writing a crisp help article, designing a hands-on walkthrough, and producing a short video. Underneath it all, you're a storyteller: you know how to earn attention in the first few seconds, hold it against real-world attention spans, and make ideas stick - and sometimes make something people can't help but share. You're also a builder: unafraid to try new formats and experiment, you read the data and listen to customers, and you continually improve and evolve with speed as our product evolves. You'll turn complex things into simple, useful experiences, and you'll own how well they land.

The Mission: help every user - external customers and internal teams - self-serve to reach their creative and business goals, with content so good, so current, and so findable that they don't need to open a ticket. Success looks like real ticket deflection, faster activation, and high CSAT.

 


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - New documentation and learning content. You'll populate our documentation and learning surfaces with new, accurate, plain-language content - help articles, answer-first FAQs, goal-based tutorials, and rebuilt getting-started paths - prioritized by real reader and ticket data, made at volume with the help of our AI- native content tools.

 - The content lifecycle. Content isn't done when it ships. You'll keep the library current through every product launch - freshness reviews, launch-day updates, retiring what's stale - so nothing published contradicts the product. Our pipeline flags what's drifting; you own making it right.

 - Learning experiences across formats. Written first where reading serves best - plus short-form video, microlearning, interactive courses, quick walkthroughs, GIFs, and in-product tips. You pick the format that fits the job, not the other way around, and you bring a storyteller's instinct for attention and memorability to every one - learning content competes with everything else on someone's screen, and yours wins. You keep pushing into new, innovative experiences as our tools grow.

 - A content calendar built for effectiveness. You plan what gets made and when - covering the topics customers most need help with, sequenced for maximum impact, so the library actually answers the questions people are asking.

 - Findability. You make sure content is easy to discover - titled, tagged, and structured so people (and the AI assistants that read our docs) find the right answer through search, at the moment of need. Great content nobody can find doesn't deflect anything, and this is yours to own.

 - Engagement and outcomes. You care whether it worked - reader feedback, findability, completion and watch-through, self-serve resolution, deflection, CSAT - and you tune the calendar and the craft based on what the data and customers tell you.

 - A recognizable voice. A consistent, human style across docs, learning, and video that makes every piece feel like part of one connected experience, whether someone reads a single article or completes a whole course.

 


HOW YOU'LL WORK WITH THE TEAM

This role is a force-multiplier - it makes the whole team's knowledge reach people. You won't work alone:

• With our Technical Customer Education Specialist for accuracy and depth - they bring the technical truth; you turn it into clear, findable content people trust and enjoy.

• With our Sr. Learning Experience Lead on what content is needed and what's working - they own the learning platform, journeys, and measurement; you read the same effectiveness data to steer the calendar.

• With our docs and product partners on launches - so new features ship with accurate, ready content on day one, not weeks later.

• With the hiring manager and the wider team to scale our content capability together, so the sum is greater than the parts.

 


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• A proven learning-content creator. A portfolio of documentation, tutorials, courses, or product education that people actually used and learned from - across at least two formats, with written content among them. You understand clarity, structure, and story, and you can prove it.

• A strong writer. You make complex or dry topics genuinely clear and engaging in plain language, with warmth and a point of view. Docs people want to read are your craft.

• A gifted storyteller, across media. You understand hooks, pacing, attention spans, and what makes content memorable - sometimes shareable, occasionally viral - and you apply that craft to written, video, and interactive work alike. It shows up in a doc's first sentence as much as a video's first five seconds.

• A capable short-form video creator. Video is one of your formats - you understand watchability and modern platform sensibilities, and you're comfortable producing (on or off camera) with AI-assisted workflows.

• A builder and experimenter. You try new formats and ideas, take calculated content risks, glean insights from data and customers, and continually improve - determining the right approach even when the problem is ambiguous.

• Fast to learn a product. You get up to speed quickly and can represent it accurately to newcomers - you don't need to be a developer, but you make technical things make sense.

• Outcome-minded. You define what success looks like for your work, and you care about real results (deflection, activation, self-serve success, CSAT), not just output.

• A strong thought partner. You share ideas openly, seek other perspectives, and collaborate well across a small, fast team.

 


BONUS

• Experience writing or maintaining developer or product documentation (docs-as-code, Markdown-based platforms) - and a feel for content lifecycle at scale.

• Hands-on with AI-native build or content tools (Replit) and modern editing/production workflows.

• Instructional design fundamentals - you know why a checklist beats a paragraph and when a video beats both.

• A feel for discoverability and search - how people (and AI assistants) find content and how to help them.

• Experience running a content channel, editorial calendar, or creator program with an audience - bonus points if something you made really took off.

 

This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance
